In 1998, Labour Member of Parliament Gwyneth Dunwoody demanded their return. “Just like the Greeks want their Elgin Marbles back, so we want our Winnie-the-Pooh back, along with all his splendid friends,” she said. “They plainly want to come home after 70 wasted years exile.”
paras.zh: 英国政界人士多次质疑这一安排。 1998年，工党议员格温妮丝·邓伍迪（Gwyneth Dunwoody）要求他们返回。 “就像希腊人想要回他们的埃尔金大理石一样，我们也希望我们的小熊维尼和他所有出色的朋友们回来，”她说。 “他们显然想在浪费了 70 年的流放生活后回家。”

paras.en: That prompted then-New York City Mayor Rudy Giuliani to declare Pooh and friends immigrant success stories who came to the United States “to build a better life for themselves.”
paras.zh: 这促使时任纽约市市长鲁迪·朱利安尼宣布维尼和他的朋友们是移民成功的故事，他们来到美国“是为了为自己创造更美好的生活”。

paras.en: To celebrate the centennial, the library has mounted “Silly Old Bear! Winnie-the-Pooh at 100,” a special pop-up exhibition that displays rare editions, E.H. Shepard’s original sketches and the newly gifted Roo through November 30.
paras.zh: 为了庆祝一百周年，图书馆举办了一场特别的快闪展览“愚蠢的老熊！小熊维尼 100 岁”，展示稀有版本、E.H.截止 11 月 30 日，Shepard 的原创草图和新近获得的 Roo 的作品。

paras.en: Library officials insist that the toys are inseparable from the institution’s historic heritage. “The New York Public Library’s holdings of rare Winnie-the-Pooh materials ... stand as an important cornerstone of our world-class collection of children’s literature,” Brent Reidy, the NYPL’s director of research libraries, says in a statement.
paras.zh: 图书馆官员坚称，这些玩具与该机构的历史遗产密不可分。纽约公共图书馆研究图书馆主任布伦特·雷迪在一份声明中表示：“纽约公共图书馆收藏的稀有小熊维尼资料……是我们世界级儿童文学收藏的重要基石。”

paras.en: And so, for the foreseeable future, the world’s most famous bear will remain right where he has sat for decades, quietly contemplating life from a glass case on Fifth Avenue.
paras.zh: 因此，在可预见的未来，世界上最著名的熊将继续坐在它几十年来一直坐的地方，在第五大道的玻璃柜里静静地思考生活。

paras.en: “Silly Old Bear! Winnie-the-Pooh at 100” is on view at the New York Public Library’s Stephen A. Schwarzman Building until November 30, 2026.
paras.zh: “愚蠢的老熊！小熊维尼 100 岁”将在纽约公共图书馆史蒂芬·A·施瓦茨曼大厦展出，直至 2026 年 11 月 30 日。

articles.title: A Rare Nanotyrannus Skeleton Sells for $47.3 Million, Becoming the Second Most Valuable Dinosaur Ever Auctioned

paras.en: One year after the Nanotyrannus genus was largely confirmed as separate from its Tyrannosaurus rex cousin, the world’s most complete Nanotyrannus skeleton sold at auction for a whopping $47.3 million dollars. It’s now the second most valuable dinosaur ever sold, although auction house Sotheby’s has not disclosed the buyer.
paras.zh: 在小暴龙属被基本确认与其近亲霸王龙分开一年后，世界上最完整的小暴龙骨架在拍卖会上以 4730 万美元的天价售出。尽管苏富比拍卖行尚未透露买家身份，但它现在是有史以来售出的第二大最有价值的恐龙。

paras.en: Dubbed “Jodi,” the roughly 67-million-year-old skeleton measures nearly 10 feet tall and just over 19 feet long. The adult specimen represents one of three mostly complete Nanotyrannus skeletons and features bones including a skull, around 50 teeth, a pelvic girdle, many leg and arm bones, claws, and dozens of vertebrae and ribs, according to another statement.
paras.zh: 这具骨骼被称为“乔迪”，约有 6700 万年前的历史，高近 10 英尺，长略多于 19 英尺。另一份声明称，这具成年标本代表了三具最完整的矮暴龙骨骼之一，其骨骼包括头骨、大约 50 颗牙齿、骨盆带、许多腿骨和臂骨、爪子以及数十块椎骨和肋骨。

paras.en: The fossil’s namesake, rancher Jodi Pierson, discovered the Nanotyrannus remains on her land in Montana in 2019. The fossil was preserved in the Hell Creek Formation, a fossil-rich rock formation that stretches across Montana, the Dakotas and Wyoming. Pierson’s cousin Clayton Phipps, a commercial paleontologist nicknamed the “Dinosaur Cowboy,” excavated the skeleton.
paras.zh: 该化石的同名牧场主乔迪·皮尔森 (Jodi Pierson) 于 2019 年在她位于蒙大拿州的土地上发现了小暴龙遗骸。该化石保存在地狱溪地层中，这是一个遍布蒙大拿州、达科他州和怀俄明州的富含化石的岩层。皮尔森的表弟克莱顿·菲普斯（Clayton Phipps）是一位绰号“恐龙牛仔”的商业古生物学家，他挖掘了这具骨架。

paras.en: This exceptional fossil became part of an enduring debate. It all started when paleontologists in Montana excavated a small Tyrannosaurus rex-like skull in 1942. Analyses of it split the research community into two camps: those who suspected it represented a new genus and species, N. lancensis, and those who instead suspected that it was just a young T. rex. More than 80 years later, Nanotyrannus supporters appear to have won.
paras.zh: 这块特殊的化石引起了一场持久争论。这一切都始于 1942 年蒙大拿州的古生物学家挖掘出一个类似霸王龙的小型头骨。对它的分析将研究界分成了两个阵营：一些人怀疑它代表了一个新的属和物种，即 N. lancensis，而另一些人则怀疑它只是一只年轻的霸王龙。 80 多年后，矮暴龙的支持者似乎取得了胜利。

paras.en: In a Nature study published in October 2025, researchers claimed to have conclusively demonstrated that Nanotyrannus was its own genus and includes two known species, N. lancensis and N. lethaeus. They investigated a teensy tyrannosaur specimen from a larger fossil unit nicknamed the “Dueling Dinosaurs,” in which a Nanotyrannus and Triceratops look like they’re fighting. Jodi was found just eight miles from where the Dueling Dinosaurs were discovered in 2006.
paras.zh: 在 2025 年 10 月发表的《自然》研究中，研究人员声称已最终证明矮暴龙是一个独立的属，并包括两个已知物种：N. lancensis 和 N. lethaeus。他们研究了一个来自一个更大的化石单元的小型霸王龙标本，绰号为“决斗恐龙”，其中小暴龙和三角龙看起来像是在战斗。乔迪是在距离 2006 年发现决斗恐龙的地方仅 8 英里的地方被发现的。

paras.en: Jodi is a Nanotyrannus cf. lancensis, though “cf.” means that the identification is still uncertain. In fact, the New York Times’ Sopan Deb reports that some scientists still argue over whether there are two distinct species in the genus.
paras.zh: 乔迪是一只矮暴龙 cf. lancensis，虽然“cf.”意味着身份仍不确定。事实上，《纽约时报》的 Sopan Deb 报道称，一些科学家仍在争论该属是否存在两个不同的物种。

paras.en: Sotheby’s estimated Jodi would fetch between $6 million and $9 million. But by the end of an intense 12-minute bidding battle between six contenders on October 27, the skeleton sold for more than five times the high end of its maximum evaluation. Only one dinosaur—“Gus” the T. rex—has sold for more money. That fossil went for $50.1 million this past July.
paras.zh: 苏富比估计 Jodi 的售价在 600 万至 900 万美元之间。但到 10 月 27 日，六位竞争者之间长达 12 分钟的激烈竞拍战结束时，这具骨架的售价是其最高估价上限的五倍多。只有一种恐龙——霸王龙“格斯”——售价更高。今年 7 月，这块化石以 5010 万美元的价格成交。

paras.en: At 38 feet long, Gus is about twice Jodi’s length. The T. rex stands at 12.5 feet tall.
paras.zh: 格斯长 38 英尺，大约是乔迪身长的两倍。霸王龙身高 12.5 英尺。

paras.en: “It does feel like this is a bubble of prices on dinosaurs which must burst at some point; they can’t keep rising forever,” David Hone, a paleontologist at Queen Mary University of London, tells CNN’s Jacopo Prisco. Hone was very surprised about Jodi’s steep winning bid.
paras.zh: 伦敦玛丽女王大学古生物学家戴维·霍恩 (David Hone) 告诉美国有线电视新闻网 (CNN) 的雅科波·普里斯科 (Jacopo Prisco)：“确实感觉这是恐龙价格的泡沫，总有一天会破灭；它们不可能永远持续上涨。”霍恩对乔迪的惊人中标感到非常惊讶。

paras.en: The exceptional selling point prices out many public institutions, and some scientists worry about such special specimens disappearing into the hands of private owners.
paras.zh: 这一特殊的卖点让许多公共机构望而却步，一些科学家担心这种特殊的标本会消失在私人所有者手中。

paras.en: “We’ve really just found out that Nanotyrannus is real, and now one of the best skeletons is about to be sold to the highest bidder,” Steve Brusatte, a paleontologist at the University of Edinburgh in Scotland, tells BBC News’ Angus Thompson. “It’s harrowing to think it could disappear into the vaults of a collector rather than displayed on a museum where it can wow and inspire kids and families and the public at large.”
paras.zh: 苏格兰爱丁堡大学古生物学家史蒂夫·布鲁萨特 (Steve Brusatte) 告诉英国广播公司新闻 (BBC News) 的安格斯·汤普森 (Angus Thompson)：“我们确实刚刚发现矮暴龙是真实存在的，现在最好的骨架之一即将被卖给最高出价者。” “一想到它可能会消失在收藏家的金库里，而不是在博物馆里展示，它可以让孩子、家庭和广大公众惊叹不已，激发他们的灵感，真是令人痛苦。”

paras.en: “A person really interested in paleontology could do vastly more good by supporting the ongoing operations of multiple museums than the sale of one specimen,” Thomas R. Holtz Jr., a paleontologist at the University of Maryland, tells the Guardian’s Anna Betts and Jenna Amatulli.
paras.zh: 马里兰大学古生物学家小托马斯·R·霍尔茨 (Thomas R. Holtz Jr.) 告诉《卫报》的安娜·贝茨 (Anna Betts) 和詹娜·阿马图利 (Jenna Amatulli)，“一个真正对古生物学感兴趣的人，支持多个博物馆的持续运营，比出售一个标本能做出更大的贡献。”

paras.en: But Megan Jacobs, a paleontologist at the University of Portsmouth in England, doesn’t “begrudge the people involved for wanting to sell it for such a large amount of money,” she tells BBC Radio 4’s “Today” program, per BBC News. “Although it’s a scary prospect, actually a lot of [dinosaurs sold to private collectors] have ended up in the public eye.”
paras.zh: 但据 BBC 新闻报道，英国朴茨茅斯大学古生物学家梅根·雅各布斯 (Megan Jacobs) 告诉 BBC 广播 4 台“今日”节目，她并不“嫉妒那些想要以如此大笔价格出售它的人”。 “虽然这是一个可怕的前景，但实际上很多[出售给私人收藏家的恐龙]最终进入了公众的视野。”

paras.en: For instance, a Stegosaurus skeleton called “Apex” was purchased by hedge fund billionaire Kenneth Griffin in a 2024 auction, but it’s currently on long-term loan at the American Museum of Natural History.
paras.zh: 例如，对冲基金亿万富翁肯尼思·格里芬 (Kenneth Griffin) 在 2024 年的一次拍卖中购买了一个名为“Apex”的剑龙骨架，但它目前长期租借在美国自然历史博物馆。

paras.en: “These things without a doubt will end up in a museum at some point,” Jacobs adds.
paras.zh: “毫无疑问，这些东西最终会在某个时候进入博物馆，”雅各布斯补充道。

articles.title: From a Black Limo With a Silken Armchair to a Bulletproof 'Sardine Can,' the Vatican Looks Back at the Evolution of the Popemobile

paras.en: Once dubbed a “sardine can” by Pope Francis, the popemobile—with its large, domed top and bulletproof glass—is truly the only vehicle of its kind on the road. Now, the story of how the fishbowl-esque automobile came to be is on display at the Vatican for visitors from around the world to see.
paras.zh: 教皇专车曾被教皇方济各称为“沙丁鱼罐头”，拥有巨大的圆顶和防弹玻璃，确实是路上唯一的同类车辆。现在，梵蒂冈正在向来自世界各地的游客展示这款鱼缸式汽车的诞生故事。

paras.en: “A Century of the Popemobile,” an exhibition which opened at the Vatican Museums on Thursday, features eight iterations of popemobiles spanning from 1930 to 2012, all designed by Mercedes-Benz. Versions of the popemobile made by other auto companies, like Land Rover, Fiat and Ferrari are not included in the collection.
paras.zh: 周四在梵蒂冈博物馆开幕的“教皇专车世纪”展览展出了从 1930 年到 2012 年的八辆教皇专车，全部由梅赛德斯-奔驰设计。其他汽车公司（如路虎、菲亚特和法拉利）生产的教皇专车版本不包括在该系列中。

paras.en: “Over the decades, the popemobile has evolved from a means of transportation into an instrument of encounter,” Pope Leo XIV told Mercedes-Benz executives in an address ahead of the exhibition’s official opening. “In this way, your work has helped facilitate the Church’s mission of reaching out to people and bringing a message of faith, of hope and of charity to the world.”
paras.zh: 教皇利奥十四世在展览正式开幕前的致辞中对梅赛德斯-奔驰高管表示：“几十年来，教皇专车已从一种交通工具演变为一种见面工具。” “通过这种方式，你们的工作有助于促进教会的使命，即向人们伸出援手，向世界传递信仰、希望和慈善的信息。”

paras.en: The oldest popemobile on display is a 460 Nürburg limousine gifted to Pope Pius XI in 1930. Unlike the hulking, glass popemobiles of today, this first custom-made model featured a black exterior and a red armchair upholstered in a silk brocade.
paras.zh: 展出的最古老的教皇专车是 1930 年赠送给教皇庇护十一世的 460 Nürburg 豪华轿车。与当今笨重的玻璃教皇专车不同，这辆定制车型采用黑色外观和丝绸织锦软垫的红色扶手椅。

paras.en: When Pius XI first took the 80-horsepower car for a spin around the Vatican Gardens, he reportedly cried out: “Beautiful car! A masterpiece … A wonder of modern technology!”
paras.zh: 据报道，当庇护十一世第一次驾驶这辆 80 马力的汽车绕梵蒂冈花园兜风时，他大喊道：“漂亮的汽车！杰作……现代技术的奇迹！”

paras.en: The 460 Nürburg and its immediate successors, however, tended to reside in the papal garage.
paras.zh: 然而，460 Nürburg 及其直接后继者往往停放在教皇车库中。

paras.en: “The popemobile didn’t become standard-issue for getting the pontiff through crowds until the late 1970s,” Danny Lewis wrote for Smithsonian magazine in 2015. “Historically, the pope traveled by way of an extravagant sedan chair carried atop the shoulders of a squad of uniformed footmen.”
paras.zh: “直到 20 世纪 70 年代末，教皇专车才成为载着教皇穿过人群的标准配备，”丹尼·刘易斯 (Danny Lewis) 2015 年为《史密森尼》杂志撰文。“从历史上看，教皇的出行方式是由一队穿着制服的仆人肩上扛着一辆奢华的轿子。”

paras.en: In order to allow the pope to engage with the faithful—and bless babies—from the confines of a car, automakers customized the vehicles to enhance the pope’s visibility and access to the external world.
paras.zh: 为了让教皇能够在车内与信徒互动并祝福婴儿，汽车制造商定制了车辆，以提高教皇的可见度和接触外部世界的机会。

paras.en: “The so‑called popemobile serves to allow people to see the pope, but also to allow him to see,” Sandro Barbagallo, curator of the Historical Collections Department at the Vatican Museums, tells Francesco Sportelli and Nicole Winfield of the Associated Press (AP). “It serves so that people can greet the pope, but also and above all so that the pope can, along the roads, greet and at the same time bless.”
paras.zh: 梵蒂冈博物馆历史收藏部馆长桑德罗·巴尔巴加洛 (Sandro Barbagallo) 告诉美联社 (AP) 的弗朗西斯科·斯波特利 (Francesco Sportelli) 和妮可·温菲尔德 (Nicole Winfield)：“所谓的教皇专车不仅可以让人们看到教皇，还可以让他看到。” “它的作用是让人们可以问候教皇，但最重要的是，让教皇可以沿着道路问候并同时祝福。”

paras.en: The first model to resemble the iconic modern design comes from 1980, a modified 230 G model with a large, glass dome in the back, allowing for congregants to see the pope as he passed. Popemobiles began incorporating bulletproof glass a year later, after an attempted assassination of Pope John Paul II while he was riding in an open-topped Fiat popemobile.
paras.zh: 第一个类似于标志性现代设计的型号来自 1980 年，是一款经过修改的 230 G 型号，后面有一个大型玻璃圆顶，让信徒可以在教皇经过时看到他。一年后，教皇约翰·保罗二世乘坐一辆敞篷菲亚特教皇专车遭到企图暗杀后，教皇专车开始采用防弹玻璃。

paras.en: Designing papal automobiles comes with manifold security considerations. “It has to be safely conceived and executed in terms of the current modern risks you face if you are in big crowds,” Marcus Breitschwerdt, executive vice president of Mercedes-Benz and chief executive of Mercedes-Benz Heritage, tells EWTN News’ Ishmael Abiduah. “So we have armored versions; we have the secured glass popemobiles, which are very, very sophisticated.”
paras.zh: 设计教皇汽车需要考虑多种安全因素。梅赛德斯-奔驰执行副总裁兼梅赛德斯-奔驰 Heritage 首席执行官马库斯·布赖特施韦特 (Marcus Breitschwerdt) 告诉 EWTN 新闻的伊斯梅尔·阿比杜阿 (Ishmael Abiduah)：“如果身处人群众多，就必须安全地构思和执行，以应对当前面临的现代风险。” “所以我们有装甲版本；我们有安全的玻璃教皇专车，它们非常非常复杂。”

paras.en: The exhibit also features a 1960 300D Landaulet with removable side windows built for Pope John XXIII, a 1997 “lungo” Landaulet featuring an electrohydraulic soft top designed for Pope John Paul II and Pope Benedict XVI’s 2012 ML 500, a behemoth with a large, enclosed glass rear, per Agence France-Presse.
paras.zh: 据法新社报道，此次展览还展示了一辆 1960 年 300D Landaulet，带有为教皇约翰二十三世设计的可拆卸侧窗，一辆 1997 年“lungo”Landaulet，配备专为教皇约翰·保罗二世和教皇本笃十六世设计的电动液压软顶，2012 年 ML 500 是一款带有大型封闭式玻璃后部的庞然大物。

paras.en: When Pope Francis visited the United States in 2015, he rode around Washington, D.C., New York and Philadelphia in a tricked out Jeep Wrangler with open sides and rear seating.
paras.zh: 2015 年，教皇方济各访问美国时，他驾驶一辆两侧和后座均开放的改装吉普牧马人，游览了华盛顿特区、纽约和费城。

paras.en: “[The popemobile] was specifically built, designed and prepared for papal use, so much so that just by comparing it, you can see how it transitions from the serial to the unique,” Barbagallo tells the AP.
paras.zh: “[教皇专车]是专门为教皇使用而建造、设计和准备的，以至于只要通过比较它，你就可以看到它是如何从连续剧过渡到独特的，”巴尔巴加洛告诉美联社。

paras.en: The popemobile has also reflected the distinct preferences of the popes themselves. In 2024, Mercedes-Benz gifted the environmentally minded Pope Francis the first electric car in the popemobile fleet.
paras.zh: 教皇专车也反映了教皇本身的独特喜好。 2024 年，梅赛德斯-奔驰向具有环保意识的教皇方济各赠送了教皇专车车队中的第一辆电动汽车。

paras.en: In fact, Pope Leo XIV referenced this gift, and Pope Francis’ call to make the automotive sector more sustainable, in his address to the Mercedes-Benz executives: “In this spirit, I encourage you to continue placing technological innovation at the service of human dignity, care for creation and the common good.”
paras.zh: 事实上，教皇利奥十四世在对梅赛德斯-奔驰高管的讲话中提到了这份礼物，以及教皇方济各关于使汽车行业更具可持续性的呼吁：“本着这种精神，我鼓励你们继续将技术创新服务于人类尊严、关心创造和共同利益。”

paras.en: “A Century of the Popemobile” is on view at the Vatican Museums.
paras.zh: 梵蒂冈博物馆正在展出“教皇专车的一个世纪”。

articles.title: The Hollywood Color Nerd Who Shot ‘Knives Out’ Explains His Viral iPhone Camera App
articles.author: Reece Rogers

paras.en: Steve Yedlin is a certified color nerd. He almost immediately starts explaining “the math” behind his passion for color science.
paras.zh: 史蒂夫·耶德林（Steve Yedlin）是一位经过认证的色彩迷。他几乎立即开始解释他对色彩科学的热情背后的“数学”。

paras.en: But I didn’t call to chat about psychophysics or color theory. I called to talk to Yedlin about his Chromagraph Camera app, newly released, virally popular, and available only on the iPhone.
paras.zh: 但我打电话并不是想聊心理物理学或色彩理论。我打电话与 Yedlin 讨论他的 Chromagraph Camera 应用程序，该应用程序新发布、广受欢迎，并且仅在 iPhone 上可用。

paras.en: Yedlin is a longtime collaborator with director Rian Johnson, shooting his films like Knives Out and Star Wars: The Last Jedi. The duo teamed up again for this launch. “I write all of my own image processing that we use on the movies,” he says. The Chromagraph Camera app brings a taste of Yedlin’s special sauce to your smartphone camera.
paras.zh: 耶德林是导演莱恩·约翰逊的长期合作者，拍摄了《利刃出鞘》和《星球大战：最后的绝地武士》等电影。此次发布会，两人再度联手。 “我们在电影中使用的所有图像处理都是我自己编写的，”他说。 Chromagraph 相机应用程序将 Yedlin 的特殊酱料带到您的智能手机相机中。

paras.en: Instead of the iPhone’s built-in image processing, this app shoots RAW image data and processes it with a similar formula to what he uses in film production. After Johnson promoted Chromagraph Camera on social media in late October, it quickly became the top paid download in the iOS store. The app costs a one-time fee of $13 and only shoots still photos. (There’s no video support yet.)
paras.zh: 该应用程序没有使用 iPhone 的内置图像处理功能，而是拍摄 RAW 图像数据，并使用与电影制作中类似的公式进行处理。约翰逊于 10 月下旬在社交媒体上推广 Chromagraph Camera 后，迅速成为 iOS 商店付费下载榜首。该应用程序一次性收费 13 美元，并且只能拍摄静态照片。 （尚不支持视频。）

paras.en: I am far from the resident photography nerd on WIRED’s gear team. (That award goes, in part, to my wonderful editor, Julian.) I’m often just whipping out my iPhone and snapping a picture with the default settings. Even so, I really enjoyed capturing some of San Francisco’s fall vibes using the Chromagraph Camera. Although Apple gives iPhone owners plenty of built-in tools for adjusting the color on your own images, I loved this app’s ability to capture highly stylized shots without me needing to fiddle with anything at all.
paras.zh: 我与《连线》装备团队中的常驻摄影迷相去甚远。 （这个奖项部分归功于我出色的编辑朱利安。）我经常只是拿出我的 iPhone，用默认设置拍一张照片。即便如此，我真的很喜欢使用 Chromagraph 相机捕捉旧金山的一些秋天氛围。尽管 Apple 为 iPhone 用户提供了大量内置工具来调整自己图像的颜色，但我喜欢这个应用程序能够捕捉高度风格化的照片，而无需我摆弄任何东西。

paras.en: When you open the app, what you see in the viewfinder before snapping the shot is not what the Chromagraph Camera will spit out. The photo is essentially “developed” in the app after you capture the image. This is because the app needs a moment to run its unique processing for the specific tone, color, and grain effects. You can also alter how an image looks in the app after it’s processed, if you want to tweak the overall exposure or texture of an image.
paras.zh: 当您打开应用程序时，您在拍照之前在取景器中看到的内容并不是 Chromagraph 相机会吐出的内容。照片本质上是在您拍摄图像后在应用程序中“冲洗”的。这是因为该应用程序需要一些时间来运行其针对特定色调、颜色和颗粒效果的独特处理。如果您想调整图像的整体曝光或纹理，您还可以更改图像处理后在应用程序中的外观。

paras.en: Yedlin is adamant that he’s not attempting to replace your iPhone camera app or release a professional tool for editing everything. It’s all about that color, man. “It's just this curated app that takes the pictures the way we like,” he says. Yedlin and Johnson teamed up with programmer Eric Cameron to build the app centered around their color tastes, experimenting with it for a couple of months before launch.
paras.zh: 耶德林坚称，他并不是试图取代你的 iPhone 相机应用程序或发布一个用于编辑所有内容的专业工具。这都是关于那个颜色的，伙计。 “正是这个精心设计的应用程序可以按照我们喜欢的方式拍摄照片，”他说。耶德林和约翰逊与程序员埃里克·卡梅伦合作，围绕他们的色彩品味构建了这款应用程序，并在发布前进行了几个月的试验。

paras.en: Even after all of this custom image processing, Yedlin still sees the iPhone as a fundamentally limited device. “This idea that you can actually have the control that a professional camera would have is not really true anyhow,” he says. Software can only do so much to change how hardware works, especially when developing an app within Apple’s parameters that limit how far the software can push the phone’s hardware.
paras.zh: 即使在完成所有这些自定义图像处理之后，Yedlin 仍然认为 iPhone 从根本上来说是一种受限的设备。 “这种认为你实际上可以拥有专业相机所拥有的控制能力的想法无论如何都是不正确的，”他说。软件对改变硬件工作方式的作用有限，尤其是在苹果的参数范围内开发应用程序时，这些参数限制了软件对手机硬件的推动程度。

paras.en: As advances in computational photography and generative AI have renewed discussions about what a smartphone photo even is anymore, Yedlin’s approach isn't an attempt to find a sense of neutrality. He doesn’t see any image as a literal rendering of what exists. It’s always an interpretation, whether that's a stylized, artful depiction or a more stagnant shot. He says that the look of the Chromagraph Camera app is consciously “opinionated” and specific.
paras.zh: 随着计算摄影和生成人工智能的进步重新引发了关于智能手机照片是什么的讨论，耶德林的方法并不是试图寻找中立感。他不认为任何图像都是对存在事物的字面呈现。它始终是一种诠释，无论是风格化、巧妙的描绘还是更加停滞的镜头。他说 Chromagraph Camera 应用程序的外观是有意识地“固执己见”且具体的。

paras.en: “You can describe how the different rendering looks in words, but you just have to look at it,” he says. The color speaks for itself.
paras.zh: “你可以用文字描述不同的渲染效果，但你只需要看看它，”他说。颜色不言而喻。

articles.title: There’s a Free Video Editor Inside Google Drive That Anyone Can Use
articles.author: David Nield

paras.en: Mention the online apps available as part of Google Workspace, and most people will immediately think of Google Drive, Gmail, Google Docs, Google Sheets, and Google Slides—those speedy, lightweight office apps that let you get work done from any browser tab.
paras.zh: 提到 Google Workspace 中提供的在线应用程序，大多数人会立即想到 Google 云端硬盘、Gmail、Google 文档、Google 表格和 Google 幻灯片 - 这些快速、轻量级的办公应用程序可让您从任何浏览器选项卡完成工作。

paras.en: There's more to the suite of Google Workspace tools than you might have realized though, including an online video editing package called Google Vids. Originally launched in 2024 for business and enterprise users, the app was made available to individuals in 2026 and continues to get regular updates from Google.
paras.zh: Google Workspace 工具套件的功能超出您的想象，其中包括名为 Google Vids 的在线视频编辑软件包。该应用最初于 2024 年面向商业和企业用户推出，于 2026 年向个人提供，并继续从 Google 获得定期更新。

paras.en: Since it's both free to use and designed to run in a web browser, it's not capable of pro-level, high-resolution, multitrack video editing. But for personal and hobbyist use, it works well, and it won't take you long to learn the basics.
paras.zh: 由于它既可以免费使用，又可以在网络浏览器中运行，因此它不具备专业级、高分辨率、多轨视频编辑功能。但对于个人和业余爱好者来说，它效果很好，并且不需要很长时间即可学习基础知识。

paras.en: Finding Google Vids isn't difficult: You can either open Google Drive on the web, then click New and Google Vids, or head straight to the Google Vids app page and click the + (plus) button under Start a new video. (Any videos you've previously made are shown here, too.)
paras.zh: 查找 Google Vids 并不困难：您可以在网络上打开 Google Drive，然后单击“新建”和“Google Vids”，或者直接前往 Google Vids 应用程序页面并单击“开始新视频”下的 +（加号）按钮。 （您之前制作的所有视频也会显示在此处。）

paras.en: Besides beginning with a clean state (the Blank vid option), there are plenty of other ways to get started: You can generate AI videos with the Veo 3.1 model, turn a slideshow into a video, work from a template, upload an existing video as a starting point, create an AI music track, record a video using your camera, produce a video with an AI avatar, or create a storyboard outline. Note you can also pick the video orientation at the top.
paras.zh: 除了从干净的状态（空白视频选项）开始之外，还有很多其他方法可以开始：您可以使用 Veo 3.1 模型生成 AI 视频、将幻灯片转换为视频、从模板工作、上传现有视频作为起点、创建 AI 音乐曲目、使用相机录制视频、使用 AI 头像生成视频或创建故事板大纲。请注意，您还可以在顶部选择视频方向。

paras.en: Most of these options use a similar layout, and we're going to focus on the traditional video-making approach here—though the AI options are well worth exploring, too, if you don't have source material to work with. If you're new to Google Vids, then picking Templates from the opening splash screen will ease you in gently.
paras.zh: 这些选项中的大多数都使用类似的布局，我们将在这里重点关注传统的视频制作方法——尽管如果您没有可用的源材料，人工智能选项也非常值得探索。如果您是 Google Vids 的新手，那么从打开的初始屏幕中选择“模板”将让您轻松上手。

paras.en: When it comes to picking a template, the topic isn't as important as the layout. Look for something that matches what you want to create as closely as possible (hover over any of the thumbnails to see an animated preview). The next dialog lets you choose whether you want to use the entire template or just selected scenes. After that, you're into the video editing interface proper.
paras.zh: 在选择模板时，主题并不像布局那么重要。寻找与您想要创建的内容尽可能匹配的内容（将鼠标悬停在任何缩略图上以查看动画预览）。下一个对话框允许您选择是要使用整个模板还是仅使用选定的场景。之后，您就进入了视频编辑界面。

paras.en: Most of the elements should be relatively familiar if you've ever used a timeline-based video editor in the past. At the bottom you've got your video and audio tracks, while the main window shows the currently selected segment of your video. The panel on the right lets you edit whatever's currently selected.
paras.zh: 如果您过去曾经使用过基于时间线的视频编辑器，那么大多数元素应该相对熟悉。在底部，您可以看到视频和音轨，而主窗口则显示当前选定的视频片段。右侧的面板可让您编辑当前选择的内容。

paras.en: Down the right side of the interface you've got all the options for loading in new content. You can record webcam clips, create AI videos, import footage from Google Drive and Google Photos, add voiceovers, and drop in text, images, music, and shapes. If you've started with a template, some of these elements will be styled to match.
paras.zh: 在界面的右侧，您可以找到加载新内容的所有选项。您可以录制网络摄像头剪辑、创建 AI 视频、从 Google 云端硬盘和 Google 照片导入素材、添加画外音以及插入文本、图像、音乐和形状。如果您已经开始使用模板，其中一些元素的样式将进行匹配。

paras.en: Along the top of the Google Vids interface are more editing and formatting tools. These menus are where you should head to change transitions between scenes, to manage how elements are arranged in a particular scene, to drop in new scenes, and to manage your video project as a whole.
paras.zh: Google Vids 界面的顶部有更多编辑和格式化工具。您应该在这些菜单中更改场景之间的过渡、管理元素在特定场景中的排列方式、放入新场景以及管理整个视频项目。

paras.en: Building Video Projects With Google Vids
paras.zh: 使用 Google Vids 构建视频项目

paras.en: To begin building your projects, you'll probably want to load in audio, video, and images via the buttons on the right. On the most basic level, you can click the + (plus) button on the timeline to create a new scene, then drag in a photo or video from the right-hand panel to fill the scene you've just created.
paras.zh: 要开始构建项目，您可能需要通过右侧的按钮加载音频、视频和图像。在最基本的层面上，您可以单击时间轴上的 +（加号）按钮来创建新场景，然后从右侧面板中拖入照片或视频以填充刚刚创建的场景。

paras.en: A whole host of options present themselves when you right-click on the timeline. You can, for example, mute the audio track imported with a video, then add a voiceover or some different music. You're also able to split scenes (if you only want to keep half a scene maybe) and duplicate scenes (for quickly expanding the running time of your project) with a right-click.
paras.zh: 当您右键单击时间轴时，会出现大量选项。例如，您可以将随视频导入的音轨静音，然后添加画外音或一些不同的音乐。您还可以通过右键单击来分割场景（如果您只想保留半个场景）和复制场景（以快速扩展项目的运行时间）。

paras.en: Keep your eye on the panel on the right, which changes depending on the context. With audio tracks, you can apply fades, and with video clips you can choose from different transitions. If your scene has several elements (like shapes that scroll over a video), you're able to adjust how they look and behave.
paras.zh: 请注意右侧的面板，该面板会根据上下文而变化。对于音轨，您可以应用淡入淡出，对于视频剪辑，您可以从不同的过渡中进行选择。如果您的场景有多个元素（例如在视频上滚动的形状），您可以调整它们的外观和行为。

paras.en: Let's say you have a video scene and want to put some text over it. Select the scene in the timeline, click the Text button on the right, then click Add a title to do just that. If you then select the title in the scene itself, you can change the text and its styling.
paras.zh: 假设您有一个视频场景并想在其上添加一些文本。选择时间线中的场景，单击右侧的“文本”按钮，然后单击“添加标题”即可完成此操作。如果您随后在场景本身中选择标题，则可以更改文本及其样式。

paras.en: Using the handles around the text box you can change its position, size, and rotation. There are also three buttons underneath on a floating toolbar: Animation lets you animate the text, Resize will resize the text box to fit the text you've entered, and Format options brings up a panel where you can change text size, padding, rotation, and so on.
paras.zh: 使用文本框周围的手柄可以更改其位置、大小和旋转。浮动工具栏下方还有三个按钮：“动画”可让您对文本进行动画处理，“调整大小”将调整文本框的大小以适合您输入的文本，“格式”选项会显示一个面板，您可以在其中更改文本大小、填充、旋转等。

paras.en: Click and drag on elements inside a scene to reposition them, and right-click for more options—including Cut, Copy, Paste, and Delete. If you need more material to work with, choose the Stock option on the right, which gives you a library of material you can make use of in addition to your own content and anything created with AI.
paras.zh: 单击并拖动场景内的元素以重新定位它们，然后右键单击以获取更多选项，包括剪切、复制、粘贴和删除。如果您需要使用更多材料，请选择右侧的“库存”选项，它为您提供了一个材料库，除了您自己的内容和使用 AI 创建的任何内容之外，您还可以使用该材料库。

paras.en: There's a lot more to Google Vids, but that should be enough to get you started—try experimenting with a few of the templates to see what else is possible. As with the other Google Drive apps, all your edits are saved instantly, and up in the top right corner you've got a Play button for viewing your work in progress, and a Share button for when it’s ready for the world to see.
paras.zh: Google 视频还有很多内容，但这应该足以让您入门 - 尝试使用一些模板进行试验，看看还有什么可能。与其他 Google 云端硬盘应用程序一样，您的所有编辑都会立即保存，右上角有一个“播放”按钮，用于查看正在进行的工作，还有一个“共享”按钮，可供全世界查看。

articles.title: The 30 Best Gifts for Star Wars Fans (2026)
articles.author: Simon Hill

paras.en: I have received many, many Star Wars gifts over the years. I spent the first Christmas Day that I can remember flying Luke and his X-wing around the house. I met Darth Vader (David Prowse) when I was 6. I can still feel the shiver of fear as he strode through the double doors, reaching over the crowd to shake hands with me as my dad held me up. I never questioned why the Dark Lord of the Sith was in Woolworth’s.
paras.zh: 这些年来我收到了很多很多星球大战礼物。我度过了我记忆中的第一个圣诞节，驾驶着卢克和他的 X 翼飞机在房子里绕来绕去。我六岁的时候遇到了达斯·维德（大卫·普劳斯饰）。当他大步穿过双扇门、越过人群与我握手、而我爸爸抱着我时，我仍然能感受到恐惧的颤抖。我从来没有质疑过为什么西斯黑魔王会出现在伍尔沃斯店里。

paras.en: When I became a dad, I had a fresh excuse to visit that galaxy far, far away and buy new toys. (I still regret selling my own in a garage sale to raise funds for our first home.) My wife and I love the original movies, and our kids prefer the prequel trilogy, but we all enjoyed watching the latest shows together. And because just about everyone knows I’m a fan, and I have received (and given) countless Star Wars gifts over the years. These are some of my favorites.
paras.zh: 当我成为一名父亲后，我有了一个新的借口去遥远的银河系买新玩具。 （我仍然后悔在车库拍卖中卖掉自己的房子来为我们的第一个家筹集资金。）我和我的妻子喜欢原版电影，我们的孩子更喜欢前传三部曲，但我们都喜欢一起观看最新的节目。因为几乎每个人都知道我是粉丝，多年来我收到（并赠送）了无数的星球大战礼物。这些是我最喜欢的一些。

paras.en: For more recommendations, check out my picks for The Best Gifts for Lego Fans, Best STEM Gifts for Kids, and Best Gifts Under $25.
paras.zh: 如需更多推荐，请查看我精选的“给乐高迷的最佳礼物”、“给孩子的最佳 STEM 礼物”和“25 美元以下的最佳礼物”。

paras.en: Updated November 2026: I added a marble run, a jigsaw puzzle, and an advent calendar. I also updated prices throughout.
paras.zh: 2026 年 11 月更新：我添加了弹珠跑、拼图游戏和降临节日历。我还全程更新了价格。

paras.en: - A Helmet Hasbro’s Black Series of Star Wars helmets strikes the right balance between quality and price. They look good enough to satisfy collectors but come cheaper than high-end movie replicas. My favorite is the sadly discontinued original battered Boba Fett helmet. You can still find it or the newer re-armored version if you're prepared to pay an inflated bounty. Many other Black Series helmets, including Vader and various Troopers, are also excellent and still available.
paras.zh: - 头盔孩之宝的黑色系列星球大战头盔在质量和价格之间取得了适当的平衡。它们看起来足以满足收藏家的需求，但价格却比高端电影复制品便宜。我最喜欢的是不幸停产的原始破旧波巴·费特头盔。如果您准备支付高额赏金，您仍然可以找到它或更新的重装版本。许多其他黑色系列头盔，包括维德和各种士兵，也很出色并且仍然可用。

paras.en: - A Lego Set I have spent many hours building Star Wars Lego sets with my kids, and nothing compares to the Death Star (if you’re looking to push the boat out), but you may also want to check out one of the new Smart Brick sets. While it’s not perfect and lacks authentic Star Wars sound effects, I did have fun with the Star Wars Smart Play Throne Room Duel and A-Wing set. Recreating the iconic final light saber battle in Star Wars: Return of the Jedi, as Emperor Palpatine sits on his throne, watching Darth Vader and Luke Skywalker fight, with light saber swooshes as a synth version of “The Imperial March” plays, will put a smile on any fan’s face.
paras.zh: - 乐高套装我花了很多时间和我的孩子们一起搭建星球大战乐高套装，没有什么能与死星相比（如果你想把船推出去），但你可能还想看看其中一套新的智能积木套装。虽然它并不完美并且缺乏真实的星球大战音效，但我确实对星球大战智能游戏王座决斗和 A-Wing 套装感到很有趣。重现《星球大战：绝地归来》中标志性的最终光剑之战，帕尔帕廷皇帝坐在王座上，观看达斯·维德和卢克·天行者战斗，随着合成版本的“帝国进行曲”的演奏，光剑嗖嗖地响，这会让任何粉丝脸上露出笑容。

paras.en: - Darth Darts If the Star Wars fan in your life also enjoys darts, you’ve just hit the mother lode. Target Darts has a Star Wars-themed line, and my top pick is this stylish set of Darth Vader darts. These tungsten steel-tipped beauties come in three weights with molded grippy barrels and black imperial flights. The zippy Darth case contains a spare set of red flights and tools. You can also get Darth Maul, Stormtrooper, and R2-D2-themed cases and flights, and Target Darts just released new themed sets of Mandalorian ($380) and AT-AT ($170) darts, and Grogu ($55) and Mandalorian ($55) cases. And don’t forget the Star Wars Millennium Falcon Surround and Dartboard ($200), which I tested with Target's Omni Auto Scoring System.
paras.zh: - 达斯飞镖 如果您生活中的星球大战迷也喜欢飞镖，那么您就已经找到了母脉。 Target Darts 有一个星球大战主题系列，我的首选是这套时尚的达斯·维达飞镖。这些美丽的钨钢头有三种重量，配有模制的握力枪管和黑色帝国螺纹。活泼的达斯箱包含一套备用的红色航班和工具。您还可以获得 Darth Maul、Stormtrooper 和 R2-D2 主题的箱子和飞行器，Target Darts 刚刚发布了新的主题套装曼达洛人 (380 美元) 和 AT-AT (170 美元) 飞镖，以及 Grogu (55 美元) 和曼达洛人 (55 美元) 箱子。不要忘记星球大战千年隼环绕和飞镖（200 美元），我使用 Target 的 Omni 自动评分系统对其进行了测试。

paras.en: - A Metallic Print If you’re unfamiliar, Displates are metallic artworks with a clever magnetic mount system that makes it quick and easy to switch your prints when you want a change. The artwork is layered and textured with gloss varnish on the details, and this one, released for the 20th anniversary of Revenge of the Sith, depicts Darth, flanked by Clone Troopers, with Anakin and Obi-Wan duelling on Mustafar in the foreground. If you don’t like this particular print, Displate has an enormous Star Wars section to browse.
paras.zh: - 金属印刷品如果您不熟悉，盘子是金属艺术品，具有巧妙的磁性安装系统，可让您在需要更改时快速轻松地切换印刷品。这幅艺术作品的细节层次分明，有光泽清漆，这幅作品是为《西斯的复仇》20 周年而发行的，描绘了达斯，两侧是克隆人士兵，前景是阿纳金和欧比旺在穆斯塔法上决斗。如果你不喜欢这种特殊的印刷品，Displate 有一个巨大的星球大战部分可供浏览。

paras.en: - A Lightsaber Any aspiring Jedi or Sith needs a lightsaber. If you want a high-quality replica that’s right for you, be prepared to research. I tried a Combat Saber from Padawan Outpost, Model Vader E6 (Xenopixel), inspired by Darth’s lightsaber from Episode VI: Return of the Jedi. There is a learning curve, but this lightsaber really looks and feels the part. You can change the color, trigger countless sound effects, and even play music. There’s also an app, so you can connect to the saber from your phone and tweak the settings. No worries if you’re not a fan of Vader, because the Outpost offers a wide range of realistic lightsabers (check here if you’re in the UK) based on those wielded in the movies and shows by everyone from Obi-Wan to Count Dooku. WIRED readers can get a 5 percent discount with the code WIRED5.
paras.zh: - 光剑任何有抱负的绝地或西斯都需要一把光剑。如果您想要一个适合您的高品质复制品，请准备好进行研究。我尝试了 Padawan Outpost 的战斗军刀，型号 Vader E6 (Xenopixel)，其灵感来自《第六集：绝地归来》中达斯的光剑。虽然有一个学习曲线，但这把光剑的外观和感觉确实很适合这个部分。你可以改变颜色，触发无数的音效，甚至播放音乐。还有一个应用程序，因此您可以从手机连接到 Saber 并调整设置。如果您不是维达的粉丝，也不用担心，因为前哨站提供了各种逼真的光剑（如果您在英国，请查看此处），这些光剑是根据从欧比旺到杜库伯爵等所有人在电影和节目中使用的光剑而设计的。 WIRED 读者可以使用代码 WIRED5 获得 5% 的折扣。

paras.en: - A Marble Run Marble runs are universally popular with kids (mine loved them when they were younger), and this Star Wars-themed one is part of the GraviTrax series. Kids can get creative when they construct it, building different types of runs with X-Wings, Tie Fighters, a Star Destroyer, and the Millennium Falcon—all on a Death Star board. They can also potentially connect it to other GraviTrax sets.
paras.zh: - 弹珠跑 弹珠跑普遍受到孩子们的欢迎（我小时候很喜欢弹珠跑），而这个星球大战主题的弹珠跑是 GraviTrax 系列的一部分。孩子们在建造它时可以发挥创造力，用 X 翼、领带战斗机、歼星舰和千年隼建造不同类型的跑道——所有这些都在死星板上。他们还可以将其连接到其他 GraviTrax 装置。

paras.en: - An Arcade Machine I spent an entire summer as a kid in an Atari Star Wars cockpit cabin at my local arcade, reliving the climax of the movie in wire-frame form as I blasted TIE Fighters, sped through the Death Star trench, and timed proton torpedoes to blow it up. That 1983 release is bundled with The Empire Strikes Back (1985) and Return of the Jedi (1984) games in this ROTJ-styled arcade cabinet. It takes some building and feels a little cheap, but it does include the original yoke flight controls, and it’s still very fun to play. Just make sure your giftee has room for it, as it’s 61.5 inches tall, 19 inches wide, and 24 inches deep.
paras.zh: - 一台街机 当我还是个孩子的时候，我在当地游乐场的雅达利星球大战驾驶舱里度过了整个夏天，以线框形式重温了电影的高潮，我炸毁了钛战机，加速穿过死星战壕，并定时质子鱼雷将其炸毁。 1983 年发行的这款 ROTJ 风格街机柜中与《帝国反击战》（1985 年）和《绝地归来》（1984 年）游戏捆绑在一起。它需要一些建造，感觉有点便宜，但它确实包括原始的操纵杆飞行控制，而且玩起来仍然很有趣。只需确保您的礼品接收者有足够的空间，因为它高 61.5 英寸、宽 19 英寸、深 24 英寸。

paras.en: - A Phone Case A Darth Vader phone case will go down well with most Star Wars-loving dads, and this range from Casetify features some excellent Galactic Empire designs. My wife and kids have been using Casetify cases with a mix of iPhones and Pixels for over a year, and we find them durable and protective, if a little chunky. Unfortunately, it’s not just the Star Wars designs that are on the dark side; these cases are also pricey.
paras.zh: - 手机壳 达斯·维达 (Darth Vader) 手机壳会很适合大多数热爱星球大战的爸爸，Casetify 的这款手机壳采用了一些出色的银河帝国设计。我的妻子和孩子已经使用 Casetify 保护壳混合 iPhone 和 Pixel 一年多了，我们发现它们耐用且具有保护性，尽管有点厚重。不幸的是，不仅仅是《星球大战》的设计是黑暗的一面，它也是如此。这些案例也很昂贵。

paras.en: - A Book Of the many excellent books about Star Wars, this might be my favorite. It charts the rise of the franchise, offers countless nuggets of trivia, and acknowledges the role fans have played in making Star Wars so special. It's an entertaining peek behind the scenes that is affectionate but also dares to be critical. Perhaps mercifully, it ends with the new trilogy still on the horizon.
paras.zh: - 一本书 在关于星球大战的许多优秀书籍中，这可能是我最喜欢的。它描绘了该系列的崛起，提供了无数的琐事，并承认粉丝在使《星球大战》如此特别的过程中所发挥的作用。这是一次充满深情但也敢于批评的有趣的幕后一瞥。也许幸运的是，它以新三部曲仍然在地平线上结束。

paras.en: - An Apron It’s way too easy to get messy when cooking, which is why aprons exist. Respected apron purveyor Hedley & Bennett makes some top-quality aprons, and it has a Star Wars line. I tried the Darth Vader Essential Apron (a great gift for dads), and my wife tried the Ahsoka Tano Crossback Apron. We love them. The thoughtful designs include lots of wee Star Wars character references (there are eight options). Mine has an adjustable neck strap, while the Crossback goes over your shoulders. Both are comfy, with lengthy straps to tie and three pockets. Made from protective cotton canvas, these aprons can be machine-washed cold.
paras.zh: - 围裙 做饭时很容易弄脏，这就是围裙存在的原因。受人尊敬的围裙供应商 Hedley & Bennett 生产一些顶级品质的围裙，并且拥有星球大战系列。我尝试了 Darth Vader Essential 围裙（送给爸爸的绝佳礼物），我的妻子尝试了 Ahsoka Tano Crossback 围裙。我们爱他们。深思熟虑的设计包括许多星球大战的小人物参考（有八个选项）。我的有一个可调节的颈带，而 Crossback 则可以套在你的肩膀上。两者都很舒适，配有长带子和三个口袋。这些围裙由防护棉帆布制成，可以冷水机洗。

paras.en: - A Board Game This beautifully themed spin-off of the Villainous series challenges players to take on the role of a Star Wars baddie. You can play as Darth Vader, Kylo Ren, General Grievous, Asajj Ventress, or Moff Gideon. Each has unique abilities and a specific set of victory conditions, and there are chances to meddle with your foes as the game unfolds. One of the best family board games, it works best with four players aged 10 years and up.
paras.zh: - 棋盘游戏 这款主题精美的恶棍系列衍生游戏挑战玩家扮演星球大战坏人的角色。您可以扮演达斯·维达、凯洛·伦、格里弗斯将军、阿萨吉·文崔斯或星区总督吉迪恩。每个人都有独特的能力和一组特定的胜利条件，并且随着游戏的展开，有机会干扰你的敌人。它是最好的家庭棋盘游戏之一，最适合四名 10 岁及以上的玩家。

paras.en: - Action Figures Kenner sold over 300 million Star Wars action figures in the late ’70s and early ’80s. I spent every penny of my pocket money on them for years, and there’s a roaring trade in secondhand figures. When Hasbro realized its potential, it started making new figures under the Kenner brand, and there are three main lines today. The Retro Collection is all 3.75-inch figures like the originals Kenner sold, with a peg hole in the bottom of their feet and legs that don’t bend. The Vintage Collection figures are the same size but with more detail and bendable limbs. The Black Series figures are larger, at around 6 inches tall, and tend to be much more detailed.
paras.zh: - 可动人偶 Kenner 在 70 年代末和 80 年代初售出了超过 3 亿个星球大战可动人偶。多年来我把零用钱的每一分钱都花在了它们上，而且二手玩偶的交易也非常猖獗。当孩之宝（Hasbro）意识到其潜力后，开始以肯纳（Kenner）品牌制作新的玩偶，如今共有三个主线。复古系列全部是 3.75 英寸的人物，与 Kenner 出售的原版人物一样，脚底和腿部有一个钉孔，不会弯曲。复古系列人物尺寸相同，但细节更多，四肢可弯曲。黑色系列人偶较大，高约 6 英寸，而且往往更加细致。

paras.en: - An Ornament Based on the three wise monkeys and the Confucian maxim “See no evil, hear no evil, speak no evil,” this trio of ornamental stormtroopers is a great gift for Star Wars fans. One of mine took a tumble and broke both his legs, but after a quick superglue treatment, he made a full recovery. I advise putting them out of reach of young kids and cats.
paras.zh: - 以三只聪明的猴子和儒家格言“非礼勿视，非礼勿听，非礼勿言”为基础的装饰品，这三只装饰冲锋队是送给星球大战粉丝的绝佳礼物。我的一个人摔倒了，摔断了双腿，但经过快速强力胶治疗后，他完全康复了。我建议将它们放在小孩和猫接触不到的地方。

paras.en: - A Jigsaw Puzzle This challenging 2,000-piece puzzle packs in more than 60 characters from the Star Wars universe (some appear twice), with a starship-filled space battle backdrop. It’s a fun activity for fans of any age, but expect to take a few days assembling it. The finished jigsaw is huge, measuring 39 x 30 inches, so make sure you've got a proper table for the job.
paras.zh: - 拼图这款具有挑战性的 2,000 块拼图包含来自星球大战宇宙的 60 多个角色（有些角色出现两次），并以充满星舰的太空战斗为背景。对于任何年龄段的粉丝来说，这都是一项有趣的活动，但需要花费几天的时间来组装。成品拼图非常巨大，尺寸为 39 x 30 英寸，因此请确保您有一张合适的桌子来完成这项工作。

articles.title: Watch: Tom Hanks returns as David S. Pumpkins for Halloween 'SNL'

paras.en: Nov. 1 (UPI) -- Oscar-winning actor Tom Hanks revived his creepy Halloween character David S. Pumpkins for this weekend's edition of Saturday Night Live.
paras.zh: 11 月 1 日（UPI）——奥斯卡获奖演员汤姆·汉克斯 (Tom Hanks) 在本周末的《周六夜现场》中复活了他令人毛骨悚然的万圣节角色大卫·S·南瓜 (David S. Pumpkins)。

paras.en: Wearing his trademark jack o'lantern suit and flanked by dancing skeletons played by Mikey Day and Bobby Moynihan, Pumpkins popped out at a couple (Jeremy Culhane and Grace Reiter) enjoying a horror ride.
paras.zh: 穿着他标志性的南瓜灯套装，两侧是米奇·戴和鲍比·莫伊尼汉扮演的跳舞骷髅，南瓜突然出现在一对正在享受恐怖之旅的情侣（杰里米·卡尔哈恩和格蕾丝·瑞特饰）面前。

paras.en: James Austin Johnson then interrupted the sketch to do his U.S. President Donald Trump impression, comparing himself to Pumpkins and reminding people to vote in Tuesday's mid-term elections.
paras.zh: 詹姆斯·奥斯汀·约翰逊随后打断了小品，以表现他对美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的印象，将自己比作南瓜，并提醒人们在周二的中期选举中投票。

paras.en: "He keeps popping up and confusing the people on the ride. But, you know, I actually have a lot in common with Mr. Pumpkins. We both appeared in 2016. We're both very loud, very orange, and very, frankly, annoying," he said.
paras.zh: “他不断地出现，让骑行中的人们感到困惑。但是，你知道，我实际上和南瓜先生有很多共同点。我们都是 2016 年出现的。我们都非常吵闹，非常橙色，而且坦率地说，非常烦人，”他说。

paras.en: "But we love Tom Hanks. Look at him back there. Good acting, great ass. It's a great ass on Hanks. That's something I've been doing lately -- admiring men's asses. Not that there's anything wrong with that, just that I might be gay. They're calling it gay dementia. Dementia, short for 'da men should' show me their butts."
paras.zh: “但我们爱汤姆·汉克斯。看看他后面的样子。演技很好，屁股很棒。汉克斯的屁股很棒。这是我最近一直在做的事情——欣赏男人的屁股。这并不是说有什么问题，只是我可能是同性恋。他们称之为同性恋痴呆症。痴呆症是‘男人应该’向我展示他们的屁股的缩写。”

paras.en: The clip has already gotten 1.4 million views on YouTube.
paras.zh: 该视频在 YouTube 上的观看次数已达 140 万次。

articles.title: Director Michael Mann OK after shooting mishap at gun range

paras.en: Nov. 1 (UPI) -- Manhunter, Miami Vice, The Last of the Mohicans and Heat filmmaker Michael Mann sustained minor injuries during a gun-range mishap in Los Angeles Saturday.
paras.zh: 11 月 1 日（合众国际社）——周六在洛杉矶发生的枪击事故中，《猎人》、《迈阿密风云》、《最后的莫西干人》和《热火》电影制作人迈克尔·曼受了轻伤。

paras.en: "On Saturday, at a gun range, a weapon accidentally discharged while holstered resulting in a superficial injury to film director Michael Mann. He was treated and is being released," Mann's representative said in a statement to TMZ Sunday.
paras.zh: “周六，在射击场，一把武器在装在枪套中时意外走火，导致电影导演迈克尔·曼受了表面伤。他接受了治疗，正在被释放，”曼的代表周日在给 TMZ 的一份声明中说。

paras.en: The Los Angeles Times described the filmmaker as a target shooter with decades of experience.
paras.zh: 《洛杉矶时报》将这位电影制片人描述为一位拥有数十年经验的射手。

paras.en: Deadline.com said Mann, 83, is still slated to start filming Heat 2 in January.
paras.zh: Deadline.com 表示，83 岁的曼仍计划于 1 月份开始拍摄《盗火线 2》。

articles.title: German protests turn violent; police blame 'left-wing extremists'

paras.en: Nov. 1 (UPI) -- What began as largely peaceful protests became violent across Germany, a turn police blamed on extremist factions infiltrating the demonstrations against the high cost of living and lack of education funding.
paras.zh: 11 月 1 日（合众社）——德国各地的抗议活动最初基本上是和平的，后来演变成了暴力活动，警方将这一事件归咎于极端主义派别渗透到示威活动中，抗议生活成本高和教育经费匮乏。

paras.en: Roman Poseck, the interior minister for Hesse state, said "around 100 clearly identified left-wing extremists" joined protesters in Frankfurt, prompting violence and looting, CNN reported.
paras.zh: 据美国有线电视新闻网 (CNN) 报道，黑森州内政部长罗曼·波塞克 (Roman Poseck) 表示，“大约 100 名明确身份的左翼极端分子”加入了法兰克福的抗议者行列，引发了暴力和抢劫。

paras.en: Police said protesters broke shop windows, threw Molotov cocktails at officials and broke into shops. Police used water cannons to disperse the gatherings. In Hamburg, crowd control barriers were set on fire.
paras.zh: 警方称，抗议者打破商店橱窗，向官员投掷燃烧弹，并闯入商店。警方使用高压水枪驱散集会。在汉堡，人群控制屏障被点燃。

paras.en: "It is shameful how this event here in Frankfurt has ended," Poseck said.
paras.zh: 波塞克说：“在法兰克福举行的这一活动以这样的方式结束是可耻的。”

paras.en: At least 30 people were detained in Frankfurt and 60 in Berlin, where 27 officers sustained injuries.
paras.zh: 法兰克福至少有 30 人被拘留，柏林有 60 人被拘留，柏林有 27 名警察受伤。

paras.en: German Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt told Bild newspaper that in addition to left-wing groups, "troublemakers from migrant communities" also caused violence.
paras.zh: 德国内政部长亚历山大·多布林特对《图片报》表示，除了左翼团体之外，“来自移民社区的麻烦制造者”也制造了暴力事件。

paras.en: NBC News reported that tens of thousands of people took part in the protest in cities across Germany, including Berlin, Cologne Frankfurt.
paras.zh: 美国全国广播公司新闻报道称，柏林、科隆、法兰克福等德国多座城市都有数万人参加抗议活动。

paras.en: The protests were organized by Gen Z Regelt (Gen Z Takes Charge). Organizers told Der Spiegal they weren't involved in the violence.
paras.zh: 抗议活动是由 Z 世代负责组织的。组织者告诉《明镜周刊》，他们没有参与暴力事件。

paras.en: "We had no influence on what happened after the demonstrations ended," a spokesperson said.
paras.zh: “我们对示威结束后发生的事情没有影响，”一位发言人说。

paras.en: In addition to cost of living concerns, the protesters sought increased action against climate change and stood against plans to reintroduce mandatory military service. The German protests were inspired by those in France, which also turned violent last month, prompting officials to impose curfews and other restrictions.
paras.zh: 除了生活成本问题之外，抗议者还寻求采取更多行动应对气候变化，并反对重新实行义务兵役制的计划。德国的抗议活动受到法国抗议活动的启发，法国上个月也发生了暴力事件，促使官员实施宵禁和其他限制。

articles.title: Here’s Where to Watch the 2026 New York Marathon Live Online
articles.author: Rudie Obias

paras.en: All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.
paras.zh: 所有特色产品和服务均由编辑独立选择。然而，Billboard 可能会收到通过其零售链接下的订单的佣金，并且零售商可能会收到某些用于会计目的的可审计数据。

paras.en: In the past, famous New Yorkers have raced, so it’s fun to see which celebrities are throwing on a pair of running shoes to race with the public this year.
paras.zh: 过去，纽约名人都参加过比赛，所以今年看看哪些名人穿上跑鞋与公众一起比赛很有趣。

paras.en: How to Watch 2026 New York Marathon Live Online, at a Glance:
paras.zh: 如何在线观看 2026 年纽约马拉松赛直播一目了然：

paras.en: - Online Streaming: DirecTV, Fubo, Hulu + Live TV, Sling TV, ESPN Unlimited
paras.zh: - 在线流媒体：DirecTV、Fubo、Hulu + 直播电视、Sling TV、ESPN Unlimited

paras.en: When Does the 2026 New York Marathon Start?
paras.zh: 2026 年纽约马拉松什么时候开始？

paras.en: The New York Marathon takes place on Sunday (Nov. 1), with the city-wide race starting at 8 a.m. ET/5 a.m. PT.
paras.zh: 纽约马拉松将于周日（11 月 1 日）举行，全市比赛于东部时间上午 8 点/太平洋时间上午 5 点开始。

paras.en: What TV Networks Feature the 2026 New York Marathon?
paras.zh: 哪些电视网络报道 2026 年纽约马拉松？

paras.en: In 2026, the New York Marathon broadcasts across two networks: ABC7NY, locally and ESPN, nationally. Meanwhile, It’s available to livestream on ESPN Unlimited.
paras.zh: 2026 年，纽约马拉松赛将通过两个网络进行转播：本地 ABC7NY 和全国 ESPN。同时，可以在 ESPN Unlimited 上进行直播。

paras.en: Which Celebrities Are Running in the 2026 New York Marathon?
paras.zh: 哪些名人参加 2026 年纽约马拉松比赛？

paras.en: The New York Marathon is known for celebrity sightings with a number of famous actors, actresses and recording artists participating in the race. Artists who have been known to run in the past, include Action Bronson, Kevin Hart, Prince Royce, Jennifer Connelly, Death Cab for Cutie’s Ben Gibbard, AEW star Darby Allin and others.
paras.zh: 纽约马拉松以名人出没而闻名，许多著名演员和唱片艺术家都参加比赛。过去已知参与跑步的艺术家包括 Action Bronson、Kevin Hart、Prince Royce、Jennifer Connelly、Death Cab for Cutie 的 Ben Gibbard、AEW 明星 Darby Allin 等。

paras.en: Meanwhile, it’s likely that Harry Styles might run in the 2026 New York Marathon. His residency at Madison Square Garden ends the night before on Saturday (Oct. 31) and he’s been spotted all over the city running over the last few months.
paras.zh: 与此同时，哈里·斯泰尔斯 (Harry Styles) 很可能会参加 2026 年纽约马拉松。他在麦迪逊广场花园的驻地于周六（10 月 31 日）前一天晚上结束，在过去的几个月里，人们看到他在城市各处跑步。

paras.en: Where to Watch the 2026 New York Marathon Live Online for Free
paras.zh: 哪里可以免费观看 2026 年纽约马拉松在线直播

paras.en: For cord-cutters, there are a few ways to watch the New York Marathon, if you don’t have cable, especially if you want to watch for free. DirecTV has a five-day free trial, while other streaming services, such as Fubo and Hulu + Live TV, offer free trials, so you can watch for free.
paras.zh: 对于掐线者来说，如果您没有有线电视，特别是如果您想免费观看的话，有几种方法可以观看纽约马拉松比赛。 DirecTV 有五天的免费试用期，而其他流媒体服务，例如 Fubo 和 Hulu + Live TV，则提供免费试用，因此您可以免费观看。

paras.en: Sling TV offers the Orange & Blue plan, which comes with ABC7NY and ESPN. With more than 50 channels, the streaming plan goes for $69.99 per month. All plans come with a free cloud DVR and an extra 600 or so free channels too. Please note: Pricing and channel availability vary from market-to-market.
paras.zh: Sling TV 提供 Orange & Blue 套餐，该套餐附带 ABC7NY 和 ESPN。流媒体套餐拥有 50 多个频道，每月价格为 69.99 美元。所有套餐都附带免费的云 DVR 和额外的 600 个左右的免费频道。请注意：定价和渠道可用性因市场而异。

paras.en: Broadcast and cable networks ABC7NY and ESPN are available to watch with Hulu + Live TV. Prices for the cable alternative start at $99.99 per month for more than 100 live channels, while each plan comes with Hulu, Disney+ and ESPN Select at no additional cost. Hulu + Live TV might be best for those who want all of these streaming services together in one package. The service includes a three-day free trial.
paras.zh: 广播和有线网络 ABC7NY 和 ESPN 可通过 Hulu + Live TV 观看。有线替代方案的起价为每月 99.99 美元，可观看 100 多个直播频道，而每个套餐都附带 Hulu、Disney+ 和 ESPN Select，无需额外付费。对于那些希望将所有这些流媒体服务集中在一个包中的人来说，Hulu + 直播电视可能是最好的选择。该服务包括三天免费试用。

paras.en: ESPN Unlimited is the official streaming platform for ESPN. A subscription includes instant access for $31.99 per month. However, you can save almost 17% off by purchasing an annual subscription for $319.99 per year. It features every ESPN network, including ESPN, ESPN2, ESPNU, ESPNEWS, ESPN Deportes, SEC Network, ACC Network, ESPN on ABC, ESPN+, SEC Network+ and ACC Network Extra — all in one streaming service.
paras.zh: ESPN Unlimited 是 ESPN 的官方流媒体平台。订阅包括即时访问，每月费用为 31.99 美元。不过，如果您每年支付 319.99 美元购买年度订阅，则可以节省近 17% 的费用。它包含每个 ESPN 网络，包括 ESPN、ESPN2、ESPNU、ESPNEWS、ESPN Deportes、SEC Network、ACC Network、ESPN on ABC、ESPN+、SEC Network+ 和 ACC Network Extra — 所有这些都在一个流媒体服务中。

paras.en: In addition to live sports, ESPN Unlimited has original programming to stream on demand. Although the service doesn’t offer a free trial, you can still watch ESPN Unlimited with a clever workaround to watch online for free. Learn more about how to get a free trial to access ESPN Unlimited here.
paras.zh: 除了体育赛事直播外，ESPN Unlimited 还提供原创节目供点播。尽管该服务不提供免费试用，但您仍然可以通过巧妙的解决方法免费在线观看 ESPN Unlimited。在此处了解有关如何免费试用 ESPN Unlimited 的更多信息。

paras.en: On Sunday (Nov. 1), the New York Marathon broadcasts across on ABC7NY and ESPN. One of the best ways to watch live is with DirecTV.
paras.zh: 周日（11 月 1 日），纽约马拉松赛将在 ABC7NY 和 ESPN 上转播。观看直播的最佳方式之一是使用 DirecTV。

articles.title: AliExpress’ Singles’ Day Sale Is a Tech Lover’s Dream, From Gaming Consoles to Karaoke Machines
articles.author: Camila Quimper

paras.en: All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.
paras.zh: 所有特色产品和服务均由编辑独立选择。然而，Billboard 可能会收到通过其零售链接下的订单的佣金，并且零售商可能会收到某些用于会计目的的可审计数据。

paras.en: Your next tech obsession might be a lot more affordable than you expected. AliExpress’ annual Singles’ Day sale is back until Nov.18, bringing deals on everything from Bluetooth speakers and gaming gear to smart rings and digital pianos.
paras.zh: 您的下一个技术痴迷可能比您预期的要便宜得多。全球速卖通一年一度的双十一促销活动将持续至 11 月 18 日，提供从蓝牙扬声器、游戏设备到智能戒指和数码钢琴等各种商品的优惠。

paras.en: And if your music setup could use some attention, there’s plenty to browse. A mini karaoke machine is practically begging for a living room singalong, while the W-KING Bluetooth speaker can take your playlists on the road. Gamers can check out the Retroid Pocket 5 handheld console or Edifier G35 headset, and aspiring musicians can get started with a 61-key digital piano.
paras.zh: 如果您的音乐设置需要一些注意，那么还有很多内容可供浏览。迷你卡拉 OK 机几乎可以在客厅里唱歌，而 W-KING 蓝牙扬声器则可以在旅途中携带您的播放列表。游戏玩家可以尝试一下 Retroid Pocket 5 手持式游戏机​​或 Edifier G35 耳机，有抱负的音乐家可以开始使用 61 键数码钢琴。

paras.en: The deals aren’t the only draw. AliExpress’ Brand+ is a dedication shopping destination bringing together products from trusted brands with enhanced servicing at competitive prices. From tech and beauty to home essentials, shoppers can explore a wide range of products, with free returns on eligible purchases.
paras.zh: 这些交易并不是唯一的吸引力。全球速卖通的 Brand+ 是一个专注的购物目的地，汇集了值得信赖的品牌的产品，并以具有竞争力的价格提供增强的服务。从科技和美容到家居必需品，购物者可以探索各种产品，符合条件的购买可享受免费退货。

paras.en: Even better, most Brand+ products ship free without a minimum order requirement. AliExpress also says 95% of U.S.-available products qualify for fast delivery guarantee, with coupons for qualifying delays and refunds for eligible lost, damaged or late shipments.
paras.zh: 更好的是，大多数 Brand+ 产品免费送货，没有最低订单要求。 AliExpress 还表示，95% 的美国产品都有资格获得快速交付保证，并针对符合条件的延误提供优惠券，并对符合条件的丢失、损坏或延迟发货提供退款。

paras.en: The sale ends Nov. 18, so consider this your cue to upgrade your tech before the holiday shopping rush begins.
paras.zh: 促销活动将于 11 月 18 日结束，因此请将此视为在假日购物热潮开始之前升级您的技术的提示。

paras.en: A good gaming headset can make all the difference, especially when every sound counts. Edifier’s G35 delivers 7.1 virtual surround sound through 50mm drivers, while a detachable noise-canceling microphone helps keep your voice clear during multiplayer sessions.
paras.zh: 一款好的游戏耳机可以发挥重要作用，尤其是当每种声音都很重要时。 Edifier 的 G35 通过 50 毫米驱动器提供 7.1 虚拟环绕声，而可拆卸的降噪麦克风有助于在多人游戏过程中保持声音清晰。

paras.en: AliExpress W-KING Deep Bass Bluetooth Speaker
paras.zh: 全球速卖通 W-KING 深重低音蓝牙音箱

paras.en: From bass-heavy hip-hop tracks to your favorite dance anthems, the W-KING D9-1 is built to give your music some extra punch. It packs 60W RMS output, dual woofers and a 7.2-inch passive bass radiator, plus up to 40 hours of playback at low volume.
paras.zh: 从重低音嘻哈曲目到您最喜爱的舞曲，W-KING D9-1 旨在为您的音乐增添更多冲击力。它配备 60W RMS 输出、双低音扬声器和 7.2 英寸无源低音辐射器，低音量播放时间长达 40 小时。

paras.en: AliExpress SucceBuy 61 Key Digital Keyboard Piano
paras.zh: AliExpress SucceBuy 61 键数字键盘钢琴

paras.en: The SucceBuy digital keyboard gives beginners plenty to work with, including 61 keys, a metronome and recording and playback functions. Depending on the model, it offers up to 600 tones and 500 rhythms, allowing players to explore different sounds as their skills improve.
paras.zh: SucceBuy 数字键盘为初学者提供了丰富的使用空间，包括 61 个键、节拍器以及录音和播放功能。根据型号的不同，它提供多达 600 种音调和 500 种节奏，让玩家随着技能的提高探索不同的声音。

paras.en: AliExpress W-KING T9-M2 Portable Karaoke Speaker
paras.zh: 全球速卖通 W-KING T9-M2 便携式卡拉 OK 音箱

paras.en: For anyone who likes their music loud and their bass even louder, the W-KING T9-M2 delivers 80W RMS output with a 180W peak rating. The portable speaker also includes two wireless microphones and RGB lighting, so it’s just as ready for karaoke night as it is for a party playlist.
paras.zh: 对于那些喜欢响亮音乐和更响亮低音的人来说，W-KING T9-M2 可提供 80W RMS 输出和 180W 峰值额定功率。这款便携式扬声器还包括两个无线麦克风和 RGB 灯光，因此它既适合卡拉 OK 之夜，也适合派对播放列表。

articles.title: The Best 2026 Halloween Costumes, From Paris Hilton as Britney Spears to Kim Kardashian as North West
articles.author: Hannah Dailey

paras.en: It’s that time of year again: Halloween, which means a trick-or-treat bag’s worth of celebrity costumes ranging from spooky to cutesy to pop culture-referencing.
paras.zh: 又到了一年中的这个时候：万圣节，这意味着一袋“不给糖就捣蛋”的名人服装，从怪异到可爱到流行文化参考。

paras.en: That includes the usual suspects, stars who’ve long been showcasing their love of the holiday with increasingly elaborate looks. Paris Hilton returned with another Halloween tribute to her friend and pop icon Britney Spears — which she premiered in photos shared exclusively with Billboard — as well as a wholesome family dress-up borrowed from a beloved Disney princess movie. Janelle Monáe has also gone all out once again ahead of her annual Wondaween festival, and a costume triangle of sorts has emerged between Kim Kardashian, her daughter North West and Natalie Nunn.
paras.zh: 其中包括常见的嫌疑人、明星，他们长期以来一直以越来越精致的造型来展示他们对节日的热爱。帕丽斯·希尔顿 (Paris Hilton) 回归，再次向她的朋友兼流行偶像布兰妮·斯皮尔斯 (Britney Spears) 致敬——这是她在《公告牌》(Billboard) 独家分享的照片中首次亮相的，还有借鉴自一部深受喜爱的迪士尼公主电影的健康家庭装扮。加奈尔·梦奈 (Janelle Monáe) 在一年一度的旺达威节 (Wondaween Festival) 之前也再次全力以赴，金·卡戴珊 (Kim Kardashian)、她的女儿诺丝·韦斯特 (North West) 和娜塔莉·纳恩 (Natalie Nunn) 之间也出现了某种服装三角关系。

paras.en: As for costumes specifically honoring something that happened in 2026, Owen Thiele and Benito Skinner are arguably the front runners with a two-person look that recreated one of the year’s buzziest pop collaborations. (Whether you’re a celebrity or not, there’s still time to pull together a 2026-specific Halloween look — here’s some ideas Billboard put together recently referencing Bad Bunny’s Super Bowl performance, Taylor Swift watching the New York Knicks and more.)
paras.zh: 至于专门纪念 2026 年发生的事情的服装，欧文·蒂勒 (Owen Thiele) 和贝尼托·斯金纳 (Benito Skinner) 无疑是领跑者，他们的两人造型再现了今年最热门的流行合作之一。 （无论您是否是名人，仍然有时间打造 2026 年万圣节造型 - Billboard 最近整理了一些创意，参考了 Bad Bunny 的超级碗表演、泰勒·斯威夫特 (Taylor Swift) 观看纽约尼克斯队比赛等内容。）

paras.en: With the next few days bringing more and more ‘stumes leading up to the main event on Saturday (Oct. 31), Billboard is keeping track of all of the best celebrity looks. Whether you’re searching for some last-minute inspo or simply want to check out what the biggest names in entertainment are doing for the holiday this year, keep reading to learn about the best Halloween costumes we’ve seen below — and keep checking back for updates!
paras.zh: 在接下来的几天里，周六（10 月 31 日）的主赛事将有越来越多的粉丝前来关注，Billboard 正在追踪所有最好的名人造型。无论您是在寻找最后一刻的灵感，还是只是想看看今年娱乐界的大腕们都在做什么，请继续阅读以了解我们在下面看到的最好的万圣节服装 - 并不断回来查看更新！

paras.en: - Paris Hilton as Britney Spears Paris Hilton continued her tradition of paying homage to the Princess of Pop for the fourth Halloween in a row, this time dressing up as Britney Spears performing “I’m a Slave 4 U” at the 2001 VMAs. “Britney is not only an icon, but also a dear friend, and I’ll always love celebrating her and the incredible impact she’s had on all of us,” Hilton told Billboard of the look. Later, she’d share a second 2026 costume inspired by Beauty and the Beast that got her whole family involved. See Hilton as Britney Spears here and as Princess Belle alongside her family here.
paras.zh: - 帕丽斯·希尔顿 (Paris Hilton) 饰演布兰妮·斯皮尔斯 (Britney Spears) 帕丽斯·希尔顿 (Paris Hilton) 连续第四个万圣节延续了向流行音乐公主致敬的传统，这一次，她装扮成布兰妮·斯皮尔斯 (Britney Spears) 在 2001 年 VMA 上表演“I'm a Slave 4 U”。 “布兰妮不仅是一个偶像，而且还是一位亲爱的朋友，我将永远喜欢庆祝她以及她对我们所有人产生的令人难以置信的影响，”希尔顿在谈到这一造型时说道。后来，她分享了第二套 2026 年服装，灵感来自《美女与野兽》，这让她的全家人都参与其中。在这里，希尔顿扮演布兰妮·斯皮尔斯，在这里，她扮演贝儿公主和她的家人。

paras.en: - Kim Kardashian as North West Kim Kardashian didn’t have to look farther than her own home for her Halloween 2026 muse, dressing up as daughter North West. The reality star completed her look with a turquoise wig, long nails and goth clothing, either replicas of North’s look or borrowed straight from the source. See Kardashian’s costume here.
paras.zh: - 金·卡戴珊 (Kim Kardashian) 饰演诺丝·韦斯特 (North West) 金·卡戴珊 (Kim Kardashian) 打扮成女儿诺丝·韦斯特 (North West) 的样子，无需走出家门就能找到她的 2026 年万圣节缪斯。这位真人秀明星用绿松石假发、长指甲和哥特服装完成了她的造型，这些服装要么是诺斯造型的复制品，要么是直接从来源借来的。在这里查看卡戴珊的服装。

paras.en: - Natalie Nunn as North West “Uno reverse 🔄 @northwest,” Nunn wrote on Instagram while unveiling her 2026 costume: North West. In response to Kardashian and Ye’s eldest daughter dressing up as her, Nunn repaid the favor by joining Kardashian in dressing up as North in turquoise pigtails and a studded collar. See Nunn as North West here.
paras.zh: - 娜塔莉·纳恩 (Natalie Nunn) 饰演西北 “Uno 逆转🔄 @northwest，”纳恩在 Instagram 上发布她的 2026 年服装：西北 (North West) 时写道。为了回应卡戴珊和叶的大女儿打扮成她的样子，纳恩也加入了卡戴珊的行列，打扮成诺斯，扎着绿松石辫子，戴着镶钉衣领。在这里将纳恩视为西北。

paras.en: - Cyndi Lauper as Ursula Cyndi Lauper joined Bette Midler at the New York Restoration Project’s annual Hulaween gala photo call, sporting a chic Phantom of the Opera-esque masquerade look. Inside the event, Lauper switched into a detailed Ursula costume for a performance of her signature Billboard Hot 100 smash, “Girls Just Want to Have Fun,” which she switched to “Ghouls Just Want to Have Fun” for the occasion.
paras.zh: - 辛迪·劳珀 (Cyndi Lauper) 饰演乌苏拉 (Ursula) 辛迪·劳珀 (Cyndi Lauper) 与贝蒂·米德勒 (Bette Midler) 一起出席纽约修复项目一年一度的 Hulaween 盛大拍照会，一身别致的歌剧魅影式化装舞会造型。在活动中，劳珀换上了精致的乌苏拉服装，表演了她标志性的 Billboard Hot 100 热门单曲“Girls Just Want to Have Fun”，并在这次场合换成了“Ghouls Just Want to Have Fun”。

paras.en: - Chloe Bailey as Meg Griffin Chloe Bailey recognized Family Guy‘s most under-appreciated family member, Meg Griffin, by dressing up as the “Hot Meg” version of her for Halloween. The R&B singer showed off her figure in a pink strapless bra, denim skirt and boots, topping it off with Meg’s signature pink beanie and glasses. See Bailey as Meg here.
paras.zh: - 克洛伊·贝利 (Chloe Bailey) 饰演梅格·格里芬 (Meg Griffin) 克洛伊·贝利 (Chloe Bailey) 在万圣节装扮成“性感梅格”版的梅格·格里芬 (Meg Griffin)，认识到了《恶搞之家》中最不受重视的家庭成员梅格·格里芬 (Meg Griffin)。这位 R&B 歌手穿着粉色无肩带文胸、牛仔裙和靴子展示了自己的身材，并戴着梅格标志性的粉色无檐小便帽和眼镜。在这里将贝利视为梅格。

paras.en: - Owen Thiele & Benito Skinner as PinkPantheress & Zara Larsson Owen Thiele and Benito Skinner dressed up as one of pop music’s most dynamic duos in 2026: PinkPantheress and Zara Larsson, whose remix of “Stateside” reached No. 6 on the Hot 100 in March. The two friends recreated the pop stars’ plaid skirts and colorfully airbrushed baby tees from the “Stateside” music video for the look. See Thiele and Skinner as Pink and Larsson here.
paras.zh: - 欧文·蒂勒 (Owen Thiele) 和贝尼托·斯金纳 (Benito Skinner) 饰演 PinkPantheress 和扎拉·拉尔森 (Zara Larsson) 欧文·蒂勒 (Owen Thiele) 和贝尼托·斯金纳 (Benito Skinner) 装扮成 2026 年流行音乐最具活力的二人组之一：PinkPantheress 和 Zara Larsson，他们的混音版《Stateside》在 3 月份的 Hot 100 排行榜上排名第六。两位朋友重现了《Stateside》音乐录影带中流行歌星的格子裙和色彩缤纷的婴儿 T 恤。请在此处查看蒂勒和斯金纳饰演平克和拉尔森。

paras.en: - Travis Barker & Kourtney Kardashian as Vampires Travis Barker and Kourtney Kardashian have always loved gothic aesthetics, but at the 23rd birthday party for the Blink-182 drummer’s son, they went full vamp. The couple dressed up in all black and even added a touch of blood trickling down from the corners of their mouths to make it extra spooky. See Barker and Kardashian as vampires here.
paras.zh: - Travis Barker 和 Kourtney Kardashian 饰演吸血鬼 Travis Barker 和 Kourtney Kardashian 一直热爱哥特式美学，但在 Blink-182 鼓手儿子的 23 岁生日派对上，他们彻底变得疯狂。夫妻俩一身黑衣，嘴角还流淌着一抹血迹，显得格外阴森。在这里将巴克和卡戴珊视为吸血鬼。

paras.en: - Victoria Justice & Madison Grace as the Shining Twins Longtime Halloween lover Victoria Justice recruited her sister, Madison Grace, to dress up as the creepy twins from The Shining. “Come & play with us, Danny. Forever… and ever… and everrrrr,” she captioned an Instagram post showing off the look. The Victorious alum also popped out in a few different zombie-themed looks — including a zombie bride — as well as an elfish mushroom-inspired getup.
paras.zh: - 维多利亚·贾斯蒂斯 (Victoria Justice) 和麦迪逊·格蕾丝 (Madison Grace) 扮演《闪灵》中的双胞胎 万圣节的长期爱好者维多利亚·贾斯蒂斯 (Victoria Justice) 招募了她的妹妹麦迪逊·格雷斯 (Madison Grace) 来装扮成《闪灵》中令人毛骨悚然的双胞胎。 “丹尼，来和我们一起玩吧。永远……永远……永远……”她在 Instagram 上发了一条展示这一造型的帖子。这位胜利者还以几种不同的僵尸主题造型亮相——包括僵尸新娘——以及精灵蘑菇风格的装扮。

paras.en: - Janelle Monáe as Ghostess With the Mostess Janelle Monae started preparing for this year’s Wondaween by transforming herself into a green, decomposing zombie-like creature, which she dubbed “Hostess With the Mostess” in a video showing how she achieved the makeover. She pulled out all the stops for the look, topping it off with a swirly fake eye and blood spurting out of a faux wound in her neck. See Monae as “Hostess With the Mostess” here.
paras.zh: - 加奈儿·梦奈 (Janelle Monáe) 饰演“与最贵的女主人” 加奈尔·梦奈 (Janelle Monae) 开始为今年的 Wondaween 做准备，她把自己变成了一个绿色的、会腐烂的僵尸般的生物，她在一段视频中将其称为“与最贵的女主人”，展示了她如何实现这一转变。她使出了浑身解数，用一只旋转的假眼和脖子上的假伤口喷出的鲜血来完成这一造型。在这里将 Monae 视为“女主人与最美丽的人”。

paras.en: - Lizzo as Granny Seiko Lizzo tapped into her anime fandom for Halloween 2026, dressing up as Seiko Ayase from the anime Dandadan. As she does every year, the hitmaker went all out, this time donning a tall white wig and a massive faux bust. See her as Seiko here.
paras.zh: - Lizzo 饰演 Seiko 奶奶 Lizzo 在 2026 年万圣节进军了她的动漫迷圈，装扮成动漫《Dandadan》中的 Seiko Ayase。正如她每年所做的那样，这位热门歌手全力以赴，这一次戴上了高高的白色假发和巨大的人造半身像。在这里将她视为 Seiko。

paras.en: - Erika Jayne as Cruella Erika Jayne joined Lauper in channeling an iconic Disney villain for this year’s Hallow’s Eve, dressing up as Cruella de Vil from One Hundred and One Dalmatians. “Miserable, darling, as usual. Perfectly wretched,” the Real Housewives star captioned a video showing off the look, which came with a campy wig, spotted coat and retro cigarette holder. See Jayne as Cruella here.
paras.zh: - Erika Jayne 饰演 Cruella Erika Jayne 与 Lauper 一起在今年的万圣节前夕扮演迪士尼标志性反派角色，装扮成《一百零一只斑点狗》中的 Cruella de Vil。 “痛苦，亲爱的，像往常一样。非常可怜，”这位《真正的主妇》明星在一段展示这一造型的视频中写道，视频中还戴着一顶做作的假发，穿着斑点外套和复古烟嘴。在这里将杰恩视为克鲁拉。

paras.en: - Umi as Janet Jackson Umi dressed up — or should we say dressed down — to channel a bare-chested Janet Jackson on the cover of Rolling Stone in 1993. With no top and unbuttoned jeans, plus the iconic hands covering her bust from behind, the singer recreated Miss Jackson’s pose and sepia-toned photo for Halloween this year. See her as Jackson here.
paras.zh: - Umi 扮演珍妮·杰克逊 Umi 盛装打扮——或者我们应该说是便装——效仿 1993 年《滚石》杂志封面上赤裸上身的珍妮·杰克逊。这位歌手没有上衣，没有扣子，牛仔裤，加上标志性的双手从后面遮住胸部，这位歌手在今年的万圣节重现了杰克逊小姐的姿势和棕褐色色调的照片。在这里将她视为杰克逊。

paras.en: - Keke Palmer & Son Leo as Janet & Michael Jackson Keke Palmer and her 3-year-old son, Leo, honored both Janet and Michael Jackson for Halloween 2026, adorably recreating the iconic pop siblings’ “Scream” music video. Miss Jackson was a big fan, reposting a few of Palmer’s posts featuring the getup on Instagram Stories and writing, “HOW CUTE!” See Palmer and Leo as Janet and Michael Jackson here.
paras.zh: - Keke Palmer 和儿子 Leo 饰演珍妮特和迈克尔·杰克逊 Keke Palmer 和她 3 岁的儿子 Leo 在 2026 年万圣节向珍妮特和迈克尔·杰克逊致敬，可爱地重现了这对标志性流行兄弟的“Scream”音乐视频。杰克逊小姐是帕尔默的忠实粉丝，她在 Instagram Stories 上转发了帕尔默的一些帖子，并写道：“多可爱啊！”在这里将帕尔默和利奥视为珍妮特和迈克尔·杰克逊。

paras.en: - Summer Walker as Dr. Frank-N-Furter Summer Walker honored Tim Curry, who died in August, by dressing up as his iconic Rocky Horror Picture Show character Dr. Frank-N-Furter in a video lip-syncing to “Sweet Transvestite.” “R.I.P Tim Curry🥰 Dr. Frank & Furter 1975,” she wrote in her caption. See Walker as Curry here.
paras.zh: - 萨默·沃克 (Summer Walker) 饰演 Frank-N-Furter 博士 萨默·沃克 (Summer Walker) 为纪念 8 月去世的蒂姆·库里 (Tim Curry)，在一段与“甜蜜易装癖”视频对口型同步中，装扮成他在《洛基恐怖秀》中的标志性角色 Frank-N-Furter 博士。 “R.I.P Tim Curry🥰 Dr. Frank & Furter 1975，”她在标题中写道。在这里将沃克视为库里。

paras.en: - Lily Allen as Ticketing Seat Map Lily Allen poked fun at the chaotic live music industry by dressing as an online ticket-seller seat map. “Never beating the allegations. #bluedotfever,” she wrote on Instagram, captioning a series of photos showing off her white jumpsuit with a bunch of blue spots arranged in seating blocks. See Allen as a ticketing seat map here.
paras.zh: - 莉莉·艾伦 (Lily Allen) 饰演售票座位图 莉莉·艾伦 (Lily Allen) 打扮成在线售票员座位图，以此取笑混乱的现场音乐行业。她在 Instagram 上写道：“从来没有反驳过这些指控。#bluedotfever。”并配上一系列照片，展示了她的白色连身裤，座位区排列着一堆蓝色斑点。请在此处查看艾伦的票务座位图。

paras.en: - Lizzo as Dolly Parton Lizzo paid tribute to Dolly Parton, recreating the country icon’s look from the artwork for her 1973 hit single “Jolene.” The costume featured a skin-tight yellow floral jumpsuit and platinum blonde wig, with the singer-rapper sharing her admiration for the late country icon in a heartfelt Instagram post. See her as Parton here.
paras.zh: - Lizzo 饰演 Dolly Parton Lizzo 向 Dolly Parton 致敬，在她 1973 年的热门单曲“Jolene”的艺术作品中重现了这位乡村偶像的造型。这套服装以紧身黄色花卉连身裤和白金金色假发为特色，这位歌手兼说唱歌手在 Instagram 上发了一篇发自内心的帖子，分享了她对这位已故乡村音乐偶像的钦佩之情。在这里将她视为帕顿。

paras.en: - Justin & Hailey Bieber as Devil & Angel Justin and Hailey coordinated their Halloween costumes, with the Rhode founder dressing as an angel in a feathered white look complete with wings and a halo, while the pop superstar embraced his devilish side in an all-red outfit topped off with horns and a pointy tail. See Justin and Hailey as devil and angel here.
paras.zh: - 贾斯汀和海莉·比伯饰演魔鬼与天使 贾斯汀和海莉协调了他们的万圣节服装，罗德创始人穿着白色羽毛装扮，配有翅膀和光环，扮成天使，而这位流行巨星穿着全红色服装，上面有角和尖尾巴，拥抱着他邪恶的一面。在这里将贾斯汀和海莉视为魔鬼和天使。

paras.en: - KATSEYE as DC Characters KATSEYE brought some DC flair to Halloween this year, with the members dressing up as some of the franchise’s most recognizable characters. Yoonchae went full Harley Quinn, Megan transformed into Poison Ivy, Daniela suited up as Wonder Woman and Lara channeled Catwoman. “good luck picking a side,” the group captioned a fierce photo on Instagram. See KATSEYE as DC superheroes & villains here.
paras.zh: - KATSEYE 扮演 DC 角色 KATSEYE 为今年的万圣节带来了一些 DC 风格，成员们装扮成该系列最知名的角色。允彩变成了小丑女，梅根变成了毒藤女，丹妮拉变成了神奇女侠，劳拉变成了猫女。 “祝你选边站队好运，”该组织在 Instagram 上发布了一张激烈的照片。在这里将 KATSEYE 视为 DC 超级英雄和恶棍。

paras.en: - Slayyyter as Playmate of the Year from “Apocalypse Now” Slayyyter traveled back to the 1970s for Halloween this year, dressing up as Cynthia Wood’s Playmate of the Year character from Francis Ford Coppola’s 1979 film Apocalypse Now. In the Vietnam War film, Wood played the Playmate during the movie’s memorable USO show scene. “APOCALYPSE NOW, PLAYMATE OF THE YEAR!” the singer captioned a series of photos showing off her costume on Instagram. See Slayyyter as Playmate of the Year from Apocalypse Now here.
paras.zh: - 《现代启示录》中的年度玩伴 Slayyyter 今年万圣节回到 1970 年代，装扮成弗朗西斯·福特·科波拉 (Francis Ford Coppola) 1979 年电影《现代启示录》中辛西娅·伍德 (Cynthia Wood) 的年度玩伴角色。在越南战争电影中，伍德在电影中令人难忘的 USO 表演场景中扮演了玩伴。 “现代启示录，年度玩伴！”这位歌手在 Instagram 上发布了一系列展示她服装的照片。在这里查看《现代启示录》中的年度玩伴 Slayyyter。

paras.en: - Tate McRae as Catwoman Tate McRae leaned into her feline side this year, dressing up as Catwoman in a look inspired by Julie Newmar’s portrayal of the iconic character in the 1960s Batman television series. The “Greedy” singer put her own spin on the villain’s signature style with a sleek, all-black ensemble. See Tate McRae’s Catwoman costume here.
paras.zh: - 泰特·麦克雷 (Tate McRae) 饰演猫女 泰特·麦克雷 (Tate McRae) 今年向猫女倾斜，装扮成猫女，造型灵感源自朱莉·纽玛 (Julie Newmar) 在 1960 年代蝙蝠侠电视剧中扮演的标志性角色。这位“贪婪”歌手以时尚的全黑套装将自己的风格融入到反派的标志性风格中。在这里查看泰特·麦克雷的猫女服装。

paras.en: - Karol G as The Corpse Bride Karol G brought a gothic touch to this year’s Halloween celebrations by transforming into the titular character from Tim Burton’s 2005 animated classic Corpse Bride. The Colombian singer recreated the character’s signature look in a haunting blue-hued bridal ensemble. See Karol G as The Corpse Bride here.
paras.zh: - 卡罗尔·G 饰演“僵尸新娘” 卡罗尔·G 变身为蒂姆·波顿 2005 年经典动画《僵尸新娘》中的同名角色，为今年的万圣节庆祝活动增添了一抹哥特式的气息。这位哥伦比亚歌手以令人难以忘怀的蓝色新娘装再现了该角色的标志性造型。在这里查看 Karol G 饰演的僵尸新娘。

articles.title: Michael Mann Accidentally Shoots Himself at L.A. Gun Range
articles.author: Carly Thomas

paras.en: Michael Mann was hospitalized on Saturday after accidentally shooting himself at a gun range in Los Angeles, The Hollywood Reporter has learned.
paras.zh: 据《好莱坞报道》获悉，迈克尔·曼周六在洛杉矶的一个射击场意外开枪自杀，入院治疗。

paras.en: “On Saturday, at a gun range, a weapon accidentally discharged while holstered resulting in a superficial injury to film director Michael Mann. He was treated and is being released,” a rep for the four-time Oscar-nominated filmmaker shared in a statement.
paras.zh: 这位四次获得奥斯卡提名的电影制片人的代表在一份声明中分享道：“周六，在射击场，一把武器在装在枪套中时意外走火，导致电影导演迈克尔·曼受了浅伤。他接受了治疗，正在被释放。”

paras.en: The Los Angeles Police Department said officers responded to The Range LA at around 4 p.m. for a call about shots fired. “Responding units’ investigation determined the shooting to be accidental. The subject was transported to a local hospital in stable condition,” authorities said.
paras.zh: 洛杉矶警察局表示，警方于下午 4 点左右对 The Range LA 作出回应。接到关于开枪的电话。当局表示：“响应单位的调查确定这起枪击事件是意外事件。受害者已被送往当地医院，情况稳定。”

paras.en: Sources told TMZ that Mann was apparently trying to holster his gun during target practice at a sanctioned gun range when the firearm went off. He was later taken to a local hospital for minor injuries. Mann has been an experienced target shooter for decades.
paras.zh: 消息人士告诉 TMZ，曼恩显然是在一个经批准的射击场进行打靶练习时试图将枪收进枪套，这时枪械突然响起。他后来因轻伤被送往当地医院。几十年来，曼恩一直是一位经验丰富的射击手。

paras.en: Mann is currently in pre-production on Heat 2, which reportedly has Leonardo DiCaprio, Stephen Graham and Christian Bale attached to star. The film comes more than three decades after the 1995 crime drama Heat that starred Al Pacino, Robert De Niro, Val Kilmer and Jon Voight.
paras.zh: 曼恩目前正在筹备《热火2》，据报道莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥、史蒂芬·格雷厄姆和克里斯蒂安·贝尔将出演该片。这部电影是在 1995 年由阿尔·帕西诺、罗伯特·德尼罗、瓦尔·基默和乔恩·沃特主演的犯罪剧《盗火线》上映三十多年前拍摄的。

paras.en: He’s also best known for directing 1981’s Thief, 1999’s The Insider, 2001’s Ali, 2004’s Collateral, 2006’s Miami Vice, 2009’s Public Enemies and 2023’s Ferrari, among others. Throughout his career, he’s received four Academy Award nominations, including best director, best picture and best adapted screenplay for The Insider, and best picture for 2005’s The Aviator.
paras.zh: 他还因执导 1981 年的《神偷》、1999 年的《局内人》、2001 年的《阿里》、2004 年的《借刀杀人》、2006 年的《迈阿密风云》、2009 年的《公敌》和 2023 年的《法拉利》等而闻名。在他的整个职业生涯中，他获得了四项奥斯卡奖提名，包括《局内人》的最佳导演、最佳影片和最佳改编剧本提名，以及 2005 年《飞行者》的最佳影片提名。

articles.title: ‘You Can See Everything,’ ‘Clayface’ Fighting for No. 1 in Quiet Halloween Weekend
articles.author: Ryan Gajewski

paras.en: A24’s Elizabeth Holmes documentary You Can See Everything, which includes a memorable discussion about the classic comedy routine “Who’s on First,” sparked questions about whether the movie itself could take first place over Clayface as the two films battled at the box office during a subdued Halloween weekend.
paras.zh: A24 的伊丽莎白·福尔摩斯纪录片《你可以看到一切》，其中包括对经典喜剧套路“谁在第一”的令人难忘的讨论，引发了人们的疑问，即电影本身是否可以超越《粘土脸》，因为两部电影在万圣节周末的票房上展开了激烈的较量。

paras.en: Sunday figures show the two movies still neck and neck for the top spot domestically, with directors Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim‘s You Can See Everything looking like the early winner at $10.6 million in its third weekend to bring its North American cume to $63.8 million. Currently playing in 3,243 North American locations, the Oscar-buzzed documentary eyes its first No. 1 finish. It looks to decline around 43 percent for the weekend that saw the studios avoid releasing new titles as Halloween fell on a Saturday.
paras.zh: 周日的数据显示，这两部电影在国内票房榜上仍不相上下，导演内森·菲尔德和兰斯·奥本海姆的《你可以看到一切》看起来是早期获胜者，在第三周末获得 1,060 万美元的票房，北美票房达到 6,380 万美元。这部备受奥斯卡好评的纪录片目前在北美 3,243 个地点上映，有望首次获得第一名。由于万圣节恰逢周六，工作室避免发布新游戏，周末的票房收入似乎下降了 43% 左右。

paras.en: If this holds, the three-hour You Can See Everything would follow previous features True Grit, Argo and 1917 as films that hit No. 1 in their third frames. Despite the meager overall turnout for this weekend’s moviegoing, the domestic box office’s 2026 take of $8.46 billion still puts it around 20 percent ahead of last year’s total sum to this point, according to Rentrak.
paras.zh: 如果这种情况成立，那么时长三小时的《你可以看到一切》将继《大地惊雷》、《逃离德黑兰》和《1917》之后，成为在第三部电影中排名第一的电影。 Rentrak 的数据显示，尽管本周末的总体观影人数微乎其微，但 2026 年国内票房收入为 84.6 亿美元，仍比去年总票房高出 20% 左右。

paras.en: Just behind You Can See Everything for the time being is Clayface, as filmmaker James Watkins’ body horror feature looks to gross around $10.4 million in its sophomore frame for a two-week North American sum of $44.1 million. Tom Rhys Harries and Naomi Ackie star in the $44 million-budgeted Warner Bros. release that marks DC Studios‘ third theatrical title for bosses James Gunn and Peter Safran after 2025’s Superman and this summer’s underperforming Supergirl. Clayface looks to decline around 56 percent for the weekend.
paras.zh: 目前排在《你可以看到一切》之后的是《泥脸》，电影制片人詹姆斯·沃特金斯的人体恐怖片在第二部上映时预计票房约为 1,040 万美元，北美两周票房为 4,410 万美元。汤姆·里斯·哈里斯 (Tom Rhys Harries) 和娜奥米·阿基 (Naomi Ackie) 主演了华纳兄弟制作的这部耗资 4400 万美元的电影，这是继 2025 年的《超人》和今年夏天表现不佳的《女超人》之后，DC 工作室为老板詹姆斯·古恩 (James Gunn) 和彼得·萨夫兰 (Peter Safran) 推出的第三部影院作品。 Clayface 周末的跌幅约为 56%。

paras.en: Overall, this weekend is headed for one of the lowest domestic totals of the year with $55.6 million, down a frightening 42.1 percent from last weekend, per Rentrak. This still marks a roughly 4.2 percent uptick over the $49 million collected from the equivalent weekend in 2025. Last year, Halloween fell on Friday as Black Phone 2 led the frame with $8.3 million in its third weekend.
paras.zh: 总体而言，根据 Rentrak 的数据，本周末的国内​​总金额将是今年最低的之一，为 5560 万美元，比上周末下降了 42.1%。这仍然比 2025 年同期周末的 4900 万美元收入增长了约 4.2%。去年万圣节恰逢周五，《黑手机 2》在第三个周末以 830 万美元的收入领先。

paras.en: “Historical challenges can spook studios away from launching a major film into the marketplace,” Rentrak’s Paul Dergarabedian tells The Hollywood Reporter of competition from parties and trick-or-treating on moviegoing’s biggest day of the weekend. He points out that the lack of a splashy opener “limits the opportunity for a major new release to give October a big closing boost. [But] the broader horror picture remains remarkable. A quieter Halloween weekend can coexist with an exceptionally strong year for the genre.”
paras.zh: Rentrak 的保罗·德加拉贝迪安 (Paul Dergarabedian) 向《好莱坞报道》表示，“历史性的挑战可能会吓跑制片厂，让他们不敢将一部大片推向市场。”他指出，缺乏引人注目的开场“限制了重大新片上映给十月带来巨大收官提振的机会。[但是]更广泛的恐怖图景仍然引人注目。安静的万圣节周末可以与该类型异常强劲的一年共存。”

paras.en: In third place is Laika‘s stop-motion animated feature Wildwood, which earned around $7.5 million in its second weekend to bring its domestic sum to $25.8 million. Carey Mulligan, Peyton Elizabeth Lee and Jacob Tremblay lead the voice cast for director Travis Knight’s movie that eyes an impressive decline of around 38 percent and was likely dinged by families’ weekend attention focusing away from cinemas. Wildwood has generated Oscar buzz and carries a 99 percent critics approval rating from Rotten Tomatoes, but it will need to continue to show legs, given its hefty reported production budget of $100 million.
paras.zh: 排在第三位的是莱卡的定格动画长片《怀尔德伍德》，该片在第二个周末就获得了约 750 万美元的票房收入，使其国内票房达到了 2580 万美元。由凯里·穆里根、佩顿·伊丽莎白·李和雅各布·特伦布莱领衔的配音演员为特拉维斯·奈特导演的电影预计下降了约 38%，令人印象深刻，这可能是由于周末家庭注意力从电影院转移而造成的。 《怀尔德伍德》在奥斯卡上引起了轰动，并在烂番茄上获得了 99% 的影评人支持率，但鉴于据报道其制作预算高达 1 亿美元，它还需要继续大展拳脚。

paras.en: Registering a similarly enviable hold with a decline around 28 percent is Black Bear’s Wicker, as the romantic fantasy grossed $4.1 million from 2,374 North American theaters for a domestic total of $13.2 million after its second weekend. Olivia Colman and Alexander Skarsgard star in directors Eleanor Wilson and Alex Huston Fischer’s movie about a woman in a quiet village who gets a wicker husband. It holds a strong 94 Rotten Tomatoes score from critics.
paras.zh: 《黑熊的柳条》的票房表现也同样令人羡慕，跌幅约为 28%，这部浪漫奇幻片在北美 2,374 家影院上映后票房收入为 410 万美元，国内总票房为 1,320 万美元。奥利维亚·科尔曼和亚历山大·斯卡斯加德主演了导演埃莉诺·威尔逊和亚历克斯·休斯顿·费舍尔的电影，讲述了一个安静村庄里的女人嫁给了一个柳条丈夫的故事。它在烂番茄上获得了 94 分的高分。

paras.en: Closing out the top five is Paramount and Legendary’s Street Fighter, picking up $3.2 million in its third weekend as its domestic cume reaches $53 million in its third weekend. Starring Noah Centineo and Andrew Koji, director Kitao Sakurai’s adaptation of the Capcom video game added $3.2 million internationally as the global total stands at $91.9 million for the $82 million-budgeted feature.
paras.zh: 排在前五名的是派拉蒙影业和传奇影业出品的《街头霸王》，该片在第三周末的票房收入为 320 万美元，国内票房则达到了 5300 万美元。由诺亚·琴蒂内奥 (Noah Centineo) 和安德鲁·小司 (Andrew Koji) 主演、导演樱井北雄改编的这部由 Capcom 电子游戏改编的作品在国际上斩获了 320 万美元的票房，这部预算为 8,200 万美元的电影的全球总票房为 9,190 万美元。

paras.en: Likely landing in seventh place is Sony’s Resident Evil, which crossed $400 million at the global box office in its seventh weekend of release. Its projected $2.5 million domestically for the frame will bring the North American total to $157.3 million for director Zach Cregger’s Austin Abrams-led adaptation of the video game.
