paras.en: Carrick played under Sir Alex Ferguson and is an old-school manager in the sense that he wants to keep everything inside the dressing room. Some fans may want him to rant and rave and show more emotion in public but you are never going to get that from Carrick.
paras.zh: 卡里克在弗格森爵士的麾下踢球，他是一位老派教练，他希望把一切都留在更衣室里。有些球迷可能希望他在公共场合咆哮、咆哮并表现出更多的情感，但你永远不会从卡里克那里得到这一点。

paras.en: When it comes to the media, United are like Real Madrid and Barcelona. Everything that happens at the club is headline news - especially in the social media age. United fans feel like they are under siege.
paras.zh: 说到媒体，曼联就像皇家马德里和巴塞罗那。俱乐部发生的一切都是头条新闻——尤其是在社交媒体时代。曼联球迷感觉自己被围攻了。

paras.en: Carrick is on their side. He gives very little away when he speaks in public. He wears his club suit with pride and always says what is in the best interests of the club. He never makes it about himself. The clue is in the name: United.
paras.zh: 卡里克站在他们一边。当他在公开场合讲话时，他很少透露任何信息。他自豪地穿着俱乐部队服，总是说出最符合俱乐部利益的事情。他从来不把这事放在自己身上。线索就在名字中：United。

paras.en: Changing the manager is not going to fix the long-term problems at the club. United fans know that and that is why they are not going to hound Carrick out and watch him being replaced by another manager who has to operate in the same structure.
paras.zh: 更换主教练并不能解决俱乐部的长期问题。曼联球迷知道这一点，这就是为什么他们不会把卡里克赶出去，看着他被另一位必须在同一结构中运作的教练取代。

paras.en: United have had seven permanent managers since Ferguson retired in 2013 and, despite varying levels of relative success in cup competitions, none of them has been able to mount a genuine title challenge.
paras.zh: 自弗格森 2013 年退休以来，曼联已经有七位正式主教练，尽管在杯赛中取得了不同程度的相对成功，但他们中没有一个能够发起真正的冠军挑战。

paras.en: A long list of former United players have now joined fans in arguing that things are not going to get better at United until the club has new owners.
paras.zh: 一长串前曼联球员现在加入了球迷的行列，认为在俱乐部拥有新老板之前，曼联的情况不会好转。

paras.en: The media are sometimes criticised for not highlighting issues with United's ownership structure but anyone who has time on their hands can go and check old newspapers from 2005.
paras.zh: 媒体有时会因为没有强调曼联所有权结构的问题而受到批评，但任何有时间的人都可以去查看 2005 年的旧报纸。

paras.en: The vast majority of football reporters and commentators who covered the Glazer family's takeover warned that leveraged buyouts - the acquisition of a company using a high proportion of borrowed money (debt) - should not be allowed in football. Leveraged buyouts of the kind the Glazers used to buy United are no longer allowed in English football. That is no consolation for United fans.
paras.zh: 报道格雷泽家族收购案的绝大多数足球记者和评论员警告说，足球界不应允许杠杆收购——使用高比例借钱（债务）收购一家公司。英格兰足球不再允许格雷泽家族用来收购曼联的那种杠杆收购。这对曼联球迷来说并不是什么安慰。

paras.en: United fans don't traditionally turn on their managers
paras.zh: 曼联球迷传统上不会攻击他们的主教练

paras.en: It seems almost inevitable that Carrick will lose his job and his body language sometimes resembles a man who is resigned to his fate.
paras.zh: 卡里克似乎不可避免地会失去工作，他的肢体语言有时就像一个听天由命的人。

paras.en: If Carrick does go this month, he can walk out of Old Trafford with his head held high - and come back whenever he wants.
paras.zh: 如果卡里克这个月真的离开，他可以昂首阔步地走出老特拉福德，然后随时回来。

paras.en: United fans are proud of the fact that they have historically not turned on their managers. Fans have become disaffected and disillusioned with the managers who have followed in Ferguson's footsteps but there have been no mutinies.
paras.zh: 曼联球迷为自己历史上从未背叛过主帅而感到自豪。球迷们对追随弗格森脚步的教练们感到不满和幻灭，但并没有发生叛变。

paras.en: United supporters of a certain age still remember the lone fan who turned up to Old Trafford with a banner in December 1989 declaring that Ferguson should leave after "three years of excuses".
paras.zh: 一定年龄的曼联球迷仍然记得1989年12月，一位孤独的球迷举着横幅来到老特拉福德，宣称弗格森在“三年的借口”之后应该离开。

paras.en: Ferguson did not say goodbye and the rest is history - including 13 league titles and two European Cups.
paras.zh: 弗格森没有说再见，剩​​下的一切都已成为历史——包括 13 次联赛冠军和两次欧洲冠军杯冠军。

paras.en: Fans don't trust chiefs to make the right calls
paras.zh: 球迷不相信酋长会做出正确的决定

paras.en: When Jim Ratcliffe bought a minority stake in United in 2024, the Glazers agreed to let him take control of football operations.
paras.zh: 当吉姆·拉特克利夫 (Jim Ratcliffe) 于 2024 年购买曼联少数股权时，格雷泽家族同意让他控制足球业务。

paras.en: Erik ten Hag was the manager at the time and despite initial misgivings he was given a contract extension after winning the 2024 FA Cup final. He was sacked and replaced by Ruben Amorim just five months later. Amorim lasted 14 months before he was sacked after he criticised the way the club was being run in a press conference.
paras.zh: 埃里克·十·哈格 (Erik ten Hag) 是当时的主教练，尽管最初心存疑虑，但在赢得 2024 年足总杯决赛后，他还是获得了续约合同。仅仅五个月后，他就被解雇了，并由鲁本·阿莫林（Ruben Amorim）取代。阿莫林在新闻发布会上批评俱乐部的运作方式后，在他被解雇之前持续了 14 个月。

paras.en: Carrick took over in an interim capacity in January and he was given the full-time job in the summer after he led United back into the Champions League with a third-place finish in the Premier League.
paras.zh: 卡里克在一月份临时接任，并在夏天带领曼联以英超第三名的成绩重返冠军联赛后，他获得了全职工作。

paras.en: The key decision makers below Ratcliffe are chief executive Omar Berrada and director of football Jason Wilcox, who both used to work at Manchester City.
paras.zh: 拉特克利夫手下的关键决策者是首席执行官奥马尔·贝拉达（Omar Berrada）和足球总监杰森·威尔科克斯（Jason Wilcox），他们都曾在曼城工作过。

paras.en: Highly-respected sporting director Dan Ashworth left in December 2024 after just five months - after spending five months on gardening leave at Newcastle United.
paras.zh: 备受尊敬的体育总监丹·阿什沃斯 (Dan Ashworth) 在纽卡斯尔联队休了 5 个月的园艺假后，在任职仅 5 个月后于 2024 年 12 月离开。

paras.en: United's top targets to replace Carrick are former Newcastle and Bournemouth manager Eddie Howe and former Germany and Bayern Munich manager Julian Nagelsmann.
paras.zh: 曼联取代卡里克的首要目标是前纽卡斯尔和伯恩茅斯主教练埃迪·豪以及前德国和拜仁慕尼黑主教练朱利安·纳格尔斯曼。

paras.en: Both of them are strong candidates but United fans do not seem to be that excited by the prospect of either of them taking over.
paras.zh: 他们都是强有力的候选人，但曼联球迷似乎对他们接任的前景并不那么兴奋。

paras.en: A clean slate and a fresh start may mean they would be able to get more out of this group of players than Carrick but there are no guarantees in football.
paras.zh: 干净的状态和全新的开始可能意味着他们能够比卡里克从这群球员身上得到更多，但足球界并不能保证。

paras.en: If Unai Emery was available, he would be the favourite to take over but he is doing a great job at Aston Villa and is under contract until 2029.
paras.zh: 如果乌奈·埃梅里可以上场，他将是最有可能接手的人选，但他在阿斯顿维拉表现出色，合同期到2029年。

paras.en: In any case, swapping Villa for United at this stage of his career would mean dropping down 19 places in the Champions League table and eight places in the Premier League.
paras.zh: 无论如何，在他职业生涯的这个阶段将维拉转投曼联将意味着欧冠积分榜上的排名下降 19 位，英超排名下降 8 位。

paras.en: Clubs in the Premier League are also duty-bound to act in utmost good faith towards each other, which makes any move for Emery fraught with complications.
paras.zh: 英超联赛的俱乐部也有责任以最大的诚意彼此行事，这使得埃梅里的任何举动都充满了复杂性。

articles.title: Chelsea flex title-winning credentials but Man City following closely

paras.en: WSL talking points: Chelsea flex title-winning credentials with dominant win at Charlton but Man City are keeping up
paras.zh: WSL谈话要点：切尔西在查尔顿的比赛中取得了压倒性的胜利，证明了夺冠的凭据，但曼城正在跟上

paras.en: Sky Sports analyses the key talking points from Sunday's WSL action; Chelsea flex title-winning credentials vs Charlton; Man City keep up with the league-leaders with narrow win at London City; Spurs could be the best of the rest while relegation fears growing at Liverpool
paras.zh: 天空体育分析周日 WSL 比赛的关键话题；切尔西对阵查尔顿的比赛展示了夺冠凭证；曼城以微弱优势险胜伦敦城，紧随联赛领头羊；热刺可能是其余球队中最好的，而利物浦的降级担忧却在加剧

paras.en: Manchester City asked the question. Chelsea answered with six goals.
paras.zh: 曼城提出了这样的问题。切尔西以六个进球回应。

paras.en: Their emphatic 6-0 win at Charlton restored them to the top of the WSL on goal difference and showed just how many ways this team can hurt opponents.
paras.zh: 他们以 6-0 大胜查尔顿，凭借净胜球优势重返 WSL 榜首，并展示了这支球队可以通过多种方式伤害对手。

paras.en: - WSL round-up: Arsenal held by Villa as City beat London City
paras.zh: - WSL 综述：曼城击败伦敦城，阿森纳被维拉逼平

paras.en: - Got Sky? Watch WSL games on your phone
paras.zh: - 有天空吗？在手机上观看 WSL 比赛

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Stream WSL games with no contract
paras.zh: - 没有天空？无需签订合同即可直播 WSL 比赛

paras.en: Nathalie Bjorn opened the scoring, Melvine Malard struck twice and Ellie Carpenter also found the net before the break. Then the substitutes took over, with Aggie Beever-Jones scoring and Giulia Dragoni adding her first Chelsea goal.
paras.zh: 纳塔莉·比约恩首开纪录，梅尔文·马拉德梅开二度，艾莉·卡彭特也在中场休息前进球。随后替补球员接管比赛，阿吉·比弗-琼斯进球，朱莉娅·德拉戈尼打入她在切尔西的第一个进球。

paras.en: That depth matters in a title race. Chelsea could withdraw Malard at half-time and still carry a threat, finishing with 34 shots and more than 70 per cent possession.
paras.zh: 这种深度在冠军争夺战中很重要。切尔西可以在半场结束时撤回马拉德，但仍然具有威胁，最终射门 34 次，控球率超过 70%。

paras.en: Charlton struggled to offer anything like the same danger, managing only one effort on target.
paras.zh: 查尔顿很难提供同样的威胁，仅一次射正。

paras.en: Lauren James being forced off after 32 minutes was the concern on an otherwise commanding afternoon. Chelsea and City are both unbeaten on 22 points, but this was a reminder of the standard required to keep pace at the top.
paras.zh: 劳伦·詹姆斯 (Lauren James) 在 32 分钟后被迫下场，这在这个原本势不可挡的下午令人担忧。切尔西和曼城均积 22 分保持不败，但这提醒人们保持领先地位所需的标准。

paras.en: There was a Ballon d'Or trophy at Hayes Lane, but Manchester City left with the prize they came for.
paras.zh: 海耶斯巷曾有一座金球奖奖杯，但曼城带着他们想要的奖杯离开了。

paras.en: Alexia Putellas' third award provided the backdrop to a demanding afternoon against London City Lionesses. City's 2-1 victory owed plenty to their ability to take chances and respond when the game threatened to turn.
paras.zh: 亚历克西娅·普特拉斯 (Alexia Putellas) 的第三个奖项为对阵伦敦城狮队 (London City Lioness) 的艰难下午奠定了背景。曼城2-1的胜利很大程度上归功于他们在比赛即将发生逆转时抓住机会并做出反应的能力。

paras.en: Bunny Shaw supplied the composure for the opener, rounding Mary Earps to score her ninth league goal of the season. When Fernandes eventually headed the hosts level, Lauren Hemp restored City's lead just 122 seconds later.
paras.zh: 邦尼·肖（Bunny Shaw）为揭幕战提供了镇静，绕过玛丽·厄普斯（Mary Earps）打进了她本赛季的第九个联赛进球。当费尔南德斯最终头球扳平东道主队时，仅 122 秒后劳伦·汉普 (Lauren Hemp) 就恢复了曼城的领先优势。

paras.en: That response was crucial. London City had already shown they could create openings, registering 18 shots and 2.95 expected goals by the 67th minute.
paras.zh: 这一回应至关重要。伦敦城已经证明了他们可以创造空档，到第 67 分钟时已完成 18 次射门，预计进球数为 2.95 个。

paras.en: City were far from comfortable, but Mary Fowler's excellent delivery and Hemp's anticipation gave them the decisive moment.
paras.zh: 曼城队的表现远非舒适，但玛丽·福勒的出色传球和汉普的预判给了他们决定性的时刻。

paras.en: Chelsea's subsequent win means City finish the day second on goal difference. Yet taking three points from a game this difficult could prove every bit as valuable as a more convincing performance.
paras.zh: 切尔西随后的胜利意味着曼城以净胜球优势排名第二。然而，在如此困难的比赛中拿下三分，可以证明每一点都与更有说服力的表现一样有价值。

paras.en: Renee Slegers and Arsenal looked like they had turned a corner in their season after back-to-back wins in the build-up to facing Aston Villa.
paras.zh: 蕾妮·斯莱格斯和阿森纳在对阵阿斯顿维拉的比赛中连续获胜后，看起来他们的赛季已经迎来了转机。

paras.en: But the draw that followed, and the manner it arrived in, is yet another reminder that they remain way off the levels needed to enter the title race.
paras.zh: 但接下来的抽签以及抽签的方式再次提醒我们，他们距离进入冠军争夺所需的水平还很远。

paras.en: They had 27 shots, accumulating an expected goals value of 2.68, but were forced to wait until the final five minutes before finally finding the back of the net.
paras.zh: 他们有27次射门，累计预期进球值为2.68，但被迫等到最后五分钟才终于进球。

paras.en: Arsenal were clearly the dominant team but the same clinical edge that has guided them to titles and trophies in the past is now lacking in this side.
paras.zh: 阿森纳显然是占据统治地位的球队，但过去带领他们获得冠军和奖杯的临床优势现在却在这支球队中缺乏。

paras.en: They have scored just eight goals across their opening eight games, conceding nine.
paras.zh: 他们在前八场比赛中只进了八个球，丢了九个球。

paras.en: It isn't a disaster; they are unbeaten in four, but for a team used to being a polished product, the shift to a project is one that will take some getting used to.
paras.zh: 这不是一场灾难；而是一场灾难。他们在四场比赛中保持不败，但对于一支习惯于成为完美产品的球队来说，向项目的转变需要一些时间来适应。

paras.en: Tottenham put an end to their three-game losing streak in the WSL and flexed their muscles against Birmingham in a 4-1 win.
paras.zh: 托特纳姆热刺队结束了WSL的三连败，并以4-1战胜伯明翰队大展拳脚。

paras.en: The lack of confidence was clear to see when the hosts struck the bar early on but after Julie Blakstad's opener, there was only going to be one winner.
paras.zh: 当主队一开始击中横梁时，就可以明显看出缺乏信心，但在朱莉·布拉克斯塔德 (Julie Blakstad) 首开纪录后，只有一个获胜者。

paras.en: Spurs came racing out of the blocks to start the second half and quickly put the game to bed.
paras.zh: 热刺在下半场一开始就迅速冲出禁区，并很快结束了比赛。

paras.en: Two goals in three minutes from Olivia Holdt and Signe Gaupet created breathing room and all but secured the much-needed win.
paras.zh: 奥利维亚·霍尔特（Olivia Holdt）和西格尼·高佩（Signe Gaupet）在三分钟内连进两球，创造了喘息空间，几乎锁定了急需的胜利。

paras.en: London City Lionesses' loss to Manchester City also cuts the gap to third place down to just three points.
paras.zh: 伦敦城狮队输给曼城也将与第三名的差距缩小到仅三分。

paras.en: The title race might be out of sight with a nine-point gap already opened, but the progress for Spurs is clear to see.
paras.zh: 由于九分的差距已经拉开，冠军争夺战可能已经遥不可及，但热刺的进步是显而易见的。

paras.en: They could be the best of the rest this season.
paras.zh: 他们可能是本赛季其余球队中最好的。

paras.en: Liverpool's struggles are continuing and the threat of relegation is now looming.
paras.zh: 利物浦的挣扎仍在继续，降级的威胁迫在眉睫。

paras.en: They have now moved below West Ham following the 4-1 defeat to the Hammers and were lucky results went against both Birmingham and Crystal Palace, or they could have found themselves in the bottom two.
paras.zh: 在 4-1 输给铁锤帮后，他们现在已经排在西汉姆之后，幸运的是，对阵伯明翰和水晶宫的比赛结果，否则他们可能会发现自己处于倒数两名。

paras.en: Facing West Ham was a chance to put an end to their losing streak, which now stretches to five games in all competitions, and the fixture list remains unkind going forward.
paras.zh: 面对西汉姆联队是一个结束他们连败的机会，目前他们在所有比赛中的连败已经达到了五场，而且接下来的赛程表仍然不友好。

paras.en: They host Arsenal in their next outing, a team eager to prove a point, and Brighton after that.
paras.zh: 他们将在下一场比赛中主场迎战阿森纳，这是一支渴望证明自己的球队，随后将迎来布莱顿。

paras.en: They avoided relegation last season but if they do not find a way to snap this run, their luck may run out come the end of the 2026/27 season.
paras.zh: 他们上赛季避免了降级，但如果他们找不到办法打破这一连败，那么他们的运气可能会在2026/27赛季结束时耗尽。

paras.en: For much of the afternoon, Brighton looked in danger of leaving with familiar regrets about chances not taken.
paras.zh: 整个下午的大部分时间里，布莱顿看起来都面临着离开的危险，带着熟悉的遗憾，没有抓住机会。

paras.en: They had almost 71 per cent possession and six shots after half an hour, while Crystal Palace had yet to attempt one. Then Annabel Blanchard produced a superb strike and Brighton were behind.
paras.zh: 半小时后，他们的控球率接近 71%，并有 6 次射门，而水晶宫尚未尝试过一次。随后安娜贝尔·布兰查德打出一记精彩的射门，布莱顿落后。

paras.en: The challenge was to keep creating without letting frustration take over. They did exactly that.
paras.zh: 面临的挑战是继续创造而不让挫败感占据上风。他们正是这么做的。

paras.en: Caitlin Hayes headed in Manuela Vanegas' cross before Emilie Joramo supplied Sophie Peskett for the winner in a deserved 2-1 victory.
paras.zh: 凯特琳·海耶斯 (Caitlin Hayes) 接曼努埃拉·瓦内加斯 (Manuela Vanegas) 传中头球破门，埃米莉·乔拉莫 (Emilie Joramo) 为索菲·佩斯克特 (Sophie Peskett) 补射破门，最终以 2-1 获胜。

paras.en: Fran Kirby had earlier missed a promising opening, while Pauline Peyraud-Magnin repeatedly kept the hosts out. By 88 minutes, Brighton had registered 19 shots to Palace's five.
paras.zh: 弗兰·柯比（Fran Kirby）早些时候错过了一个充满希望的开局，而宝琳·佩罗·马宁（Pauline Peyraud-Magnin）则多次将东道主排除在外。到第 88 分钟时，布莱顿队已经有 19 次射门，而水晶宫只有 5 次射门。

paras.en: There is still an argument that Brighton should have made the closing stages more comfortable. But after falling behind despite their control, they showed the patience and persistence to turn their performance into points.
paras.zh: 仍然有人认为布莱顿应该让最后阶段变得更加舒适。但在尽管控制落后之后，他们表现出了耐心和毅力，将自己的表现转化为积分。

articles.title: Stores looted in German riots as Gen Z activists protest living costs, military service
articles.author: Freddie Clayton

paras.en: Rioters looted stores and set fires to barricades in Frankfurt on Saturday as protests across Germany demanded lower living costs and better education.
paras.zh: 周六，由于德国各地的抗议活动要求降低生活成本和改善教育，骚乱者在法兰克福抢劫商店并放火焚烧路障。

paras.en: Tens of thousands of people across more than 30 cities took to the streets, including in the capital Berlin and financial hub Frankfurt, in protests organized by the campaign group Gen Z Regelt (Gen Z Takes Charge).
paras.zh: 包括首都柏林和金融中心法兰克福在内的 30 多个城市的数万人走上街头，参加由 Z 世代负责组织 (Gen Z Regelt) 组织的抗议活动。

paras.en: The activists demand spending on schools, climate protection and housing, and are against plans to return to mandatory military service.
paras.zh: 活动人士要求在学校、气候保护和住房方面投入资金，并反对恢复义务兵役的计划。

paras.en: But the largely peaceful protests, which coincided with Halloween and came weeks after some of the worst rioting in decades erupted in neighboring France, turned violent in some areas.
paras.zh: 但这场基本上和平的抗议活动恰逢万圣节，几周前邻国法国爆发了数十年来最严重的骚乱，在一些地区演变成了暴力活动。

paras.en: “In the city center, windows have been smashed at several shops,” Frankfurt police said on X. “Molotov cocktails are also being thrown at the emergency services. We urge all bystanders to avoid the city center or to leave the area.”
paras.zh: 法兰克福警方在 X 上表示：“在市中心，多家商店的窗户被砸碎。人们还向紧急服务部门投掷燃烧弹。我们敦促所有旁观者避开市中心或离开该地区。”

paras.en: In Hamburg, some barricades were set on fire. Some businesses had boarded up their windows and doors in preparation for the protests.
paras.zh: 在汉堡，一些路障被纵火。一些企业已经用木板封住了门窗，为抗议活动做准备。

paras.en: “We are here today to fight for peace and freedom, rather than for war and coercion,” Gen Z Regelt spokesperson Lina Friedrich said in Berlin on Saturday. “What matters most to us is better support for the health and education systems. We are against compulsory military service and we are in favor of a fairer distribution of the burden.”
paras.zh: Z 雷格尔特发言人莉娜·弗里德里希 (Lina Friedrich) 周六在柏林表示：“我们今天在这里是为了和平与自由而战，而不是为了战争和胁迫。” “对我们来说最重要的是更好地支持卫生和教育系统。我们反对义务兵役制，我们赞成更公平地分配负担。”

paras.en: Official numbers Saturday afternoon suggested turnout was below the 182,000 participants that organizers initially expected.
paras.zh: 周六下午的官方数据显示，参加人数低于组织者最初预期的 182,000 人。

paras.en: The protests took place alongside many others in Europe.
paras.zh: 这些抗议活动与欧洲的许多其他抗议活动同时发生。

paras.en: France, Italy, Serbia and Spain have seen protests against the cost of living, among other causes. In France, student protests about the state of education last month evolved into wider demonstrations about the cost of living and social security.
paras.zh: 法国、意大利、塞尔维亚和西班牙都出现了针对生活成本等原因的抗议活动。在法国，上个月学生对教育状况的抗议演变成针对生活成本和社会保障的更广泛的示威活动。

paras.en: As the demonstrations began Saturday afternoon in Paris, protesters were pictured holding a banner that read: “We do not need tear gas for our future to be blurry.”
paras.zh: 周六下午，示威活动在巴黎开始，抗议者举着横幅，上面写着：“我们不需要催泪瓦斯，让我们的未来变得模糊。”

paras.en: Videos vetted by NBC News show large crowds and fires burning in Marseille.
paras.zh: NBC新闻审查的视频显示马赛有大量人群和大火。

paras.en: Roman Poseck, interior minister for the German state of Hesse, which includes Frankfurt, warned Germans against using protests in France as an example ahead of Saturday’s protests.
paras.zh: 德国黑森州（包括法兰克福在内）内政部长罗曼·波塞克在周六的抗议活动之前警告德国人不要以法国的抗议活动为例。

paras.en: “We all have those images from France in our minds — looting, burning houses, burning police vehicles, and attacks on police officers,” he said. “France must not be held up as a model in this regard.”
paras.zh: “我们脑海中都有来自法国的那些画面——抢劫、焚烧房屋、焚烧警车和袭击警察，”他说。 “法国在这方面绝不能成为典范。”

paras.en: France’s Interior Ministry said turnout stood at 320,000 on Saturday.
paras.zh: 法国内政部表示，周六的投票人数为 32 万人。

paras.en: In Italy, Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni’s far-right government also said it would deploy 500 army troops alongside the police in Milan until the end of the year after masked groups looted stores in the fashion capital and elsewhere and threw projectiles at police earlier this month.
paras.zh: 在意大利，蒙面团体本月早些时候抢劫了时尚之都和其他地方的商店并向警察投掷弹丸，意大利总理乔治亚·梅洛尼(Giorgia Meloni)的极右翼政府也表示，将在米兰部署500名军队与警察一起部署到年底。

paras.en: Tens of thousands of people again took to the streets of Rome on Friday and other cities and towns across the country.
paras.zh: 周五，数万人再次走上罗马和全国其他城镇的街头。

paras.en: The demonstrations were largely peaceful, but an NBC News crew saw police use a water cannon on protesters and groups of police charging to disperse protesters.
paras.zh: 示威活动基本上是和平的，但 NBC 新闻工作人员看到警察对抗议者使用高压水枪，以及成群结队的警察冲锋驱散抗议者。

paras.en: In Serbia, student-led activism also helped unseat the country’s long-time leader at the ballot box.
paras.zh: 在塞尔维亚，学生领导的激进主义也帮助该国的长期领导人在投票箱中下台。

paras.en: Meanwhile, police in Portugal early Sunday forcibly cleared a tent camp set up in Lisbon by activists protesting high housing costs.
paras.zh: 与此同时，葡萄牙警方周日早些时候强行清理了抗议高住房成本的活动人士在里斯本搭建的一个帐篷营地。

paras.en: Hundreds of protesters shielding the tent camp were dispersed by police using shields and some baton charges, the Reuters news agency reported.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，警察使用盾牌和警棍驱散了数百名保护帐篷营地的抗议者。

paras.en: While the protests across the continent have drawn comparisons for their timing, Andrew Barclay, a politics lecturer at the University of Sheffield in England, said it was important to focus on their differences.
paras.zh: 尽管人们对非洲大陆各地的抗议活动发生的时间进行了比较，但英国谢菲尔德大学政治讲师安德鲁·巴克莱表示，重要的是要关注它们的差异。

paras.en: The French protests have involved “hundreds of thousands taking to the streets over many weeks, and at least initially centered on specific grievances about education funding,” he told NBC News.
paras.zh: 他告诉美国全国广播公司新闻，法国的抗议活动“在数周内有数十万人走上街头，至少最初集中在对教育经费的具体不满”。

paras.en: While protests elsewhere may have taken inspiration from the French, he said, “their scale so far hasn’t been as large, and whilst the state of education continues to be a common theme, the issues being protested has ballooned to include a much larger number of complaints.”
paras.zh: 他说，虽然其他地方的抗议活动可能受到了法国人的启发，但“到目前为止，其规模还没有那么大，虽然教育状况仍然是一个共同的主题，但抗议的问题已经激增，包括更多的投诉。”

paras.en: Similarly, Barclay said, the protests in Germany and France were unlikely to lead to a direct change in governance as they did in Serbia.
paras.zh: 同样，巴克莱表示，德国和法国的抗议活动不太可能像塞尔维亚那样导致治理的直接变化。

paras.en: “Often protests, even quite large ones, don’t capture that level of support elsewhere in the country,” he said. “I would be very cautious about comparing what we have seen in Serbia, where students and others have organized to oppose state corruption, to the sorts of protests that we are seeing elsewhere.”
paras.zh: 他说：“通常，抗议活动，即使是规模相当大的抗议活动，也无法在该国其他地方获得如此程度的支持。” “我会非常谨慎地将我们在塞尔维亚看到的情况与我们在其他地方看到的抗议活动进行比较，那里的学生和其他人组织起来反对国家腐败。”

articles.title: Minor detained after U.S. warned Russia of possible Moscow terror attack, FSB says
articles.author: NBC News

paras.en: Russia’s Federal Security Service (FSB) said it had received information from the United States through established partner channels about preparations for a terrorist attack in Moscow.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯联邦安全局（FSB）表示，已通过既定合作伙伴渠道从美国收到有关莫斯科恐怖袭击准备工作的信息。

paras.en: The FSB said Sunday that it had “verified” the information received from U.S. law enforcement, and “as a result of these operations, a Russian minor was detained,” Russia’s TASS state news agency reported.
paras.zh: 据俄罗斯塔斯社报道，俄罗斯联邦安全局周日表示，它已经“核实”了从美国执法部门收到的信息，“由于这些行动，一名俄罗斯未成年人被拘留”。

paras.en: It said that an individual “had posted photos on the short-video platform TikTok showing himself wearing tactical gear—including a balaclava, a cap, protective eyewear, and headphones—while holding an object resembling an automatic weapon.”
paras.zh: 据称，有人“在短视频平台 TikTok 上发布了照片，显示自己穿着战术装备，包括头套、帽子、防护眼镜和耳机，同时手持类似自动武器的物体。”

paras.en: A subsequent search of his devices revealed a “subscription to a neo-Nazi channel on the messaging app Telegram, and a significant number of search queries concerning past terrorist attacks, mass shootings, and other acts of violence,” TASS reported, citing the FSB.
paras.zh: 塔斯社援引俄罗斯联邦安全局的话报道称，随后对他的设备进行的搜索显示，他“订阅了消息应用程序 Telegram 上的新纳粹频道，以及大量有关过去恐怖袭击、大规模枪击和其他暴力行为的搜索查询”。

paras.en: The U.S. Embassy in Moscow said separately it was “aware of a credible threat of a mass casualty event” on Saturday at Moscow’s Tsaritsyno Museum Reserve and that the U.S. government was coordinating with Russian authorities.
paras.zh: 美国驻莫斯科大使馆另外表示，周六在莫斯科察里津诺博物馆保护区“意识到发生大规模伤亡事件的可信威胁”，美国政府正在与俄罗斯当局协调。

paras.en: The Tsaritsyno Museum Reserve, a palace museum and park complex south of Moscow, was temporarily closed on Saturday and access to the park was restricted, the RIA news agency reported, citing Russian law enforcement agencies.
paras.zh: 俄新社援引俄罗斯执法机构的消息称，莫斯科南部的察里津博物馆保护区（Tsaritsyno Museum Reserve）是莫斯科南部的一座宫殿博物馆和公园建筑群，周六暂时关闭，进入公园受到限制。

paras.en: Russian tabloid Baza reported that the venue was evacuated toward the end of an organ concert, which was cut short with about ten minutes left in the program. A separate concert dedicated to the folk traditions of the North Caucasus region was subsequently canceled, the outlet reported.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯小报《Baza》报道称，一场管风琴音乐会即将结束时，会场被疏散，演出在节目还剩大约十分钟时就被缩短了。据该媒体报道，一场专门针对北高加索地区民间传统的音乐会随后被取消。

paras.en: In March 2024, the U.S. Embassy warned that extremists had imminent plans for an attack in Moscow. Days later, gunmen attacked the Crocus City Hall concert venue outside Moscow, killing more than 140 people.
paras.zh: 2024 年 3 月，美国大使馆警告称，极端分子即将计划对莫斯科发动袭击。几天后，枪手袭击了莫斯科郊外的克洛克斯市政厅音乐会场地，造成 140 多人死亡。

articles.title: Israel’s president says parties need to engage with ‘open heart’ to avoid fresh election
articles.author: Freddie Clayton

paras.en: Israeli President Isaac Herzog has urged the country’s political parties to enter negotiations on forming a new government with an “open heart,” as he prepares to consult with factions on a path forward after an uncertain election result.
paras.zh: 以色列总统艾萨克·赫尔佐格敦促该国各政党以“开放的心态”就组建新政府进行谈判，因为他准备在选举结果不确定后与各派就前进道路进行磋商。

paras.en: Last week’s elections saw Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s bloc denied a majority, with the parties in his ruling coalition claiming 53 seats in Israel’s 120-member Knesset.
paras.zh: 上周的选举中，总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡的集团未能获得多数席位，其执政联盟中的各党派在以色列议会 120 名议员中夺取了 53 个席位。

paras.en: Parties in the bloc aligned with Netanyahu’s main rival, Gadi Eisenkot, won 48 seats, leaving neither man with an obvious path to forming a government.
paras.zh: 该集团中与内塔尼亚胡主要竞争对手加迪·艾森科特结盟的政党赢得了 48 个席位，这使得两人都没有明显的组建政府的途径。

paras.en: The balance of power is held by parties representing Israel’s minority Arab community, which nearly doubled its representation in Israel’s parliament with 19 seats. But both Netanyahu and Eisenkot had ruled out working with them prior to the vote.
paras.zh: 权力平衡由代表以色列少数阿拉伯社区的政党掌握，该社区在以色列议会中的代表人数几乎翻了一番，拥有 19 个席位。但内塔尼亚胡和艾森科特在投票前都排除了与他们合作的可能性。

paras.en: Netanyahu has since continued to attack the Arab parties, accusing them of holding stances on Gaza and the West Bank he considers unacceptable. Eisenkot, however, has indicated he is open to working with anyone who agrees to four conditions on Israeli sovereignty and opposition to Hamas, potentially opening a path to a deal that could propel him to power and avoid fresh elections.
paras.zh: 此后，内塔尼亚胡继续攻击阿拉伯各方，指责他们在加沙和约旦河西岸问题上所持的立场是他认为不可接受的。然而，艾森科特表示，他愿意与任何同意就以色列主权和反对哈马斯提出四项条件的人合作，这有可能为达成一项协议开辟道路，从而推动他掌权并避免重新选举。

paras.en: While Netanyahu is the leader of the single largest party, it is up to Herzog — largely a ceremonial figure — to decide who has the first shot at forming a government. He will hold initial consultations with party officials on Wednesday, beginning a delicate process that could last weeks.
paras.zh: 虽然内塔尼亚胡是最大政党的领导人，但由赫尔佐格——主要是一个礼仪人物——来决定谁最有机会组建政府。他将于周三与党官员进行初步磋商，开始一个可能持续数周的微妙过程。

paras.en: “I hope the representatives will come with an open mind, and today I add: with an open heart,” Herzog said in a statement Sunday. “Come to listen and to be heard, to share ideas, and to find creative solutions to prevent another round of elections.”
paras.zh: 赫尔佐格在周日的一份声明中说：“我希望代表们能够以开放的心态来参加，今天我补充说：以开放的心态。” “来倾听并被倾听，分享想法，并找到创造性的解决方案来防止另一轮选举。”

paras.en: Netanyahu, who is set to remain in his post as a caretaker until a new government can be formed, has claimed Arab parties used foreign backing to “steal” the elections, without providing evidence. Israeli intelligence agency Shin Bet has said it is investigating possible foreign interference in the election but that the probe was not intended to “cast aspersions” on any specific group.
paras.zh: 在组建新政府之前，内塔尼亚胡将继续担任看守人，他声称阿拉伯政党利用外国支持“窃取”选举，但没有提供证据。以色列情报机构辛贝特表示，正在调查外国可能干预选举的可能性，但调查无意“诽谤”任何特定群体。

paras.en: Arab party leaders have strongly denied any wrongdoing, while Herzog pushed party leaders to accept the election result.
paras.zh: 阿拉伯政党领导人强烈否认有任何不当行为，而赫尔佐格则敦促政党领导人接受选举结果。

paras.en: “During an election campaign, candidates naturally and predictably climb to lofty positions,” Herzog said in his statement. “But the elections are over. The election results are a fact. They are a reality. And now is the time to call on all our leaders to stop climbing and face this reality.”
paras.zh: 赫尔佐格在声明中说：“在竞选期间，候选人自然而然地、可以预见地晋升到崇高的职位。” “但选举已经结束了。选举结果是事实。它们是现实。现在是呼吁我们所有领导人停止攀登并面对这一现实的时候了。”

paras.en: The four conditions Eisenkot set out for prospective partners include recognizing Israel as a Jewish state, committing to the values of its independence, accepting mandatory military service for all Israeli citizens and recognizing Hamas as a terrorist organization.
paras.zh: 艾森科特为潜在合作伙伴提出的四个条件包括承认以色列是一个犹太国家、致力于其独立的价值观、接受所有以色列公民的义务兵役以及承认哈马斯为恐怖组织。

paras.en: “Every Knesset member who is willing to sign on to these principles is a potential partner on the path to establishing a new and better government for Israel,” he said in a statement on Saturday. “The door to the government we will form will be open to every public representative who accepts these principles and is ready to rise to the occasion.”
paras.zh: 他在周六的一份声明中表示：“每一位愿意签署这些原则的议会成员都是以色列建立新的、更好的政府道路上的潜在合作伙伴。” “我们将组建的政府的大门将向每一位接受这些原则并准备好应对这种情况的公众代表敞开。”

paras.en: Netanyahu, meanwhile, said Sunday that it was “forbidden” to form a government with Mansour Abbas, head of Arab-led party Ra’am.
paras.zh: 与此同时，内塔尼亚胡周日表示，“禁止”与阿拉伯领导的伊斯兰党领袖曼苏尔·阿巴斯组建政府。

paras.en: He said on X that Abbas wants to establish a Palestinian state with East Jerusalem as its capital, and evacuate Israeli settlements in the occupied Palestinian territories, citing an old Ra’am policy platform.
paras.zh: 他在X上表示，阿巴斯希望建立一个以东耶路撒冷为首都的巴勒斯坦国，并援引旧的拉姆政策纲领，撤离被占巴勒斯坦领土上的以色列定居点。

paras.en: During the campaign, Netanyahu’s Likud party repeatedly alleged that Eisenkot would usher the Arab parties into power.
paras.zh: 在竞选期间，内塔尼亚胡领导的利库德集团多次声称艾森科特将带领阿拉伯政党掌权。

paras.en: In one of several AI-generated videos posted by Netanyahu, Eisenkot was portrayed astride a wooden Trojan horse, with Abbas and left-wing politician Yair Golan inside.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡发布的几段人工智能生成的视频之一中，艾森科特骑在一匹木制特洛伊木马上，阿巴斯和左翼政治家亚伊尔·戈兰在里面。

paras.en: Abbas said Friday that he was coordinating with other Arab leaders on “the prospects for forming a government to replace the one led by Netanyahu.”
paras.zh: 阿巴斯周五表示，他正在与其他阿拉伯领导人就“组建政府取代内塔尼亚胡领导的政府的前景”进行协调。

paras.en: Eisenkot’s anti-Netanyahu bloc contains a broad array of ideologies and views on the issue, ranging from Golan, who has publicly advocated for a deal with the Arab parties, to Avigdor Lieberman of the right-wing Yisrael Beiteinu party, who continues to oppose working with them.
paras.zh: 艾森科特的反内塔尼亚胡集团在这个问题上包含了广泛的意识形态和观点，从公开主张与阿拉伯政党达成协议的戈兰，到继续反对与阿拉伯政党合作的右翼以色列贝泰努党的阿维格多·利伯曼。

paras.en: With that much friction, a stalemate and more elections remain a real possibility.
paras.zh: 由于存在如此多的摩擦，陷入僵局和举行更多选举的可能性仍然存在。

paras.en: Fawaz Gerges, a professor of international relations at the London School of Economics, told NBC News that Israel still appears stuck, adding that Eisenkot’s conditions for the Arab parties are effectively asking them to “forsake their identity.”
paras.zh: 伦敦经济学院国际关系教授法瓦兹·格尔格斯 (Fawaz Gerges) 告诉 NBC 新闻，以色列似乎仍然陷入困境，并补充说，艾森科特对阿拉伯政党提出的条件实际上是在要求他们“放弃自己的身份”。

paras.en: “I don’t think we will see the opposition led by Eisenkot forming a government in Israel,” he said. “So what we have now is a deadlock.”
paras.zh: “我认为我们不会看到艾森科特领导的反对派在以色列组建政府，”他说。 “所以我们现在陷入了僵局。”

paras.en: For the major Israeli parties, it is a choice “between Israel as a democratic state or Israel as a Zionist exclusive society,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说，对于以色列主要政党来说，这是“在以色列作为民主国家还是以色列作为犹太复国主义排外社会之间的选择”。

paras.en: But Yossi Mekelberg, a senior consulting fellow with the Middle East and North Africa Program at U.K. think tank Chatham House, sees flexibility that could yield a breakthrough.
paras.zh: 但英国智库查塔姆研究所中东和北非项目高级咨询研究员约西·梅克尔伯格认为，灵活性可能会带来突破。

paras.en: Parties “make all these promises before the election, and it is obvious that you break at least some of them after the election,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说，各政党“在选举前做出了所有这些承诺，但显然在选举后至少违背了其中一些承诺”。

articles.title: Watchdog says super funds are failing their members
articles.author: Nassim Khadem

paras.en: Australia's corporate regulator warns that super funds are failing to deal with complaints properly.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚企业监管机构警告称，超级基金未能妥善处理投诉。

paras.en: The Australian Securities and Investments Commission says the ombudsman is better at detecting industry-wide issues than the funds.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚证券和投资委员会表示，监察员比基金更擅长发现全行业的问题。

paras.en: It is threatening legal action against super funds that don't step up.
paras.zh: 它威胁要对不采取行动的超级基金采取法律行动。

paras.en: Australia's corporate regulator says superannuation funds are failing their members in managing their retirement savings, warning that those who do not step up could be staring down future legal action.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚企业监管机构表示，养老金基金未能让其成员管理退休储蓄，并警告说，那些不采取行动的人可能会忽视未来的法律诉讼。

paras.en: The Australian Securities and Investments Commission's (ASIC's) latest review looked at 45 superannuation trustees, covering $1.6 trillion in benefits for more than 12.8 million members.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚证券和投资委员会 (ASIC) 的最新审查调查了 45 名退休金受托人，为超过 1,280 万名成员提供了 1.6 万亿美元的福利。

paras.en: It found that superannuation members were more likely to get resolutions to their complaints if they went to the financial ombudsman rather than raise it directly with their super fund.
paras.zh: 研究发现，如果退休金成员向财务监察员提出投诉，而不是直接向退休金基金提出投诉，他们的投诉更有可能得到解决。

paras.en: It has prompted ASIC commissioner Simone Constant to hand down a blunt warning to the funds that "blaming customers is not a complaint strategy".
paras.zh: 这促使 ASIC 专员西蒙·康斯坦特 (Simone Constant) 向这些基金发出直言不讳的警告，称“指责客户不是投诉策略”。

paras.en: ASIC has long been critical of how super funds handle member complaints over death benefits and disability insurance claims payouts and alleged fraud and misconduct.
paras.zh: ASIC 长期以来一直对超级基金如何处理会员对死亡抚恤金和伤残保险索赔支出以及涉嫌欺诈和不当行为的投诉持批评态度。

paras.en: In March last year, it called on funds to overhaul the way they dealt with death benefit claims, noting excessive delays, poor customer service and ineffective claims handling were leaving Australians worse off at some of the most vulnerable times of their lives.
paras.zh: 去年3月，它呼吁各基金彻底改革处理死亡抚恤金索赔的方式，并指出过度延误、糟糕的客户服务和无效的索赔处理使澳大利亚人在生命中最脆弱的时期处境更糟。

paras.en: In October last year, it criticised superannuation funds over the way they communicated with retirees.
paras.zh: 去年十月，它批评了养老金基金与退休人员的沟通方式。

paras.en: Payouts impact people's lives: commissioner
paras.zh: 支出影响人们的生活：专员

paras.en: Ms Constant said superannuation trustees managed $3.4 trillion in Australians' retirement savings.
paras.zh: Constant女士表示，养老金受托人管理着澳大利亚人3.4万亿美元的退休储蓄。

paras.en: She said they were dealing with payouts that affect people's lives and the retirement savings they had worked hard to build.
paras.zh: 她说，他们正在处理影响人们生活和他们努力建立的退休储蓄的支出。

paras.en: "Super funds must listen to what complaints are telling them," she said.
paras.zh: “超级基金必须倾听投诉的声音，”她说。

paras.en: "When trustees fail to learn from their complaints, small problems left unidentified, unattended or unresolved can snowball into widespread failures.
paras.zh: “当受托人未能从他们的投诉中汲取教训时，未被识别、无人处理或未解决的小问题可能会像滚雪球一样发展为广泛的失败。

paras.en: "That expose[s] members to harm and erode[s] trust in the superannuation system."
paras.zh: “这会让会员受到伤害，并削弱他们对退休金制度的信任。”

paras.en: Super funds that don't step up could face legal action.
paras.zh: 不采取行动的超级基金可能会面临法律诉讼。

paras.en: "We're willing and able to bring these actions against funds for not meeting these legal responsibilities,"
paras.zh: “我们愿意并且能够对不履行这些法律责任的基金采取这些行动，”

paras.en: Funds not analysing their complaints data
paras.zh: 基金不分析其投诉数据

paras.en: ASIC's inquiries across the industry found close to one quarter of trustees were not analysing complaints data to identify systemic issues on a regular basis.
paras.zh: ASIC 对整个行业的调查发现，近四分之一的受托人没有定期分析投诉数据来识别系统性问题。

paras.en: More than half of trustees reviewed (24 out of 45) identified fewer than five systemic issues from complaints over a two-year period. Of these, 14 trustees failed to identify a single issue.
paras.zh: 超过一半的接受审查的受托人（45 名受托人中的 24 名）在两年期间的投诉中发现了不到 5 个系统性问题。其中，14 名受托人未能发现任何问题。

paras.en: "We see low levels of systemic issue identification as a potential red flag, not evidence of better performance," Ms Constant said.
paras.zh: Constant 女士表示：“我们认为系统性问题识别水平低是一个潜在的危险信号，而不是表现更好的证据。”

paras.en: "Alarmingly, the Australian Financial Complaints Authority [AFCA] appears better at picking up issues than industry.
paras.zh: “令人担忧的是，澳大利亚金融投诉局 [AFCA] 似乎比行业更擅长发现问题。

paras.en: According to AFCA, superannuation complaints rose sharply in 2025–26, with the financial ombudsman receiving 8,755 complaints, up 42 per cent on the previous financial year.
paras.zh: 据 AFCA 称，2025-26 年养老金投诉急剧增加，金融监察员收到 8,755 起投诉，比上一财年增加 42%。

paras.en: AFCA said complaints about super funds refusing to pay claims rose by 80 per cent.
paras.zh: AFCA 表示，有关超级基金拒绝支付索赔的投诉增加了 80%。

paras.en: ASIC said during July 1, 2023 and June 30, 2026, more than 19,400 complaints were made to AFCA about superannuation concerning the 45 funds that were part of its whole-of-industry review.
paras.zh: ASIC 表示，2023 年 7 月 1 日至 2026 年 6 月 30 日期间，AFCA 接到了超过 19,400 起有关退休金的投诉，涉及 45 只基金，这些基金是其全行业审查的一部分。

paras.en: "When comparing the two years of data we collected, AFCA identified systemic issues from superannuation complaints it received at almost twice the rate all trustees identified from the complaints they received," Ms Constant said.
paras.zh: Constant 女士表示：“在比较我们收集的两年数据时，AFCA 从其收到的养老金投诉中发现系统性问题的速度几乎是所有受托人从收到的投诉中发现系统性问题的速度的两倍。”

paras.en: ASIC also found several trustees blamed members when they made complaints.
paras.zh: ASIC 还发现一些受托人在提出投诉时指责成员。

paras.en: Several of them attributed more than 60 per cent of recorded complaint causes to members.
paras.zh: 其中一些人将 60% 以上的记录投诉原因归因于会员。

paras.en: "Blaming the customer is not a complaints strategy,"
paras.zh: “责怪顾客不是投诉策略，”

paras.en: The review noted in one case, a tax-related system problem was raised through complaints for years before the trustee investigated whether other members were affected, with early estimates suggesting about 1,200 members could be impacted.
paras.zh: 审查指出，在一个案例中，在受托人调查其他成员是否受到影响之前，多年来一直通过投诉提出与税收相关的系统问题，初步估计约有 1,200 名成员可能受到影响。

paras.en: Another case involved more than 250,000 members being unable to access documents online at different times.
paras.zh: 另一个案例涉及超过 250,000 名会员在不同时间无法在线访问文档。

paras.en: "Trustees need to look behind the complaint and ask whether poor communication, unclear processes, delays or system failures are driving member dissatisfaction," Ms Constant said.
paras.zh: “受托人需要调查投诉背后的情况，并询问沟通不畅、流程不明确、延误或系统故障是否导致了会员的不满，”康斯坦斯女士说。

paras.en: "If a member cannot access their benefit payment, cannot get a timely response, or doesn't receive the support they are entitled to or the services they are paying for, the consequences can be serious."
paras.zh: “如果会员无法获得福利金，无法得到及时答复，或者没有获得他们应得的支持或他们付费的服务，后果可能会很严重。”

paras.en: But the industry said it was working hard to resolve issues.
paras.zh: 但业界表示正在努力解决问题。

paras.en: Financial Services Council chief executive Blake Briggs agreed superannuation trustees had a responsibility to deliver high-quality services to members.
paras.zh: 金融服务委员会首席执行官布莱克·布里格斯（Blake Briggs）同意养老金受托人有责任为会员提供高质量的服务。

paras.en: "In recent years, superannuation trustees have undertaken significant work to strengthen their complaints-handling frameworks, including improving processes for identifying and responding to systemic issues," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“近年来，养老金受托人在加强投诉处理框架方面开展了大量工作，包括改进识别和应对系统性问题的流程。”

paras.en: He said the government, almost two years ago, announced its intention to introduce mandatory service standards across the industry in response to unacceptable failures in how major funds had handled Australians' death benefit and group life claims.
paras.zh: 他说，大约两年前，政府宣布打算在整个行业引入强制性服务标准，以应对主要基金在处理澳大利亚人的死亡抚恤金和团体人寿索赔方面出现的不可接受的失败。

paras.en: "We support ongoing industry efforts to promptly identify and address systemic issues, learn from complaints and improve processes to deliver better outcomes for members,"
paras.zh: “我们支持行业不断努力，及时发现和解决系统性问题，从投诉中吸取教训并改进流程，为会员提供更好的结果，”

articles.title: The brutal redistribution at the heart of the RBA's interest rate policy
articles.author: Michael Janda

paras.en: The Reserve Bank has been waging a public relations battle to convince Australians that interest rate policy doesn't primarily work to lower inflation by punishing borrowers.
paras.zh: 储备银行一直在进行一场公关战，以让澳大利亚人相信利率政策的主要作用并不是通过惩罚借款人来降低通货膨胀。

paras.en: This is known by economists as "the cash flow channel", whereby rising interest rates reduce the amount of free cash households have available to spend.
paras.zh: 这被经济学家称为“现金流通道”，即利率上升减少了家庭可用于支出的自由现金数量。

paras.en: Less spending means less demand for goods and services, which in turn should mean less pressure for prices to rise.
paras.zh: 支出减少意味着对商品和服务的需求减少，这反过来又意味着价格上涨的压力减少。

paras.en: It's the most visible channel by which interest rates affect households, at least for the third who have mortgages.
paras.zh: 这是利率影响家庭（至少对于拥有抵押贷款的第三个家庭）最明显的渠道。

paras.en: It's also the most obviously painful one for those households, which is why we've had statements like this from RBA governor Michele Bullock.
paras.zh: 对于这些家庭来说，这也是最明显的痛苦，这就是为什么我们收到了澳大利亚央行行长米歇尔·布洛克这样的声明。

paras.en: "Those who have mortgages, yes, this clearly impacts them and it hurts them. They've got less cash flow, and they've got less money to spend on things," she said at her last press conference.
paras.zh: “是的，对于那些有抵押贷款的人来说，这显然会影响他们并伤害他们。他们的现金流减少了，他们花在东西上的钱也减少了，”她在上次新闻发布会上说。

paras.en: "But that's not the only way monetary policy works through the system."
paras.zh: “但这并不是货币政策在整个体系中发挥作用的唯一方式。”

paras.en: And deputy governor Andrew Hauser went even further in playing down the importance of the cash flow channel at the Citi Investment Conference a couple of weeks ago, drawing on recent research by the RBA's boffins.
paras.zh: 几周前的花旗投资会议上，副行长安德鲁·豪瑟（Andrew Hauser）根据澳大利亚央行研究人员最近的研究，进一步淡化了现金流渠道的重要性。

paras.en: "The cash flow effect, probably, in terms of our models, comes last," he said.
paras.zh: “就我们的模型而言，现金流效应可能排在最后，”他说。

paras.en: "It is first in the public discussion because obviously it's a thing people notice, and we are very sensitive to that."
paras.zh: “它首先出现在公众讨论中，因为显然这是人们注意到的事情，我们对此非常敏感。”

paras.en: But there's something the RBA officials talking about the cashflow channel generally neglect to mention.
paras.zh: 但澳洲联储官员在谈论现金流渠道时通常忽视了一些事情。

paras.en: There is a key reason it has a smaller effect, which is that it is a two-sided coin.
paras.zh: 它的影响较小有一个关键原因，那就是它是双面硬币。

paras.en: On one side are the borrowers, forking out substantially higher interest payments on their loans.
paras.zh: 一方面是借款人为贷款支付了高得多的利息。

paras.en: But on the other are savers, raking in much higher interest payments on their deposits.
paras.zh: 但另一方面是储户，他们的存款利息要高得多。

paras.en: To some extent, the two cancel each other out, reducing the overall impact of the cashflow channel on consumer demand.
paras.zh: 某种程度上，两者相互抵消，降低了现金流渠道对消费者需求的整体影响。

paras.en: That effectively understates the extent to which borrowers are lent on to dampen demand and, ultimately, inflation.
paras.zh: 这实际上低估了借款人借钱来抑制需求并最终抑制通胀的程度。

paras.en: Calculations done by economists at the Centre for Policy Development, using National Accounts data, show that since rates started rising in 2022, for every extra dollar households paid in interest on their mortgages and other debt, households as a whole received about 72 cents more in interest income.
paras.zh: 政策发展中心的经济学家利用国民账户数据进行的计算显示，自 2022 年利率开始上升以来，家庭每多支付一美元抵押贷款和其他债务利息，整个家庭的利息收入就会增加约 72 美分。

paras.en: That number isn't a pure reflection of how the cashflow channel is diluted by savers.
paras.zh: 这个数字并不能纯粹反映储户如何稀释现金流渠道。

paras.en: It also captures part of a second transmission mechanism of monetary policy, the intertemporal substitution channel, which as Andrew Hauser said, "is a long-winded way of saying if interest rates go up, [people] actually have an incentive to save more or borrow less".
paras.zh: 它还捕捉到了货币政策第二种传导机制的一部分，即跨期替代通道，正如安德鲁·豪瑟所说，“这是一种冗长的说法，如果利率上升，[人们]实际上有动机增加储蓄或减少借贷”。

paras.en: That's born out in APRA banking data, which shows the total value of outstanding household debt at prudentially regulated banks climbed about 25 per cent between March 2022 and June 2026, while the balance of household deposits jumped 37 per cent.
paras.zh: APRA 银行数据证实了这一点，该数据显示，2022 年 3 月至 2026 年 6 月期间，受审慎监管的银行的未偿家庭债务总额攀升了约 25%，而家庭存款余额则跃升了 37%。

paras.en: The latest August banking data shows there are now about 68 cents in household deposits for every dollar of household debt, up from about 61 cents in March 2022, before rates started rising from COVID lows.
paras.zh: 最新的 8 月份银行数据显示，目前每 1 美元的家庭债务对应大约 68 美分的家庭存款，高于 2022 年 3 月利率开始从新冠疫情低点上升之前的约 61 美分。

paras.en: A decade-old RBA staff research paper (which doesn't represent official views of the bank) found "the spending of borrowers is at least twice as sensitive as that of lenders to a given change in interest-sensitive cash flows".
paras.zh: 澳洲联储工作人员的一份长达十年的研究论文（并不代表该行的官方观点）发现，“对于利率敏感的现金流的特定变化，借款人的支出至少是贷方支出的两倍”。

paras.en: That's because a lot more borrowers are living at or very near their financial limits.
paras.zh: 这是因为更多的借款人生活在或非常接近他们的财务极限。

paras.en: Even so, the consumption from the new-found riches of savers blunts the overall cash flow effect, meaning borrowers need to suffer more through even higher rates to make up for it.
paras.zh: 即便如此，储户新发财富的消费削弱了整体现金流效应，这意味着借款人需要通过更高的利率承受更多损失来弥补。

paras.en: Middle-aged mortgagors lose, older home owners win
paras.zh: 中年抵押贷款人输了，老年房主赢了

paras.en: This differential also has inter-generational effects.
paras.zh: 这种差异也具有代际效应。

paras.en: The RBA's 2016 research paper found the median age of net borrower households was 42, where mortgage debts are often at their peak, while the median age of savers was 58.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚央行 2016 年的研究报告发现，净借款家庭的中位年龄为 42 岁，抵押贷款债务往往达到顶峰，而储户的中位年龄为 58 岁。

paras.en: A paper by RBA researchers Sarah Jennison and Marcus Miller published last year backs up the earlier findings, showing that over-65s overwhelmingly benefited from rising rates, while most people aged 30-54 lost out. The effect was broadly neutral, on average, for under-30s and those 55-64.
paras.zh: 澳洲联储研究人员莎拉·詹尼森和马库斯·米勒去年发表的一篇论文支持了早期的研究结果，显示 65 岁以上的人绝大多数受益于利率上升，而大多数 30-54 岁的人则蒙受损失。平均而言，对于 30 岁以下和 55-64 岁的人来说，这种影响大致是中性的。

paras.en: Perhaps no surprise then that Commonwealth Bank data shows Australians aged under 55 have been reducing their spending growth over the past year, while those aged over 55 have accelerated their consumption.
paras.zh: 联邦银行的数据显示，过去一年中 55 岁以下的澳大利亚人的支出增长一直在减少，而 55 岁以上的人的消费却在加速，这或许并不令人意外。

paras.en: Given that many of these middle-aged households have dependent children and all the expenses associated with them, it is no wonder they are feeling particularly under the pump.
paras.zh: 考虑到许多中年家庭都有受抚养的子女以及与他们相关的所有费用，难怪他们感到特别沮丧。

paras.en: Middle class suffers most from rising rates
paras.zh: 中产阶级受利率上涨影响最大

paras.en: Even within this broad group of borrowers, there are those more affected than others.
paras.zh: 即使在这一广泛的借款人群体中，也有一些人比其他人受到的影响更大。

paras.en: I bought my home eight years ago, reduced the principal owed on my mortgage and built up a sizeable buffer of offset savings, much of it over the four years post-COVID when I was on a 1.89 per cent fixed mortgage rate.
paras.zh: 我八年前买了房子，减少了抵押贷款本金，并积累了相当大的抵消储蓄缓冲，其中大部分是在新冠疫情发生后的四年里积累的，当时我的固定抵押贷款利率为 1.89%。

paras.en: Two of the authors of the RBA's 2016 research, Gianni La Cava and Greg Kaplan, were among those who recently published a paper showing how financial buffers significantly altered the spending response of borrowers to interest rate rises, potentially blunting the cash flow channel of monetary policy.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚央行 2016 年研究的两位作者詹尼·拉卡瓦 (Gianni La Cava) 和格雷格·卡普兰 (Greg Kaplan) 最近发表了一篇论文，展示金融缓冲如何显着改变借款人对利率上升的支出反应，从而可能削弱货币政策的现金流渠道。

paras.en: In plain English, people like me who built up a lot of savings in our offset accounts and redraw facilities during the low-rate, big stimulus period of the COVID pandemic aren't yet cutting our spending in response to rate rises, because we don't need to.
paras.zh: 简而言之，像我这样在新冠病毒大流行的低利率、大规模刺激时期在抵消账户中积累了大量储蓄并重新提取设施的人还没有削减我们的支出以应对加息，因为我们不需要这样做。

paras.en: When you add us to the group of mainly older Australians benefiting from higher interest rates, it leaves a very narrow group of people carrying the burden of the cash flow channel of monetary policy.
paras.zh: 当你把我们加入到受益于高利率的澳大利亚老年人群体中时，就会发现只有一小部分人承担着货币政策现金流渠道的负担。

paras.en: These are generally the younger, more recent home purchasers, with the biggest mortgages, the smallest financial buffers, and often the youngest kids, meaning less flexibility to pick up extra work.
paras.zh: 这些人通常是更年轻、最近购房的人，拥有最大的抵押贷款、最小的财务缓冲，而且通常是最小的孩子，这意味着承担额外工作的灵活性较小。

paras.en: This shows up in that 2025 RBA research, which suggests it is households in the middle of the wealth distribution, and those with mortgages at the lower and middle of the income distribution, who suffer the biggest hit to their cashflows from rising interest rates.
paras.zh: 这一点在 2025 年澳洲联储的研究中得到了体现，该研究表明，处于财富分配中间的家庭以及收入分配中下层和中间有抵押贷款的家庭，因利率上升而遭受的现金流打击最大。

paras.en: Most households at the lower end of the income scale are either renters or retirees who have already paid off their home, while households at the upper end of incomes are generally able to absorb the cost of higher mortgage repayments and have more options to trim discretionary spending.
paras.zh: 大多数收入较低的家庭要么是租房者，要么是已经还清住房贷款的退休人员，而收入较高的家庭通常能够承担更高的抵押贷款还款成本，并且有更多选择来削减可自由支配的支出。

paras.en: When you look through the studies, no amount of central bank spin can sugar-coat the reality that middle-class mortgage borrowers, many with kids, are bearing the financial brunt of the fight against inflation.
paras.zh: 当你仔细研究这些研究时，你会发现，央行的任何花言巧语都无法粉饰这样一个现实：中产阶级抵押贷款借款人（其中许多人有孩子）在对抗通胀的过程中首当其冲。

paras.en: "That cash flow channel, it is a blunt tool. And it's really tricky," the RBA's chief economist Sarah Hunter recently acknowledged on a personal finance podcast.
paras.zh: “现金流渠道是一个生硬的工具。而且真的很棘手，”澳大利亚央行首席经济学家莎拉·亨特最近在个人理财播客上承认。

paras.en: "And we know some people, especially if you're a first-time buyer and you've stretched yourself a bit to get on the ladder in the first place, and then interest rates go up, that's really tough. We know."
paras.zh: “我们认识一些人，特别是如果你是首次购房者，你一开始就竭尽全力才登上阶梯，然后利率上升，这真的很艰难。我们知道。”

paras.en: Michael Janda is the ABC's business editor.
paras.zh: 迈克尔·詹达 (Michael Janda) 是美国广播公司 (ABC) 的商业编辑。

articles.title: Disunity is death, but can the federal government rein in the blame game?
articles.author: Patricia Karvelas

paras.en: The problem with delivering a searing political take-down in the modern era is the ease with which it can come back to haunt you. That is the diabolical predicament dogging Treasurer Jim Chalmers.
paras.zh: 在当今时代，要进行一场激烈的政治镇压，问题在于它很容易再次困扰你。这就是财务主管吉姆·查默斯 (Jim Chalmers) 所面临的恶魔般的困境。

paras.en: As shadow treasurer, Chalmers accused then-prime minister Scott Morrison of having "an excuse for everything and a plan for nothing".
paras.zh: 作为影子财长，查尔默斯指责时任总理斯科特·莫里森“为所有事情找借口，却没有计划”。

paras.en: "When things are going well in the economy he takes all of the credit, and when times are tough in the economy he takes none of the responsibility," he said in 2022 after the Reserve Bank lifted interest rates for the first time in more than a decade.
paras.zh: 2022 年，在储备银行十多年来首次加息后，他表示：“当经济形势良好时，他获得了所有的功劳，而当经济困难时，他则不承担任何责任。”

paras.en: Now, if rates go up again on Tuesday, as widely tipped, there will have been 17 interest rate rises by the RBA since Labor came to office. To be fair, there were also three cuts in 2025.
paras.zh: 现在，如果周二利率再次像普遍预期的那样上调，那么自工党上台以来，澳洲联储将进行 17 次加息。公平地说，2025 年还进行了 3 次削减。

paras.en: Chalmers attacked the Coalition government for the higher repayments Australians faced, with the following line: "If only you could pay your mortgage with Scott Morrison's excuses."
paras.zh: 查尔默斯攻击联合政府让澳大利亚人面临更高的还款额，他说：“如果你能以斯科特·莫里森的借口偿还抵押贷款就好了。”

paras.en: Now his critics are replaying those attack lines against him, as evidence of hypocrisy. Social media clips feature his attacks on Morrison and contrast them with Chalmers currently pointing to global pressures for spiking inflation.
paras.zh: 现在，他的批评者正在重述这些针对他的攻击言论，作为虚伪的证据。社交媒体剪辑中展示了他对莫里森的攻击，并将其与查尔默斯目前指出的全球通胀压力进行了对比。

paras.en: But it is not just the economic numbers worrying the government.
paras.zh: 但令政府担忧的不仅仅是经济数据。

paras.en: Yesterday, Finance Minister Katy Gallagher appeared on Insiders and did her best to dismiss claims of internal party tensions.
paras.zh: 昨天，财政部长凯蒂·加拉格尔 (Katy Gallagher) 出现在 Insiders 节目中，并尽力驳斥有关党内紧张局势的说法。

paras.en: Labor insiders were in despair over a media report last Friday suggesting Chalmers wanted to go harder on cutting spending, only to be blocked by the PM's allies on the government's Expenditure Review Committee (ERC).
paras.zh: 上周五媒体报道称查尔默斯希望加大力度削减开支，但遭到总理在政府支出审查委员会（ERC）的盟友的阻挠，工党内部人士对此感到绝望。

paras.en: Gallagher, who is a member of the ERC and also a key part of the PM's praetorian guard, has long been known by those in Canberra as crucial to bridging relations between Albanese and Chalmers.
paras.zh: 加拉格尔是欧洲委员会的成员，也是总理禁卫军的重要组成部分，长期以来一直被堪培拉人士认为对于弥合阿尔巴尼亚和查尔默斯之间的关系至关重要。

paras.en: She dismissed suggestions of tension between the two, describing their working relationship as professional, saying individuals come at things from "slightly different perspectives."
paras.zh: 她驳斥了两人之间关系紧张的说法，称他们的工作关系是专业的，并表示个人看待事物的角度“略有不同”。

paras.en: Those slightly different perspectives are now the source of feverish speculation.
paras.zh: 这些略有不同的观点现在成为狂热猜测的根源。

paras.en: While Chalmers last week told media outlets he owned his share of responsibility for decision-making, Gallagher emphasised she was part of the government's economic team and also had the job of saying no to her colleagues.
paras.zh: 虽然查尔默斯上周告诉媒体，他对决策负有自己的部分责任，但加拉格尔强调，她是政府经济团队的一员，也有责任向同事说“不”。

paras.en: Her message was clear: it wasn't just Chalmers blocking spending requests from ministers hungry for more money — she too was a blocker of largesse.
paras.zh: 她的信息很明确：查默斯不仅阻止了渴望更多资金的部长们的支出请求，而且她也阻止了慷慨。

paras.en: Pushing back against a growing narrative that Labor is a high-spending government, Gallagher made the point that they are governing in a very different world from Howard and other past governments.
paras.zh: 加拉格尔反驳了越来越多的关于工党是一个高支出政府的说法，他指出，他们正在统治一个与霍华德和其他过去的政府截然不同的世界。

paras.en: "There should be some acknowledgement of the world in which we are living. NDIS, AUKUS, defence, aged care and interest on government debt; all of these continue to be significant pressures," she said.
paras.zh: “应该对我们生活的世界有所认识。NDIS、AUKUS、国防、老年护理和政府债务利息；所有这些仍然是巨大的压力，”她说。

paras.en: "We can't pretend these pressures on the budget aren't coming."
paras.zh: “我们不能假装这些预算压力不会到来。”

paras.en: Gallagher's comments offer two insights into the government.
paras.zh: 加拉格尔的评论提供了对政府的两点见解。

paras.en: The first, her pivot to talking about circumstances now being more challenging and complex than past governments have endured, is sensible, reflects the reality and demonstrates that Labor knows voters are fed up with the government continuing to blame far-off conflicts for cost-of-living pressures.
paras.zh: 首先，她谈到现在的情况比过去的政府所经历的更具挑战性和复杂性，这是明智的，反映了现实，并表明工党知道选民厌倦了政府继续将生活成本压力归咎于遥远的冲突。

paras.en: More telling, though, were Gallagher's attempts to downplay division in Labor; she was out this weekend to hose down the raging fire of division talk.
paras.zh: 不过，更能说明问题的是加拉格尔试图淡化工党内部的分裂。她这个周末出去平息了分裂言论的熊熊烈火。

paras.en: While Chalmers rejected any link to last week's media story about him wanting to deliver a more austere set of cuts, his colleagues have told this column they are not convinced.
paras.zh: 虽然查尔默斯拒绝与上周媒体报道有关他希望实施更严厉的削减计划的任何联系，但他的同事告诉本专栏，他们并不相信。

paras.en: They see it as an attempt to distance him from the government's big spending that is under scrutiny for putting pressure on inflation.
paras.zh: 他们认为这是试图让他与政府的巨额支出保持距离，政府因对通胀施加压力而受到审查。

paras.en: The thing about stories like this is they become process stories — who is doing the leaking and who is trying to undermine whom?
paras.zh: 像这样的故事的问题是它们变成了过程故事——谁在泄密，谁在试图破坏谁？

paras.en: The premium the prime minister had on unity is eroding, because even if they are sporadic, process stories about internal issues show the media and opposition there is trouble within.
paras.zh: 总理对团结的重视正在减弱，因为即使这些事件是零星的，有关内部问题的过程报道也向媒体和反对派表明内部存在麻烦。

paras.en: Once this narrative starts to take hold, tensions around the cabinet table become more of a focus than the policy problems before them.
paras.zh: 一旦这种说法开始站稳脚跟，内阁会议上的紧张局势就会比摆在他们面前的政策问题更受关注。

paras.en: Who leaked what and when is relevant and irrelevant in equal measure. The main problem is that a government that had prided itself on unity — one of Albanese's strongest commodities — is suddenly not looking very unified.
paras.zh: 谁泄露了什么以及何时泄露的内容同样重要和无关。主要问题是，一个曾经以团结而自豪的政府——阿尔巴尼亚最强大的商品之一——突然看起来不太团结。

paras.en: As households continue to grapple with power prices and the cost of groceries and petrol, the government appearing to focus on who said what and where is the quickest way to alienate voters.
paras.zh: 随着家庭继续努力应对电价以及食品杂货和汽油的成本，政府似乎关注谁说了什么以及在哪里是疏远选民的最快方式。

paras.en: Disunity is death for any government, and those in power know this political reality.
paras.zh: 对于任何政府来说，不团结就是死亡，当权者知道这个政治现实。

paras.en: Can the creeping disunity narrative be put back in the box now? If the government's senior ministers don't find a way to shut it down, the problems will only grow, and the government will lose any chance of taking control of the story about how it plans to fix the country's economic woes.
paras.zh: 现在可以把这种逐渐不团结的叙述放回盒子里吗？如果政府的高级部长找不到关闭它的方法，问题只会越来越严重，政府将失去控制有关其计划如何解决国家经济困境的故事的任何机会。

paras.en: Victorians will go to the polls at the end of this month. With Labor on track for a defeat, federal MPs are keen to ensure this election is characterised as a referendum on the 12-year reign of Daniel Andrews and his successors.
paras.zh: 维多利亚州民众将于本月底前往投票站。由于工党即将失败，联邦议员们迫切希望确保这次选举成为对丹尼尔·安德鲁斯及其继任者 12 年统治的全民公投。

paras.en: They will not want any blame to be attached to the broader economic malaise facing households.
paras.zh: 他们不希望将任何责任归咎于家庭面临的更广泛的经济不景气。

paras.en: But with process stories starting to appear in the media, a catastrophic Labor result in Victoria will only further stoke tensions in its federal ranks.
paras.zh: 但随着过程故事开始出现在媒体上，维多利亚州工党灾难性的结果只会进一步加剧联邦队伍中的紧张局势。

paras.en: A loss in Victoria might be easy to blame on the state government, its governance failures and other scandals. But with New South Wales going to the polls in March, it will be harder for federal Labor to park a second bad result squarely with the state.
paras.zh: 维多利亚州的失败很容易归咎于州政府、其治理失败和其他丑闻。但随着新南威尔士州将于三月份进行投票，联邦工党将更难将第二次糟糕的结果直接归咎于该州。

paras.en: The fancy Birdcage at Flemington is where politicians used to go on Melbourne Cup Day to wear fancy outfits and have a punt.
paras.zh: 弗莱明顿 (Flemington) 的鸟笼 (Bircage) 是政客们过去在墨尔本杯日 (Melbourne Cup Day) 穿着华丽服装并下注的地方。

paras.en: It will be a brave politician who goes near the races on Tuesday when the RBA delivers a decision expected to put another handbrake on Australian households.
paras.zh: 周二，澳洲联储将做出一项决定，预计将再次给澳大利亚家庭踩刹车，这将是一位勇敢的政客。

paras.en: Patricia Karvelas is host of ABC News Afternoon Briefing at 4pm weekdays on ABC News Channel, co-host of the weekly Party Room podcast with Fran Kelly and host of politics and news podcast Politics Now.
paras.zh: 帕特里夏·卡维拉斯 (Patricia Karvelas) 是 ABC 新闻频道工作日下午 4 点的 ABC 新闻下午简报主持人，与 Fran Kelly 共同主持每周 Party Room 播客，以及政治和新闻播客 Politics Now 的主持人。

articles.title: Prince Harry says he wants to reconcile with the Royal Family. It may not be so easy
articles.author: Janet Davison

paras.en: Prince Harry says he wants to reconcile with the Royal Family. It may not be so easy
paras.zh: 哈里王子表示他希望与王室和解。可能没那么容易

paras.en: Duke of Sussex sending public signals he wants to overcome rift
paras.zh: 苏塞克斯公爵发出公开信号，他希望克服分歧

paras.en: As far as open appeals go, it couldn’t be much clearer: Prince Harry wants a rapprochement with the Royal Family.
paras.zh: 就公开呼吁而言，再清楚不过了：哈里王子希望与王室和解。

paras.en: After several years of estrangement — particularly from elder brother Prince William — the Duke of Sussex has taken to sending public signals of a desire to overcome the discord.
paras.zh: 经过几年的疏远——尤其是与哥哥威廉王子的疏远——苏塞克斯公爵开始向公众发出希望克服不和的信号。

paras.en: The most recent came in an interview with GQ magazine, where he was asked about the "complicated relationship" he has with William and their father, King Charles.
paras.zh: 最近一次是在接受《GQ》杂志采访时，他被问及与威廉及其父亲查尔斯国王的“复杂关系”。

paras.en: "With everything else that's going on in the world, the most important thing is to reconcile. That's the key point," Harry said.
paras.zh: “对于世界上正在发生的所有其他事情，最重要的是和解。这是关键点，”哈利说。

paras.en: As much as Harry may signal the desire to reconcile, making it happen could be a challenge.
paras.zh: 尽管哈利可能表达出和解的愿望，但实现和解可能是一个挑战。

paras.en: "I think on a personal level, King Charles III will want to spend time with his grandchildren, so I can see a personal reconciliation happening on that level," Toronto-based royal author and historian Carolyn Harris said in an interview.
paras.zh: 多伦多王室作家兼历史学家卡罗琳·哈里斯在接受采访时表示：“我认为，在个人层面上，国王查尔斯三世希望与他的孙子们共度时光，因此我可以看到个人和解正在发生。”

paras.en: Harry arrives to visit the Community Recording Studio in Nottingham, central England, on Oct. 15. (Joe Giddens/AFP/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 10 月 15 日，哈利抵达英格兰中部诺丁汉参观社区录音室。（Joe Giddens/法新社/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: "In the wider Royal Family, it seems very unlikely that a reconciliation will take place, because of all the events that have unfolded over the past six years."
paras.zh: “由于过去六年发生的所有事件，在更广泛的王室中，和解似乎不太可能发生。”

paras.en: Harry and his wife, Meghan, Duchess of Sussex, stepped back as working members of the Royal Family in 2020 and moved to California.
paras.zh: 哈里和他的妻子苏塞克斯公爵夫人梅根于 2020 年不再担任王室工作成员，并搬到了加利福尼亚州。

paras.en: During their time in the U.S., a Netflix docuseries, an interview with Oprah Winfrey and Harry's memoir Spare offered a panoply of their views, including pointed criticism of the Royal Family. Harry and Meghan returned to the U.K. with their two children in August.
paras.zh: 他们在美国期间，Netflix 的一部纪录片、奥普拉·温弗瑞的采访以及哈利的回忆录《Spare》提供了他们的全部观点，包括对王室的尖锐批评。哈里和梅根于八月带着两个孩子返回英国。

paras.en: - Royal Fascinator Prince Harry told his story in his own words. But what happens now?
paras.zh: - 皇家迷惑者哈里王子用自己的话讲述了他的故事。但现在会发生什么？

paras.en: - What we learned from Netflix's docuseries about Prince Harry and Meghan Markle
paras.zh: - 我们从 Netflix 的关于哈里王子和梅根·马克尔的系列纪录片中学到了什么

paras.en: Buckingham Palace and the King have made it clear they remain non-working royals, but Harry and Meghan have been at public engagements that for the average passerby would look very similar to regular royal events.
paras.zh: 白金汉宫和国王已明确表示，他们仍然是非工作的王室成员，但哈里和梅根一直在参加公开活动，对于普通路人来说，这看起来与常规的王室活动非常相似。

paras.en: "You're hearing things like what was in the Sunday Times the other week that they don't like the term 'working royal' and that they consider themselves to be royals who work," said Craig Prescott, a constitutional expert and lecturer in law at Royal Holloway.
paras.zh: 宪法专家、皇家霍洛威学院法学讲师克雷格·普雷斯科特说：“你会听到像前一周《星期日泰晤士报》上报道的那样，他们不喜欢‘王室工作’这个词，他们认为自己是工作的王室成员。”

paras.en: "So it's all … quite confusing in some way, because if you wanted to seek reconciliation with the broader Royal Family, don't let it come out that you don't like the term that defines them rather than you."
paras.zh: “所以这一切……在某种程度上相当令人困惑，因为如果你想寻求与更广泛的王室和解，不要让别人知道你不喜欢这个定义他们而不是你的词。”

paras.en: Meghan, Duchess of Sussex, centre, and Harry, right, visit Himmah Hub, a food poverty charity, during their time in Nottingham, England, on Oct. 15. (Annabel Lee-Ellis/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 10 月 15 日，苏塞克斯公爵夫人梅根（中）和哈里（右）在英国诺丁汉期间参观了食品贫困慈善机构 Himmah Hub。（Annabel Lee-Ellis/Getty Images）

paras.en: Making the latest overture in public could also have an impact on its effectiveness.
paras.zh: 公开提出最新的提议也可能对其有效性产生影响。

paras.en: "The more that Prince Harry speaks to the press, the less likely it is that a reconciliation … will take place, as there are likely concerns among his wider family that if they do meet with Prince Harry, he will speak of it in future interviews," Harris said.
paras.zh: 哈里斯说：“哈里王子向媒体发表的讲话越多，和解的可能性就越小，因为他的家人可能担心，如果他们真的与哈里王子会面，他会在未来的采访中谈到这件事。”

paras.en: In a way, Prescott suggested, Harry and Meghan are trying to achieve private things by going public.
paras.zh: 普雷斯科特认为，在某种程度上，哈里和梅根试图通过公开来实现私人目标。

paras.en: "Generally, that's not how the monarchy works."
paras.zh: “一般来说，君主制不是这样运作的。”

paras.en: "The monarchy has always tried to keep a … distinction [between the private and public roles], and William, I think, is very keen on that distinction," Prescott said.
paras.zh: “君主制一直试图保持……[私人和公共角色之间的]区别，我认为威廉非常热衷于这种区别，”普雷斯科特说。

paras.en: William, Prescott noted, "talks about going to work."
paras.zh: 普雷斯科特指出，威廉“谈论去工作”。

paras.en: "And so the whole way Harry has gone about this is almost an anathema to how William wants to do this."
paras.zh: “因此，哈利所做的一切几乎是对威廉想要这样做的诅咒。”

paras.en: Harry, left, Prince William, centre, their father the then-Prince of Wales Charles, and David Attenborough attend the global premiere for Our Planet at the Natural History Museum in London on April 4, 2019. (John Sibley/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 哈里（左）、威廉王子（中）、他们的父亲、当时的威尔士亲王查尔斯和大卫·阿滕伯勒出席 2019 年 4 月 4 日在伦敦自然历史博物馆举行的《我们的星球》全球首映式。（约翰·西布利/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: Rifts among royals are nothing new. Sometimes, rapprochement has indeed followed.
paras.zh: 王室成员之间的裂痕并不是什么新鲜事。有时，和解确实随之而来。

paras.en: "During the medieval period, there was a kind of formal ceremony of reconciliation," said Harris.
paras.zh: “在中世纪时期，有一种正式的和解仪式，”哈里斯说。

paras.en: "There were so many conflicts between royal fathers and sons, royal brothers, that there would be a big show of forgiveness … often facilitated by royal women who were seen as peacemakers."
paras.zh: “王室父子、王室兄弟之间存在如此多的冲突，以至于会表现出巨大的宽恕……通常是由被视为和平缔造者的王室女性促成的。”

paras.en: More recently, one of the more notable rifts came between King Edward VIII and the Royal Family after his abdication in 1936.
paras.zh: 最近，爱德华八世国王 1936 年退位后与王室之间出现了最引人注目的分歧之一。

paras.en: "He was very much out and stayed out for the rest of his life," said Prescott.
paras.zh: 普雷斯科特说：“他非常喜欢外出，并且在余生中一直待在外面。”

paras.en: Of course, there are differences, given that Edward was a former King.
paras.zh: 当然，考虑到爱德华是前国王，还是有差异的。

paras.en: King Edward VIII, left, followed by Albert, the Duke of York, during a visit to Scotland in 1936. Edward abdicated on Dec. 10, 1936. He was succeeded by the duke, who became King George VI. (Fox Photos/Hulton Archive/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 1936 年，爱德华八世国王（左）和约克公爵阿尔伯特跟随其后。爱德华于 1936 年 12 月 10 日退位。公爵继位，成为国王乔治六世。 （福克斯照片/赫尔顿档案馆/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: "You had a very young Queen [Elizabeth] and you had a middle-aged [former] King, and there was always perhaps a concern in the early days of there being a rival court that never really materialized," said Prescott.
paras.zh: 普雷斯科特说：“有一位非常年轻的女王（伊丽莎白），还有一位中年的（前）国王，早期人们可能总是担心存在一个从未真正出现过的竞争对手宫廷。”

paras.en: "But with Harry, it's of course a little bit different. He's only the son of the King, not a former King. But you can still see that, in a sense, if you're in, you're in, if you're out, you're out."
paras.zh: “但对于哈利来说，情况当然有点不同。他只是国王的儿子，而不是前国王。但你仍然可以看到，从某种意义上说，如果你进来了，你就进来了，如果你出去了，你就出去了。”

paras.en: Harry's situation has also spawned its own rarity in the royal annals, one that comes with its own bit of irony — it appears to have bolstered the relationship between two other members of the family.
paras.zh: 哈里的处境也在王室编年史中产生了罕见的现象，这本身就带有一点讽刺意味——它似乎加强了家族其他两名成员之间的关系。

paras.en: The conflict with Harry has brought William and the King closer together, Harris said.
paras.zh: 哈里斯说，与哈里的冲突使威廉和国王的关系更加亲密。

paras.en: "Prince Harry's admitted royal history is not something he's particularly interested in," she said, "but when we do look at the sweep of royal history, it's rare for a monarch and an adult heir to be on the same page in this manner."
paras.zh: “哈里王子承认的王室历史并不是他特别感兴趣的事情，”她说，“但当我们真正审视王室历史时，发现君主和成年继承人以这种方式达成一致是很少见的。”

paras.en: An acknowledgment of 'suffering' but no apology — yet
paras.zh: 承认“痛苦”但没有道歉——但

paras.en: Charles, centre, joins a Junkanoo parade in Parliament Square in Nassau on Wednesday during his visit to the Bahamas. (Ben Stansall/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 查尔斯（中）周三在访问巴哈马期间参加了拿骚议会广场的贾卡努游行。 （本·斯坦索尔/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: As the King set off for his Caribbean visit this past week, much attention focused on how he would address the devastating impacts of the transatlantic slave trade and calls for an apology and reparations from the British government.
paras.zh: 当国王上周启程前往加勒比海访问时，人们的注意力集中在他将如何解决跨大西洋奴隶贸易的破坏性影响，并呼吁英国政府道歉和赔偿。

paras.en: On his first stop in the Bahamas, he acknowledged "the great suffering and injustices of the past in these islands and beyond."
paras.zh: 在巴哈马的第一站，他承认“这些岛屿及其他地区过去遭受的巨大苦难和不公正”。

paras.en: Buckingham Palace called the first stop of his three-country visit a "diplomatic success," but others felt Charles didn't go far enough.
paras.zh: 白金汉宫称他的三个国家访问的第一站是“外交成功”，但其他人认为查尔斯走得还不够远。

paras.en: "Acknowledgement is like when somebody hits your car and says, 'Oh, I'm sorry.' But the apology is when they hit your car, and say, 'I am sorry, and here's my insurance.' It's the difference between recognizing that something bad has happened and holding yourself accountable for it," Niambi Hall Campbell-Dean, chair of the Bahamas National Reparations Committee, told As It Happens host Nil Köksal.
paras.zh: “致谢就像有人撞了你的车并说，‘哦，对不起。’”但道歉是当他们撞了你的车，然后说：“对不起，这是我的保险。”巴哈马国家赔偿委员会主席尼安比·霍尔·坎贝尔-迪恩 (Niambi Hall Campbell-Dean) 告诉《发生的事情》节目主持人尼尔·科克萨尔 (Nil Köksal)，这就是承认发生了不好的事情和让自己为此负责之间的区别。

paras.en: "We need accountability. We don't just need statements of regret. Because we know that slavery was a bad thing. Everybody knows that slavery is a bad thing."
paras.zh: “我们需要问责制。我们不仅仅需要遗憾的声明。因为我们知道奴隶制是一件坏事。每个人都知道奴隶制是一件坏事。”

paras.en: King Charles, right, walks on a wooden boardwalk through the mangrove ecosystem at Bonefish Pond National Park in New Providence, during his visit to the Bahamas on Wednesday. (Isabel Infantes/AFP/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 周三访问巴哈马期间，查尔斯国王（右）在新普罗维登斯北梭鱼池国家公园的木板路上行走，穿过红树林生态系统。 （伊莎贝尔·因方特斯/法新社/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: Anything Charles says as the visit continues, particularly at the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting [CHOGM] in Antigua and Barbuda this coming week, will be under continued scrutiny, especially in light of a shift in the British government's position on the issue on Friday.
paras.zh: 随着访问的继续，特别是在下周于安提瓜和巴布达举行的英联邦政府首脑会议[CHOGM]上，查尔斯所说的任何话都将受到持续的审查，特别是考虑到英国政府周五在该问题上立场的转变。

paras.en: Writing in The Guardian newspaper, Prime Minister Andy Burnham said he is open to calls for a formal apology for Britain's historical role in slavery. He rejected calls for financial reparations, but said he wanted to "launch a new drive on debt," including by helping more vulnerable countries "repay over a longer time period and with better rates."
paras.zh: 英国首相安迪·伯纳姆在《卫报》上撰文表示，他愿意接受就英国在奴隶制历史上扮演的角色正式道歉的呼声。他拒绝了经济赔偿的要求，但表示他希望“启动新的债务驱动力”，包括帮助更脆弱的国家“在更长的时间内以更好的利率偿还债务”。

paras.en: Burnham's statement "is clearly a big development," Prescott said, "and signifies a clear softening in the U.K. government’s stance."
paras.zh: 普雷斯科特说，伯纳姆的声明“显然是一个重大进展”，“意味着英国政府的立场明显软化。”

paras.en: For Charles, Prescott said, this "very much takes the heat off him."
paras.zh: 普雷斯科特说，对于查尔斯来说，这“大大减轻了他的热情”。

paras.en: "Up to now, the calls had been on the King to make an apology, which he would not do however loud those demands became, because ... it's not the government's position and ... of the possibility of opening the door to financial reparations."
paras.zh: “到目前为止，人们一直呼吁国王道歉，但无论这些要求多么大声，他都不会这样做，因为……这不是政府的立场，而且……有可能为经济赔偿打开大门。”

paras.en: - King Charles acknowledges 'painful' past amid calls for Commonwealth discussions on reparations
paras.zh: - 查尔斯国王在呼吁英联邦讨论赔偿问题时承认“痛苦”的过去

paras.en: - King Charles's predecessors abetted the slave trade, and research aims to show what they knew
paras.zh: - 查尔斯国王的前任怂恿奴隶贸易，研究旨在展示他们所知道的事情

paras.en: Burnham's statement has, Prescott said, shown there is room for some movement — he's opened the door to an apology, but ultimately on the condition that calls for financial reparations are dropped and the focus shifts to other avenues, such as debt forbearance or extending repayments.
paras.zh: 普雷斯科特表示，伯纳姆的声明表明还有采取行动的空间——他为道歉打开了大门，但最终条件是放弃要求经济赔偿的要求，并将焦点转移到其他途径，例如债务减免或延长还款期限。

paras.en: "He has opened the door for political discussion and so that takes the focus away from the King to the politicians to potentially reach an agreement," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“他打开了政治讨论的大门，因此焦点从国王转移到了政治家身上，有可能达成协议。”

paras.en: "This is likely to dominate the CHOGM, and the King will refer to this, and perhaps support those efforts to reach an agreement, but the focus is taken away from him."
paras.zh: “这很可能会主导 CHOGM，国王会参考这一点，也许还会支持这些达成协议的努力，但焦点已经从他身上转移了。”

paras.en: In the Bahamas, Charles appeared to receive a warm welcome, and garnered headlines for dancing in a street parade.
paras.zh: 在巴哈马，查尔斯似乎受到了热烈的欢迎，并因在街头游行中跳舞而成为头条新闻。

paras.en: "King Charles has been well-received in the Bahamas and in Guyana and has shown a strong interest in engaging with both public figures at official events and the enthusiastic crowds who have gathered to greet him," Harris said.
paras.zh: 哈里斯说：“查尔斯国王在巴哈马和圭亚那受到了热烈欢迎，并且对与官方活动中的公众人物以及聚集在一起迎接他的热情人群表现出浓厚的兴趣。”

paras.en: "The King clearly enjoyed joining in the festivities in the Bahamas."
paras.zh: “国王显然很喜欢参加巴哈马的庆祝活动。”

paras.en: Charles, right, speaks with a local artisan who makes baskets in Parliament Square in Nassau on Wednesday. (Ben Stansall/AFP/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 周三，查尔斯（右）在拿骚议会广场与当地一位制作篮子的工匠交谈。 （本·斯坦索尔/法新社/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: He also met with local boxers, and as is usual for his visits, spent some time focusing on local environmental issues.
paras.zh: 他还会见了当地拳击手，并像往常一样，花了一些时间关注当地的环境问题。

paras.en: From the Bahamas, Charles travelled to Guyana, where on Friday he undertook numerous engagements, including a visit to the Commonwealth War Graves. He also visited Independence Park, which marks the place where public executions occurred after the Demerara Slave Rebellion of 1823.
paras.zh: 查尔斯从巴哈马前往圭亚那，周五他在那里进行了多次活动，包括参观英联邦战争坟墓。他还参观了独立公园，这里是 1823 年德梅拉拉奴隶叛乱后公开处决的地方。

paras.en: King Charles, second from left, visits Independence Park, which marks the site of public executions following the 1823 Demerara Slave Rebellion, in Georgetown, Guyana, on Friday. (Isabel Infantes/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 周五，查尔斯国王（左二）参观了圭亚那乔治敦的独立公园，这里是 1823 年德梅拉拉奴隶叛乱后公开处决的地点。 （伊莎贝尔·因方特斯/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: He attended a biodiversity conference, met Indigenous leaders, attended a business reception and visited the Kingston Seawall. At the beach, he heard about efforts to restore mangrove ecosystems along the coastline.
paras.zh: 他参加了生物多样性会议，会见了土著领导人，参加了商务招待会并参观了金斯敦海堤。在海滩上，他听说了恢复海岸线红树林生态系统的努力。

paras.en: Charles arrived in Antigua and Barbuda on Friday night, and will deliver the opening address at CHOGM on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 查尔斯于周五晚上抵达安提瓜和巴布达，并将于周二在 CHOGM 发表开幕致辞。

paras.en: Prince William visits Lower Blakemere Farm, a Duchy Focus Farm, in Hereford, England, earlier this year. Plans by William's Duchy of Cornwall to sell land to raise money for other projects, including ones that focus on homelessness and climate change, have sparked controversy in Devon, in southern England. (Jacob King/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，威廉王子参观了位于英国赫里福德的下布莱克米尔农场，这是一个公国重点农场。威廉康沃尔公爵领地计划出售土地为其他项目筹集资金，其中包括关注无家可归和气候变化的项目，这在英格兰南部的德文郡引发了争议。 （雅各布·金/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: The headlines focused on Prince William in the past few days were a study in contrast, from the rousing welcome he received for a talk show appearance to controversy swirling around his Duchy of Cornwall's plans to sell land, leaving tenant farmers feeling betrayed.
paras.zh: 过去几天关注威廉王子的头条新闻则形成鲜明对比，从他因参加脱口秀而受到的热烈欢迎，到围绕他的康沃尔公爵领地出售土地的计划引发的争议，让佃农感到被背叛。

paras.en: "Once Harry and Meghan returned to the United Kingdom, there was speculation that the headlines would be all about Harry and Meghan, but as heir to the throne, Prince William is attracting headlines as well," Harris said.
paras.zh: 哈里斯说：“哈里斯和梅根回到英国后，有人猜测头条新闻将全是关于哈里和梅根的，但作为王位继承人，威廉王子也吸引了头条新闻。”

paras.en: William’s appearance on The Graham Norton Show came as a surprise to the audience as he promoted his Earthshot Prize environmental initiative. While on Norton's red couch, he offered up some chat show banter, with mentions of everything from his family's love of the TV show The Celebrity Traitors to how as a child he thought it was "quite cool" to be a police officer.
paras.zh: 威廉在格雷厄姆·诺顿秀上的亮相让观众感到惊讶，因为他宣传了他的“地球射击奖”环保倡议。在诺顿的红色沙发上，他开起了一些脱口秀玩笑，提到了从家人对电视节目《名人叛徒》的喜爱，到小时候他认为成为一名警察“相当酷”的一切。

paras.en: "He showed himself to be really relaxed," Prescott said, although he noted that he's not the first royal to do a talk show, with Princess Anne going on with BBC host Terry Wogan in the 1980s.
paras.zh: “他表现得非常放松，”普雷斯科特说，尽管他指出自己并不是第一个做脱口秀节目的皇室成员，安妮公主在 20 世纪 80 年代曾与 BBC 主持人特里·沃根 (Terry Wogan) 进行过脱口秀节目。

paras.en: "It's not unheard of, but it is more unusual today."
paras.zh: “这并非闻所未闻，但今天更不寻常。”

paras.en: The Duchy story struck a markedly different tone, with the headline in the Observer being: "'Charles was fantastic. William can go to hell': Duchy tenants face eviction as prince sells historic land."
paras.zh: 公国的故事却有着明显不同的基调，《观察家报》的标题是：“‘查尔斯太棒了。威廉可以下地狱’：因为王子出售历史悠久的土地，公国租户面临被驱逐。”

paras.en: That report focused on plans by the Duchy of Cornwall to sell land to raise money for other projects, including ones that focus on homelessness and climate change, two priorities for William.
paras.zh: 该报告重点关注康沃尔公爵领地出售土地为其他项目筹集资金的计划，其中包括关注无家可归和气候变化的项目，这是威廉的两个优先事项。

paras.en: "There has been some controversy surrounding his determination to sell off parts of the Duchy of Cornwall," said Harris, "as a sale of this kind can only be done once, and the Duchy of Cornwall was intended by King Edward III to provide an income for the heir to the throne. So the question arises: What if Prince George, when he comes of age, has different views?"
paras.zh: 哈里斯说：“围绕他出售康沃尔公国部分地区的决定存在一些争议，因为这种出售只能进行一次，而康沃尔公国的目的是爱德华三世国王为王位继承人提供收入。所以问题来了：如果乔治王子成年后有不同的看法怎么办？”

paras.en: Prince William, right, meets Harry Davies, centre, the incoming tenant of the Duchy of Cornwall's first regenerative Farm Business Tenancy, during a visit to examine the role of regenerative farming in climate resilience on Oct. 1 in Hereford, England. The Prince of Wales visited to region to meet with those tackling the threat of flooding caused by extreme weather conditions. (Mathieu Willcocks/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 10 月 1 日，威廉王子（右）在英国赫里福德访问考察再生农业在气候适应能力中的作用时，会见了康沃尔公爵领地第一个再生农场商业租赁的新租户哈里·戴维斯（中）。威尔士亲王访问了该地区，会见了那些应对极端天气条件造成的洪水威胁的人们。 （马修·威尔科克斯/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: Prescott said the land sale situation is a difficult one, particularly given the nature of the relationship between landlords and tenants.
paras.zh: 普雷斯科特表示，土地出售的情况很困难，特别是考虑到房东和租户之间关系的性质。

paras.en: "The landlord has the power and the tenant doesn't," he said.
paras.zh: “房东有权力，而租客没有，”他说。

paras.en: "Intuitively, your sympathies are with the farmers, but this is where it just rubs up against the law and someone being a landlord."
paras.zh: “直觉上，你同情农民，但这就是它与法律和某人作为房东发生冲突的地方。”

paras.en: "Hearts, far from this valley, will ache with yours. Tears, from those who remember and those who at the time were not yet born, will be shed with yours."
paras.zh: “远离这个山谷的心将与你的心一起疼痛。那些记得的人和那些当时尚未出生的人的眼泪将与你一起流下。”
